jobs.title: Product Manager, Model Launches
jobs.excerpt: About Nebius:Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy.
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Token Factory is hiring a Product Manager for new model launches. We bring the newest state-of-the-art models to production, often on day-0 as a launch partner to frontier and emerging AI labs. Reporting into the product organization, you’ll own end-to-end delivery and work with engineering, billing, legal, marketing and our partners to ensure timely and quality model launches on the platform.

You’re welcome to work remotely from the United States

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own end-to-end execution of new model launches on Token Factory, from intake and kickoff to public release and post-launch activities. Ensuring every model launches on time and with quality.

  • Coordinate across engineering, billing, legal and marketing to ensure all deliverables that each launch depends on are ready, such as: model metadata, serving configuration, pricing, licensing and GTM communications.

  • Responsible for the quality of every model release through hands-on QA validation of inference, configuration and metadata and third-party integrations. You drive remediation of any gaps or defects identified to ensure model launch quality.

  • Act as the operational point of contact for model partners during a launch, aligning scope, timing, access to model assets and post-launch follow-up so that day-0 launches land cleanly.

  • Keep stakeholders informed with regular status updates, and report on post-launch traction and economic performance.

  • Maintain and improve model launch operating procedures: runbooks, intake criteria, templates and onboarding materials and acceptance gates. Run retrospectives to gather insights and opportunities that feed back into that process-improvement loop.

  • Coordinate issues, escalations and questions for upcoming and recently launched models, including support escalations, known issues and duty coordination for model problems.

We expect you to have:

    • 5+ years in a product, engineering or similar role shipping software, AI or other developer-facing products/services.

    • Ability to navigate technical and procedural friction across time zones and team boundaries, to support, communicate or escalate as needed.

    • Effective communication skills: provide concise status updates, work with internal stakeholders and external partners, run weekly meetings and write clear documentation.

    • Understanding of how models are served and consumed: architectures, serving configuration, quantization, GPU hardware and the OpenAI API schema standard.

    • Adept with AI agents and skills. You’ll set up workflows with existing tools to retrieve data, run checks and keep internal operations moving. You understand how to use AI safely and effectively, verify its output, and recognize when a non-AI approach is the right decision.

    • Technical fluency to work with APIs, read configuration and template files, familiarity with Git and CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices.

It would be an added bonus if you have:

  • Software development experience.

  • Experience with LLM inference serving: engines, quantization, benchmarking.

  • Understanding of Kubernetes, Helm charts and autoscaling.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range
$147,200—$183,900 USD

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Computational and Experimental Scientist
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleJoin a lean team at an early-stage AI-driven biotech company, combining computational protein design with hands-on experimental work.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Join a lean team at an early-stage AI-driven biotech company, combining computational protein design with hands-on experimental work. You will own the design-make-test-model loop, from developing protein design models and operating an inference platform to measuring binding kinetics and feeding results back into improved designs.

What You'll Do

  • Improve and extend discrete diffusion and protein folding models, including model architecture, attention, and hierarchical reasoning.

  • Operate and refine a biological design inference platform, analyzing usage patterns and diagnosing user behavior.

  • Write, debug, and operate production protocols for liquid-handling robots and plate automation.

  • Design and run BLI and SPR assays, fit kinetic curves, conduct quality control, and troubleshoot experimental failure modes.

  • Develop robust protocols for cloud labs and manage internal screening instrumentation.

  • Connect receptor biology, protein structure, scoring, and model outputs to practical experimental workflows.

  • Design sequences, measure their kinetics, use results to update models, and iterate toward improved candidates.

What We're Looking For

  • 3 to 11 years of relevant experience, including hands-on wet-lab work and experience across biology, bioinformatics, and machine learning.

  • Experience building or operating protein or biological models, such as discrete diffusion models, protein language models, or structure prediction systems, in an experimental feedback loop.

  • Practical experience with tools such as ESM, ProtT5, RFdiffusion, BindCraft, or equivalent, applied to real protein design workflows.

  • Hands-on experience writing and debugging liquid-handler protocols and personally fitting BLI or SPR kinetic curves end to end.

  • Proficiency with Python or equivalent scripting for robot automation and kinetic data analysis.

  • Knowledge of receptor biology, protein structure, and scoring, with the ability to diagnose why computational predictions may not match experimental results.

  • Experience in biotech or life sciences software customer success, solutions engineering, or a similar customer-facing operator role, including user conversion and varied purchasing processes.

  • Ability to conduct personalized scientific outreach and experience operating inference systems at scale or refining model architectures.

Compensation & Benefits

Consulting engagement: $3,000 to $5,000 per month. Full-time conversion base salary: $80,000 to $200,000 annually, depending on experience, with equity and deal-contingent upside. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Hybrid in New York, United States, with increased on-site presence expected as internal screening operations are established.

At Ververica, you will help shape the future of real-time data processing. Join us in a dynamic, collaborative environment where your leadership and expertise will drive our success and define the next era of innovation.

jobs.description:
As vCluster Labs’ Staff Software Engineer, you will operate as a specialized technical leader, working directly with the CTO to explore new frontiers in our technology. You will bridge the gap between rapid prototyping, architectural research, and product evolution, taking on responsibilities that go far beyond standard coding to shape the future of our Kubernetes virtualization platform.

As a Staff Software Engineer, your role will include:

  • Rapid Prototyping & Innovation: Act as a specialized engineer who identifies interesting product opportunities, researches solutions, and quickly builds prototypes to validate if they work. You will report back on feasibility and guide the technical direction based on your findings.

  • Strategic Technical Leadership: Take ownership of responsibilities beyond coding, including managing complex technical projects, writing technical abstracts, and helping the wider engineering team navigate difficult challenges.

  • Direct Collaboration with Leadership: Work directly with the CTO and operate outside the traditional engineering organization boundaries to solve high-level problems and ideate on new product capabilities.

  • System Mastery & Evolution: Develop a deep understanding of our existing system while maintaining the agility to learn new things quickly. You will be responsible for integrating new technologies into our stack efficiently.

  • Customer & External Engagement: While primarily technical, this role includes customer-facing elements. You will occasionally engage with users to understand their deep technical needs and translate those into engineering solutions.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Deep Kubernetes & GoLang Expertise: You possess 3+ years of deep technical experience with Kubernetes and GoLang. You are comfortable diving into the internals of cloud-native infrastructure.

  • High Autonomy: You are a self-starter who can work on your own, figure out complex issues without hand-holding, and thrive in an environment where you are trusted to manage your own time and priorities.

  • Beyond the Code: You have experience that extends beyond just writing software. You understand the broader picture of product development, project management, and technical communication.

  • Rapid Learning Agility: You are quick to prototype and even quicker to learn. You enjoy the challenge of picking up new tools, languages, or architectural concepts on the fly to solve immediate problems.

Bonus points for:

  • Deep understanding of cloud-native containers and the broader ecosystem.

  • Startup experience where you had significant technical influence and helped shape the product.

  • Experience writing technical content, such as abstracts, white papers, or blog posts.

  • Background in Platform Engineering or experience building internal developer platforms (IDPs).

About vCluster Labs

We are a venture-backed tech startup striving to be the leading force in enabling platform engineers. We raised +$30M from top-tier VCs such as Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, Doordash) and are in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to complement our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe and we have a remote-first work culture.

We are vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (+10k GitHub stars). Open source is part of our DNA.

The adoption of our commercial product based on vCluster has grown extremely fast (multi-million dollar revenue) and our customer base includes some of the biggest companies in the world, including 6 Global Fortune 500 companies as well as some of the fastest-growing tech unicorns and AI clouds (neoclouds).

Why join vCluster Labs?

Since we are a fast-moving startup, you will not be number 14,589 in our company but rather become an essential part of our team right from the start:

  • Fast Application Process: We will typically get back to you within a week. No need to polish your resume for us. Just send us some links (e.g. LinkedIn, etc.), answer a few questions about your previous experiences, and hop on a quick Zoom call with one of our team members to see if you’re a good fit. We will respond quickly and make hiring decisions within days rather than months.

  • Open-Minded Work Environment: You can always speak your mind - no company politics or unnecessary formalities. We are operating in a lean, honest, and efficient way and we are looking for different perspectives, constructive feedback and creative, motivated people who want to make a difference.

  • Grow With The Company: We are a small company right now but we are growing incredibly fast because we work on something that has a lot of value to engineering teams in large enterprises. Joining vCluster Labs early will give you the chance to advance much faster to the next step on the career ladder than in any larger company.

  • Responsibility From Day 1: You will see right from the start that your work will immediately have an impact in our company and you can shape the future of this company together with the rest of our team.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

jobs.excerpt: About ActThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

About the Role

As Lead Technical Recruiter, you will lead critical technical searches, raise recruiting quality across the team and help build ActAI's technical recruiting capability.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead Act's highest-priority technical searches across AI/ML, engineering leadership, backend, infrastructure, web and mobile.

  • Build search strategies and talent maps for scarce technical talent across global AI and engineering markets.

  • Personally source, engage, assess and close senior and difficult-to-hire candidates.

  • Set a high bar for technical profile assessment, ensuring recruiters understand candidates' actual work, technical depth and relevance before progressing them.

  • Partner closely with engineering leadership to define hiring profiles, calibrate interview standards and diagnose gaps in the recruiting funnel.

  • Coach technical recruiters on sourcing strategy, profile assessment, candidate engagement and closing.

  • Review pipeline quality and recruiting data, identify where searches are failing and change strategy quickly.

  • Develop repeatable recruiting practices that improve hiring quality and speed as Act scales.

What You Will Need

  • 7+ years of technical recruiting experience, including significant ownership of senior and difficult engineering searches.

  • Strong track record hiring high-quality engineers through direct sourcing and headhunting.

  • Deep familiarity with technical talent markets and strong understanding of software engineering and AI/ML profiles.

  • Ability to distinguish exceptional technical work from strong branding, titles or CV keywords.

  • Experience partnering directly with senior engineering leaders on hiring strategy and calibration.

  • Demonstrated ability to coach recruiters and improve the quality of their sourcing and assessment.

  • Strong judgement, urgency and willingness to remain deeply hands-on.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or leading technical recruiting at an AI company or high-growth technology startup.

  • Existing networks across AI/ML and engineering communities.

  • Experience hiring across multiple markets including the US, Europe and Asia.

Solution Architect

Who We Need

ADA is looking for an experienced Solution Architect who can operate as a trusted technical authority across the business. This is a company-level role: rather than being fully embedded in one project or customer, the Solution Architect will consult across multiple projects, clients and strategic initiatives while remaining close enough to delivery to guide implementation and quality.

At this stage of your career, you are expected to have demonstrated that you:

  • Can be fully trusted with technical decision-making and architectural direction.
  • Can balance technical requirements, delivery constraints and a project’s business objectives.
  • Contribute to improving ADA’s technical landscape, engineering practices and reusable capability.
  • Actively build your own professional brand and the Decision Inc. brand internally and within the broader technology community.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Consulting: Provide architecture leadership across multiple engagements; translate business needs into scalable, secure and maintainable solutions; assess existing systems; define target architectures and make pragmatic technology decisions.
  • Implementation: Remain hands-on enough to validate architecture through delivery, support critical implementation decisions and guide teams through complex technical challenges.
  • Technical Leadership: Mentor Technical Leads and senior engineers, provide technical escalation support and raise engineering capability across teams.

  • Training & Capability Development: Help define technical learning priorities, contribute to training content and support the development of architects, Technical Leads and engineers.
  • Research & Development: Allocate time to emerging technologies, architectural patterns and practical experimentation that can improve client solutions and internal capability.

Technical Scope

  • The role is technology-agnostic and requires broad architectural depth across modern custom development and digital solutions. Key areas include:
  • Custom development: Java, .NET/C#, React, Angular and JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Architecture: enterprise applications, microservices, modular and event-driven architectures, APIs, integration patterns, distributed systems and security-by-design.
  • Cloud & infrastructure: Microsoft Azure, cloud-native architecture, containers, networking, identity, scalability, resilience, monitoring and observability; AWS exposure is advantageous.

  • DevOps & engineering quality: CI/CD, source control, automated testing, Infrastructure as Code, deployment strategies and technical quality gates.
  • Emerging technologies: AI-enabled applications, AI service integration, low-code platforms and application modernisation.

How you work

  • Make technology choices based on business problems, not platform preference.
  • Evaluate trade-offs across cost, speed, scalability, security, maintainability and operational complexity.
  • Communicate architecture clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Provide direction without becoming a bottleneck, enabling teams to make sound decisions independently.

Experience and Capability

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical discipline.
  • Typically 7–10+ years’ experience across software engineering, technical leadership and solution architecture.
  • Strong foundation in custom application development and modern enterprise architecture.
  • Experience designing solutions across frontend, backend, integration, data, cloud and infrastructure concerns.
  • Strong Azure architecture experience; AWS exposure advantageous.
  • Experience providing technical governance, reviewing designs and guiding multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Strong consulting and stakeholder engagement capability, including the ability to operate across several clients and initiatives.
  • Experience supporting presales, technical assessments, estimation or solution shaping is advantageous.

What success looks like

  • Technical Leads and engineering teams become stronger and more self-sufficient through effective mentorship.
  • Reusable standards, patterns and lessons are shared across ADA rather than remaining within individual projects.

Peraton is seeking a Director to lead the administration and user enablement of Peraton[x], our enterprise generative AI and agentic analytics platform. This leader is accountable for how the platform is configured, governed, and accessed, and for making sure every program that uses it can do so successfully. The Director leads a multidisciplinary team of system administrators, AI analysts, business analysts, and knowledge workers who onboard users, build reusable solutions, curate knowledge, and drive adoption across Peraton. The role connects end users, program leadership, and platform engineering. It turns business needs into well-administered platform capabilities and measurable adoption outcomes.

Job Responsibilities

Platform Administration & Governance

  • Lead all Peraton[x] system administration, including user and program provisioning, role-based access and data-tier management, environment configuration, and platform settings.
  • Set and enforce administrative standards, policies, and procedures for access requests, onboarding and offboarding, project and workspace management, and knowledge-base (cortex) governance.
  • Oversee release readiness and change management from the administrator and end-user side, including communicating platform changes, new features, and impacts to users.
  • Run the service desk and tiered user support model: ticket intake, triage, escalation to engineering, and resolution tracking against service-level targets.
  • Manage AI usage, cost, and license administration: track consumption and spend by program, attribute costs, and enforce usage policies.
  • Maintain administrative documentation, runbooks, and audit-ready records of access, configuration, and change.

User Enablement & Adoption

  • Own the Peraton[x] enablement strategy, including role-based onboarding, training curricula, office hours, user guides, and playbooks for new and experienced users.
  • Build and lead a community of practice and a power-user/champion network across programs to spread best practices and grow adoption.
  • Direct AI and business analysts in designing reusable skills, flows, workflows, dashboards, and templates that solve recurring program problems and lower the barrier to entry.
  • Partner with programs to identify high-value use cases, guide pilots, and scale successful solutions across the enterprise.
  • Measure adoption, engagement, and value using usage analytics and user feedback, and use the results to target training and improvements.

Knowledge Management

  • Lead knowledge workers in curating, organizing, and governing platform content, including enrolled documents, ontologies, knowledge graphs, and reference materials.
  • Set standards for content quality, metadata, classification, and lifecycle (review, archive, retire) so knowledge stays accurate and discoverable.
  • Maintain a central knowledge base of FAQs, how-to content, and lessons learned for users and administrators.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a cross-functional team of system administrators, AI analysts, business analysts, and knowledge workers.
  • Define roles, career paths, performance goals, and development plans, including AI literacy, prompt and agent design, and platform administration skills.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for program leaders and business units on platform access, onboarding, support, and adoption.
  • Gather and prioritize user and program requirements and represent them to product and engineering teams.
  • Report adoption, user satisfaction, support performance, cost, and value metrics to senior leadership.
  • Manage the administration and enablement budget, vendor relationships, and licensing.

Security, Compliance & Responsible AI

  • Make sure platform administration complies with Peraton policy, the Acceptable Use Policy, and relevant frameworks (e.g., NIST 800-171, CMMC, FedRAMP).
  • Enforce least-privilege access, data classification, periodic access reviews, and audit-evidence practices.
  • Promote responsible AI use through training, human-in-the-loop review, output verification, and governed approval workflows.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Proven experience administering enterprise SaaS, collaboration, or analytics platforms, including user and access management, configuration, and governance.
  • Demonstrated success leading technology adoption, training, and change-management programs across large or distributed organizations.
  • Strong working knowledge of generative AI, LLMs, and agentic workflows, and how they create business and mission value.
  • Experience running service desk and user support operations (ITIL or equivalent).
  • Experience leading mixed technical and non-technical teams (e.g., administrators, analysts, knowledge managers).
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to train users, brief executives, and turn technical topics into business terms.
  • Experience managing budgets, vendors, and licensing.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in data analytics, business analysis, or all-source analysis.

  • Certifications such as ITIL, Prosci/change management, PMP, AWS, or Agile/SAFe.

jobs.excerpt: About WebEngage:WebEngage is an enterprise-grade customer engagement and retention platform that helps global brands across industries such as e-commerce, fintech, travel, edtech, gaming, media, and consumer apps.
jobs.description:
About WebEngage:

WebEngage is an enterprise-grade customer engagement and retention platform that helps global brands across industries such as e-commerce, fintech, travel, edtech, gaming, media, and consumer apps. and turn data into measurable revenue impact. Trusted by 800+ brands globally, we have strong presence in India, UAE, KSA, SEA, Europe and beyond. WebEngage powers intelligent, real-time engagement across the entire customer lifecycle.
  • We are built for scale.
  • We are built for complexity.
  • We are built for outcomes.
At our core, WebEngage is a full-stack retention operating system that combines:
  • A powerful Customer Data Platform (CDP)
  • Real-time behavioral segmentation and intelligence
  • Omnichannel journey orchestration
  • AI-driven personalization and recommendations
  • Deep analytics, experimentation, and revenue attribution
  • WebEngage BLACK: our AI-native layer that brings Agentic capabilities to engagement.
Learn more about us at www.webengage.com

About The Role:

WebEngage’s Data Engineering team is the backbone of our analytics, personalisation, and machine-learning capabilities. As a Data Engineer, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of data — from ingesting raw event streams and third-party feeds to building well-modelled, highly reliable datasets that power dashboards, predictive models, and customer journey orchestration. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will work at the intersection of product, analytics, and backend engineering. You will be expected to think beyond just moving data — designing for data quality, pipeline observability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability from day one.

Responsibilities:

Pipeline Development & Reliability

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from APIs, databases, event streams (Kafka/Pub-Sub), and flat files into the central data warehouse.
  • Implement idempotent, incremental load patterns with built-in retry logic, dead-letter queues, and SLA-based alerting to ensure zero-data-loss pipelines.
  • Own pipeline observability — set up data freshness checks, row-count validations, schema drift detection, and anomaly alerts using tools like Great Expectations or dbt tests.

Data Modelling & Warehouse Design

  • Translate business requirements into clean dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas) and maintain a well-documented data catalogue.
  • Design slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), bridge tables, and fact tables optimised for analytical query patterns.
  • Enforce partitioning, clustering, and materialised view strategies to keep warehouse costs under control while maintaining sub-second query performance.

Code Quality & Engineering Best Practices

  • Write clean, modular, well-tested Python and SQL code. Follow DRY principles, use version control (Git), and participate in peer code reviews.
  • Build reusable transformation frameworks using dbt or equivalent tooling, with proper documentation and testing at every layer (staging → intermediate → mart).
  • Containerise data services with Docker and automate deployments via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub
Actions / GitLab CI).

BI, Visualization & Analytics

  • Build interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Streamlit, enabling stakeholders to explore metrics, run ad-hoc analyses, and make data-driven decisions without engineering dependency.
  • Design and maintain BI layers — semantic models, KPI definitions, and pre-aggregated mart tables that serve as the single source of truth for reporting across teams.
  • Translate raw data into compelling visual narratives using libraries like Plotly, Matplotlib, or Altair; present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with product managers, analysts, and data scientists to understand data needs and proactively identify gaps in current data coverage.
  • Document data lineage, transformation logic, SLAs, and known limitations in a shared knowledge base to enable self-service analytics.
  • Contribute to internal engineering guilds, knowledge-sharing sessions, and post-incident reviews for pipeline failures.

Requirements:

  • Strong SQL skills with expertise in complex queries, performance optimization, and cost-efficient design on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift).
  • Strong Python scripting for data ingestion, transformation, and validation, with hands-on experience in Pandas, SQLAlchemy, APIs, and automation.
  • ETL/ELT- End-to-end ownership of data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, and loading, with understanding of incremental loads, and backfills.
  • Data Modelling- Ability to design dimensional and transactional data models (star/snowflake, SCDs) and translate business needs into optimized table structures.

Good to Have:

  • Airflow, dbt, Docker, CI/CD
  • GCP/AWS, data warehousing concepts
  • BI tools / Streamlit / visualization

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 1–3 years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a backend role with significant data pipeline work.
  • Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture — know when to use wide denormalised tables vs. normalised models, and the trade-offs of each.
  • Familiarity with version control workflows (Git branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and agile development practices.
  • A data quality mindset — you instinctively validate assumptions, add assertions to pipelines, and treat silent data failures as critical incidents.

Life at WebEngage:

  • We take transparency very seriously. Along with a full view of team goals, get a top-level view across the board with our monthly & quarterly town hall meetings.
  • A highly inclusive work culture that promotes a relaxed, creative and productive environment.
  • Practice autonomy, open communication, growth opportunities,while maintaining a perfect work-life balance

Perks & Benefits:

  • Learning is a way of life. Unlock your full potential backed with cutting-edge tools and mentorship (Macbook for Engagers!)
  • Get the best in class medical insurance (with Covid Care facilities), programs for taking care of your mental health, and a Contemporary Leave Policy (beyond sick leaves)

jobs.title: Clinical Research Associate II - IQVIA Biotech - Belgium - Home based (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: IQVIA Biotech is a unique division specialising in working with smaller biotech and emerging biopharma clients and as such we have a vibrant, fast-paced working environment.
jobs.description:
IQVIA Biotech is a unique division specialising in working with smaller biotech and emerging biopharma clients and as such we have a vibrant, fast-paced working environment. The sector we are in is cutting edge for therapies with un-met medical need.

IQVIA Biotech has an exciting position within its EU Clinical Monitoring team. The Clinical Monitoring department is the largest team within IQVIA Biotech, providing CRA, Clinical Leads, Management and oversight to global clinical studies.

Please note, for this role you must be based in Belgium

Basic Functions:

Participates in the preparation and execution of Phase I-IV clinical trials. Oversees the progress of clinical investigations by conducting site evaluation, initiation, and interim close out visits to sites. Monitors clinical trials in accordance with Good Clinical Practices and procedures set forth by IQVIA Biotech and sponsors. Works closely with the Clinical Trial Manager (CTM) and/or Lead CRA to ensure all monitoring activities are conducted according to study requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Participates in the investigator recruitment process, performing site evaluation visits of potential investigators to evaluate the capability of the site to successfully manage and conduct the clinical study.

  • Coordinate activities with the site and internal departments in preparation for the initiation of the study. Performs study initiation activities, reviewing with the site personnel the protocol, regulatory issues, study procedures, and provides training on completion of the eCRF and EDC system; monitoring activities and study close-out activities.

  • Assists in resolving any issues to ensure compliance with site file audits in conjunction with ISS.

  • Assures adherence to Good Clinical Practices, investigator integrity, and compliance with all study procedures through on-site monitoring visits. Performs validation of source documentation as required by sponsor. Prepares monitoring reports and letters per the timelines defined in IQVIA Biotech SOPs.

  • Documents accountability, stability and storage conditions of clinical trial materials as required by sponsor. Performs investigational product inventory.

  • Reviews the quality and integrity of the clinical data through (1) in house review of electronic CRF data and (2) on-site source verification and works with sites to resolve data queries and produce robust data.

  • May review protocols, eCRFs, study manuals and other related documents, as requested by the Clinical Trial Manager and/or Lead CRA.

  • Serves as primary contact between IQVIA Biotech and investigator; coordinates all correspondence; ensures timely transmission of clinical data with the study site and technical reporting, as requested.

  • Assists with, and attends, Investigator Meetings for assigned studies.

  • Attends study-related, company, departmental, and external meetings, as required.

  • Ensures all study deliverables are completed per IQVIA Biotech and study timelines

  • Conducts Field Evaluation Visits and field training of CRA Is, IIs and other Sr. CRAs.

  • Serves as mentor for junior CRAs and those new to the company and/or study.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Strong knowledge of clinical research process, including working knowledge of all functional areas of clinical trials and medical terminology.

  • Minimum of 1-2 years of onsite monitoring experience is a must.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to express complex ideas to study personnel at research and clinical institutions.

  • Able to form productive professional relationships both internally within own function, cross-functionally and externally with health care professionals.

  • Able to handle several priorities within multiple, complex trials.

  • Able to reason independently and recommend specific solutions in clinical settings.

  • Able to work independently, prioritize, and work within a matrix team environment.

  • Knowledge of current GCP/ICH guidelines applicable to the conduct of clinical research.

  • Candidates must have strong communication levels of Dutch and English (French is a plus)

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

Why We Exist

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We’ve reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and scaled revenue 70X. We’re now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

Why We’re Hiring

Jerry is expanding into several new markets at the same time. Capital allocation is now one of the most consequential decisions we make: each dollar committed to a new product line, a marketing channel, or a headcount is a dollar not available elsewhere.

We are hiring a Strategic Finance Manager, reporting to our VP of Finance, to build the analysis those decisions rest on. You will own the operating model and the planning cycle, partner with functional leaders across the company, and work closely with the CFO and the founders.

What You’ll Own

The operating core is the model, the planning cadence, and the spend discipline the company runs on. Alongside it, you are the analytical partner on new opportunities — the products, verticals, channels and partnerships we are deciding whether to back. And over your first year or two, as our newer products scale and the audience for our numbers widens beyond the people who already know the business, the reporting itself has to reach a standard that holds up to outside diligence.

Own the operating model and forecast cycle:

  • Own Jerry’s driver-based operating model for the base business and expand it as we launch new insurance products and business lines.

  • Run the annual budget and long-range planning process end to end — cadence, assumptions, stakeholder inputs, and the consolidated plan the executive team commits to.

  • Own the monthly and quarterly forecast cycle and variance analysis: Once Accounting closes the books, explain what moved against plan and prior period, why it moved, and what it means for the forecast.

  • Write the executive narrative: Translate the financial results into clear business insights for the CFO, the founders, the board, and our investors, at a standard that survives external diligence.

  • Lead monthly business reviews: Work with functional leaders and turn what the numbers show into the business decisions that need to be made.

  • Support the team in evaluating and implementing a planning system: Assess the options, make the recommendation, and own the rollout.

Build the financial case for new opportunities

  • Build the financial model for new product, vertical, channel or partnership: Size the market, model the economics, evaluate capital commitment and return profile.

  • Read results back against the case: Once something is live, compare the actual economics to what we underwrote and carry the lesson into the next decision. Monitor product and channel economics including CAC and payback, policy retention and lifetime value, contribution margin etc.

  • Support corporate development: Capital markets and investor workstreams through diligence, modeling, and transaction analysis as the need arises.

  • Frame build, buy or partner decisions: help refine the frameworks we use to compare the options and the return profile of each.

Underwrite vendor spend:

  • Build the business case before a commitment is made, support negotiation on terms, and give budget owners the visibility to manage their own numbers.

Who You Are

  • Accurate under deadline: Your numbers are right the first time, and they stay right when the deadline compresses. You check your own work before anyone else has to.

  • Picks the right question: No one hands you the workstream. You decide which analysis will actually change a decision, and leave the rest alone.

  • Direct communicator: You form a view, communicate it directly, and revise it when the evidence changes.

  • Executive-ready output: What you produce can go in front of the founders or the board without a rewrite — clear, precise, and honest about what the numbers do and do not show.

Field Sales Representative

Location: Doncaster, covering Doncaster or surrounding areas such as Mexborough, Thorne or Bawtry (fully field-based)

£50,000–£90,000 OTE (£30,000–£54,000 base salary + uncapped commission, based on experience) + £800 monthly car allowance and a comprehensive benefits package

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy meeting new people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for ambitious, driven people to join our growing Field Sales team and help bring Teya to more local businesses across the UK.

As a Field Sales Representative, you’ll take ownership of your own territory, getting out into your local community, meeting business owners face-to-face and showing them how Teya can help their businesses thrive.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships and winning new business. You’ll have the freedom to manage your territory, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career in sales.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own your territory: Proactively identify and engage local businesses through face-to-face prospecting, networking, referrals and other opportunities to generate new business.

  • Build meaningful relationships: Get to know business owners, understand their challenges and identify how Teya’s products and services can make their lives easier.

  • Win new Members: Use a consultative, value-led approach to demonstrate Teya’s solutions, build trust and turn conversations into long-term customer relationships.

  • Deliver results: Take ownership of your sales performance, maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently work towards your commercial targets.

  • See things through: Take responsibility for your Members’ experience from the first conversation through to onboarding, ensuring they’re set up successfully and ready to start using Teya.

  • Keep learning: Develop strong knowledge of our products, competitors and sales methodology through structured training, coaching and feedback.

  • Represent Teya: Be a trusted face of Teya in your local community, delivering the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience.

  • Help us improve: Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve our products, sales approach and Member experience.

Your Story

We believe great salespeople come from all kinds of backgrounds.

You might already be an experienced field sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business. Or you might be earlier in your career, with the ambition, drive and potential to become an exceptional salesperson.

What matters most to us is your mindset, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn and improve.

We’re looking for people who bring:

  • Ambition and drive: You’re motivated to succeed, enjoy working towards challenging goals and take pride in delivering great results.

  • A competitive mindset: You enjoy winning, hold yourself to high standards and are always looking for ways to improve.

  • Resilience and determination: You’re comfortable with rejection, stay positive when things get tough and don’t give up easily.

  • Strong people skills: You enjoy meeting new people, build rapport naturally and can have meaningful conversations with business owners from all walks of life.

  • Curiosity and commercial awareness: You ask good questions, listen carefully and want to understand what makes a business successful.

  • Coachability: You’re open to feedback, willing to challenge yourself and committed to developing your skills.

  • Ownership and self-discipline: You’re organised, proactive and comfortable managing your own time and priorities in a field-based role.

  • A genuine care for others: You understand that great sales isn’t just about closing a deal. It’s about doing what’s right for the customer and building trust that lasts.

Experience in field sales, business development, payments or financial services is an advantage, but not essential for every level. We care just as much about your potential as your experience.

You’ll also need:

  • Fluency in English.

  • A full UK driving licence and access to a car.

  • The right to work in the UK.

  • Willingness to work in a fully field-based role, travelling regularly throughout your territory.

The Perks

We believe great performance should be recognised and rewarded. Alongside the opportunity to build your career in a growing European fintech, you’ll receive:

  • £30,000–£54,000 base salary, depending on your experience and demonstrated capability.

  • Uncapped commission.

  • £800 per month car allowance (£9,600 annually), on top of your salary and commission.

  • 25 days of paid annual leave, plus UK bank holidays.

  • Bupa private healthcare and life insurance.

  • Employer pension contributions through our company pension scheme.

  • Free gym membership through Wellhub, alongside one-to-one therapy sessions, meditation and digital fitness and nutrition apps.

  • Structured onboarding, practical sales training, ongoing coaching and opportunities to grow your career at Teya.

What Happens Next?

Our recruitment process is designed to help us get to know you, understand your strengths and give you a genuine opportunity to show us what you can do.

Stage 1 - Introductory conversation (30 minutes)
A conversation with our Talent team to learn more about you, your motivation and what you’re looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 - Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)
An opportunity to explore your experience, how you approach challenges and what makes you successful.

Stage 3 - Final Assessment (60 minutes)
You’ll meet members of our Sales leadership team, present a short territory plan and take part in a practical sales role-play. We’ll share everything you need to prepare in advance.

We know interviews are a two-way process, and we’ll make sure you have plenty of opportunities to ask questions and get to know us along the way.

Teya is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those without a traditional sales or commercial track record.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

jobs.excerpt: PermitFlow is redefining how America builds.  We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how.
jobs.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

This role must be based in Ontario or willing to relocate to the area.

Who You Are

  • Customer-Centric: You excel at building and maintaining strong customer relationships, understanding each customer’s unique needs, and identifying how PermitFlow can support their success and growth. You are comfortable and thrive at connecting with customers virtually – spearheading meetings and serving as the face of PermitFlow in all your interactions.

  • Construction Permitting Expert: You have extensive hands-on experience in construction or construction permitting directly, with a thorough understanding of regulations, compliance, and the full permit lifecycle. You’re excited about this space and the construction industry at large.

  • Team Player: You’re a key contributor to the customer journey from software adoption to full implementation. Collaboration is your strength, and you thrive in a cross-functional environment.

  • Analytical Thinker: You’re data-driven in your decision-making. You know how to gather, interpret, and leverage data to enhance customer conversations and improve processes.

  • Tech-Forward & Adaptable: You’re comfortable leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to improve workflows and customer outcomes. You’re eager to learn and implement new software features, and you adapt quickly — ready and able to pivot to new processes at a moment’s notice.

What You’ll Do

  • Customer Point of Contact: Serve as the primary resource for customers, keeping them informed on permit status, timelines, and requirements.

  • Team Development: You are comfortable providing clear training, coaching, feedback, and direction to junior team members and oversee their work. You have the skillset to effectively manage a team, hold 1:1s with them, and empower them to learn more.

  • Manage the Permit Process: Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of permit applications, including researching requirements, preparing forms, gathering documentation, and submitting applications to the relevant authorities.

  • Generate Reports: Produce detailed reports on permit progress, delivering regular, clear updates to customers and stakeholders.

  • Optimize Processes: Continuously identify opportunities for improvement, implementing best practices that streamline workflows, reduce bottlenecks, and enhance operational efficiency.

  • Ensure Compliance and Accuracy: Guarantee that all permit applications are complete, accurate, and compliant with jurisdictional standards and requirements.

  • Monitor and Expedite Approvals: Track permit statuses proactively, engaging with authorities to move applications forward as efficiently as possible.

Qualifications & Fit

  • 3-5+ years of relevant experience: Proven track record in construction permitting, project management, or a similar role—ideally within a SaaS or tech-driven environment.

  • Bilingual: English and French

  • Location: Based in Ontario or willing to relocate to the area

  • Permitting Expert: Experience with residential or commercial permitting in Quebec, including direct work with municipalities. Strong understanding of permitting processes, regulations, and compliance standards, with awareness of jurisdictional differences.

  • Exceptional project management skills: Ability to balance multiple projects and deadlines without sacrificing attention to detail.

  • Outstanding communication: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally, manage customer relationships, and collaborate with AHJs.

  • Leadership experience: Preferred 2+ years leading, managing, and mentoring teams, including coaching, performance management, and team development.

  • Customer-centric mindset: Background in customer success, customer experience, or sales, with a demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality service throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Critical thinker and problem-solver: Able to stay calm under pressure, quickly assess challenges, and identify effective solutions.

What We Offer (Full Time Roles Only)

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

jobs.description:
NOTE: The Pay Range referenced in this job announcement only applies to applicants who perform the job within the US and to applicants classified by CRS as International Assignees. Staff hired on local payroll would follow the respective Country pay range. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your anticipated work location during the candidate selection process.

Job Summary

CRS strives to promote the health, safety and well-being of all staff. As part of this approach, CRS considers health and well-being an integral aspect of our success. This role will be responsible for strategically designing, leading, and implementing staff care and well-being strategies at both the individual, group and organizational levels. As part of the Health, Safety and Security Unit (HSSU) and member of the HSS Senior Management Team, the Senior Advisor, Staff Well-Being and Workforce Resilience will oversee capacity strengthening in staff care and resilience practices, psychosocial critical incident response, and global well-being initiatives.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership:

  • Lead the technical development, implementation, and continuous improvement of CRS’ Staff Care and Well-Being strategy, procedures, standards, and frameworks to ensure alignment with organizational priorities, duty of care commitments, risk management strategies, workforce needs, and operational effectiveness.
  • Develop and oversee a psychosocial risk assessment framework, including standardized assessment and documentation tools that can be adapted and scaled across countries and regions to identify, monitor, and address emerging psychosocial risks.
  • Advise country and regional teams, and leadership on strategies and practices that promote staff well-being, resilience, and operational effectiveness, with particular attention to high-risk, insecure, emergency, humanitarian, disaster, and other high-stress operating environments.

Crisis Response:

  • Facilitate preparedness activities and psychosocial risk mitigation efforts for country programs operating in high-risk, insecure, and crisis-affected contexts.
  • Lead agency-wide Family Liaison Program, including liaison training curriculum development, program oversight, and continuous quality improvement.
  • Translate clinical knowledge into technical/operation guidance to country and regional teams, and leadership during and following critical incidents, emergencies, security incidents (road traffic accidents, detentions, physical or sexual violence, etc.), and other situations that may adversely affect staff well-being.
  • Coordinate referrals during/after critical incidents to appropriate resources

Capacity Building and Technical Assistance:

  • Design and deliver in-person and remote training and capacity-strengthening initiatives for CRS staff, managers, and leaders, with particular emphasis on strengthening preparedness, resilience, psychosocial support, and stress management in high-risk and high-stress operating environments.
  • Develop evidence-informed guidance, tools, and resources grounded in psychological science, mental health care research, and trauma-informed principles and adapt them for use across CRS organizational and operating contexts.
  • Strengthen leadership and manager capacity to recognize, address, and mitigate psychosocial risks affecting individuals, teams, and organizational performance.
  • Facilitate agency-wide learning opportunities, community of practice, and knowledge-sharing initiatives that promote effective staff care and well-being practices across CRS and, where appropriate, partner organizations.

Supervision, Monitoring, Evaluation, Reporting:

  • Supervise and provide technical direction to Technical Advisor and/or consultant responsible for supporting agency-wide staff care and well-being activities.
  • Monitor and track progress toward strategic objectives and key performance indicators and recommend adjustments to strengthen effectiveness, sustainability, and organizational impact.

Key Working Relationships

  • Internal: HSSU, Regional and Deputy Regional Directors, Sr. Director of Health, Safety and Security, Country Representatives and Managers, Heads of Operations, Heads of Programs, HSS Focal Points, HR, Program Quality (including Health programming team), Ethics Unit, General Counsel, and Humanitarian Response Department.
  • External: International and local mental health providers, Employee Assistance Program vendors, contracted medical service providers and peers/peer networks in public and private sector.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Demonstrates ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed team with strong relationship building skills to work collaboratively and effectively with key stakeholders across functions, cultures, and time zones.
  • Experience working in sensitive situations with internal and external stakeholders
  • Strong proficiency in virtual collaboration and communication technologies (e.g., Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, intranet, email, phone, text messaging, webinar platforms, and shared workspaces),
  • Self-motivated to meet deadlines with evidence of problem solving and critical thinking
  • Ability to train and convey information to a variety of personnel on various skill and language levels
  • Able and willing to work flexible hours when needed, including off-hours and weekends for critical incident response
  • Provide effective remote supervision and/or coaching, and support to staff, consultants, and stakeholders worldwide.
  • Language Required: Fluency in English required; Fluency in another language such as French, Spanish or Arabic preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience transferring knowledge to diverse audiences through training, mentoring, and other formal and informal methods

Required Languages: Fluency in English required; Fluency in another language such as French, Spanish or Arabic preferred.

Travel:Approximately 15% of the time, primarily to/within the various regions, and sometimes in remote areas with minimal amenities available.

jobs.description:
About Clarity Pediatrics

Clarity Pediatrics is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD. After successfully launching our virtual clinic for ADHD and anxiety, we are expanding our pediatric care platform to address other common chronic conditions and are focused right now on Obesity and Overweight management. Our clinical model is tech-enabled, backed by the best science, and designed to deliver exceptional health outcomes that transform a child's trajectory.

Our co-founders and leadership team have deep commitment to clinical excellence and domain expertise in healthcare. Our CEO, Christina LaMontagne, has led two startups and earned her MBA at Harvard Business School. Our Chief Medical Officer,Alesandro Larrazabal, MD, trained at UCSF and Stanford. Until recently, he was a Medical Director building specialty care services at Kaiser Permanente. Earlier, he worked at IDEO.

We're backed by top VCs who have supported category-defining health-tech companies like One Medical, Hims, Spring Health, Cityblock, Honor, and Tia.

The Role

For a lot of families, food is where the hardest moments of the day happen. ADHD medications can blunt appetite, picky eating can turn dinner into a standoff, and weight conversations can leave kids feeling judged. As our Registered Dietitian, you'll help families turn those moments into progress, with care that is practical, evidence-based, and free of stigma.

You'll join a true multidisciplinary team. Our physicians, nurse practitioners, and behavioral health clinicians treat together, so your nutrition plan isn't a referral that disappears into a chart. It's part of one coordinated plan for the whole child.

This is also a chance to build. You'll help design the evidence-based programming and protocols behind our nutrition care, from 1:1 visits to virtual group programs for kids and caregivers. If you've ever wanted to design the program instead of just running it, this is that role, on a part-time schedule you set.

What You'll Do

Care for kids and families (Practice Devotion to our Families)

  • Conduct 1:1 virtual nutrition visits for children and caregivers as part of our integrated care model.

  • Lead engaging virtual group sessions that give kids and caregivers practical tools they can use at the next meal.

  • Meet families where they are, with culturally responsive, non-stigmatizing language and plans that fit real budgets, schedules, and food traditions.

Deliver safe, high-quality care (Patient Safety Always Comes First)

  • Assess growth, intake, and medication effects such as appetite suppression, and flag concerns to the care team quickly.

  • Monitor progress, adjust recommendations, and document every interaction accurately and on time.

Work as one team (Earn Trust From Everyone)

  • Partner closely with our physicians, nurse practitioners, and behavioral health clinicians on shared, whole-child care plans.

  • Be a trusted voice for families and colleagues: clear, warm, and consistent.

Build what's next (Observe, Improve and Innovate)

  • Help design evidence-based nutrition programming and group curricula, drawing on pediatric nutrition research, family-based behavioral treatment, and motivational interviewing.

  • Share what you learn from families so we can keep improving the model, and help us measure what's working.

Who You Are (Play to Win)

  • A credentialed RD. You hold an active RD or RDN credential through the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR).

  • Experienced with kids and families. You have 3+ years of clinical or community nutrition experience, ideally in pediatric or family-focused settings.

  • Skilled in weight and metabolic health. You've supported patients with obesity, overweight, or metabolic conditions, and you know how to talk about weight in ways that build trust instead of shame.

  • A confident group facilitator. You can keep a virtual room of kids or caregivers engaged, and you enjoy it.

  • Comfortable with virtual care. You use EMRs and telehealth platforms with ease and document efficiently.

  • Culturally responsive. You've worked with families from diverse backgrounds and tailor your recommendations to their culture, resources, and goals.

  • A builder at heart. You're energized by a fast-growing startup and happy to iterate on new care models.

  • Ready to serve our Medicaid families. You're enrolled in California or Texas Medicaid, or willing to enroll.

Bonus points

  • State dietitian licensure, or openness to obtaining licenses with support from Clarity Pediatrics Medical Group.

  • Spanish fluency.

Compensation, Schedule and Benefits

The pay range for this role is 40–50 per hour, depending on experience. You're paid for all time worked, including visits, group sessions, prep, and documentation.

This is a part-time, hourly W-2 role, fully remote. You choose your hours within our operating window of Monday through Friday, 2pm–8pm PT. This role is eligible for sick leave and 401k participation.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Clarity, we believe every family deserves care that sees and understands them, and that starts with the team we build. Our patients and their families come from every background, community, and walk of life, and we're at our best when our team reflects that diversity. As a female-led company, we know firsthand that different perspectives lead to better decisions, better technology, and better care for kids.

We're building a workplace where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong, and where trust is earned and extended to all. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including those whose experience doesn't match every line of this description. If this role excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. Recruitment Fraud Notice

Clarity Pediatrics will never ask candidates for payment, bank account details, or sensitive personal information such as a Social Security number during the application or interview process. We will never ask you to buy equipment or send money as a condition of employment. All communication from our team will come from an @ email address or through Ashby, and we do not make job offers over text message or chat apps alone.
