Operations Associate – HubSpot CRM, Deal Pipeline & Excel Reporting | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Time (EST)
Location: South Africa or Latin America

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized Operations Associate to keep a high-value deal pipeline accurate, structured, and consistently moving forward.

This is not a traditional finance, investment banking, or sales role. You won’t be responsible for complex financial modeling, sourcing deals, or hitting sales quotas. Instead, your focus will be on execution, HubSpot CRM management, reporting, deal coordination, and consistent follow-through.

You’ll own the operational details behind long, 6–12 month deal cycles, ensuring every opportunity, follow-up, next step, meeting, and task is properly tracked and completed.

If you’re experienced with HubSpot, comfortable with Excel, and naturally make sure nothing falls through the cracks, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Deal Pipeline & HubSpot Management – 50%

  • Own and maintain the deal pipeline within HubSpot CRM
  • Track:
    • Inbound interest
    • Responses
    • Follow-ups
    • Deal stages
    • Next steps
  • Manage consistent follow-up across 6–12 month deal cycles
  • Keep CRM records accurate, complete, and current
  • Maintain clean:
    • Notes
    • Tasks
    • Deal stages
    • Follow-up dates
    • Next actions
  • Flag urgent, stalled, or unattended opportunities for leadership
  • Ensure no deal or important communication is overlooked
  • Monitor overdue tasks and outstanding actions
  • Keep leadership informed of priorities and next steps
  • Maintain reliable pipeline visibility at all times

Deal Execution & Operations Support – 50%

  • Maintain and update Excel and Google Sheets deal trackers
  • Organize raw information into clear:
    • Summaries
    • Reports
    • Graphs
    • Visuals
  • Support the preparation and organization of:
    • Pitch materials
    • Client-facing documents
    • Internal deal materials
  • Coordinate meetings, calendars, and deal-related calls
  • Track action items and ensure timely completion
  • Organize deal information so it is easily accessible to leadership
  • Provide administrative and operational support throughout deal execution

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including:
    • Deal tracking
    • CRM updates
    • Tasks
    • Follow-ups
    • Pipeline management
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets skills, including:
    • Formatting
    • Templates
    • Basic data handling
    • Reporting
  • Strong written English communication skills
  • Ability to independently manage professional follow-ups
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Comfortable managing repetitive follow-ups across long deal cycles
  • Strong execution discipline and reliability
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities, tasks, and deadlines simultaneously
  • Ability to work during U.S. Eastern Time (EST) business hours
  • Must be based in South Africa or Latin America

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to:
    • Finance
    • M&A
    • Investment banking
    • Deal-based environments
  • Experience supporting founders or senior executives
  • Familiarity with pitch decks and client-facing materials
  • Experience creating simple charts and data visualizations
  • Familiarity with HubSpot workflows or CRM automation
  • Experience supporting long-cycle transactions or opportunities

Tools & Technology

HubSpot | Microsoft Excel | Google Sheets | Calendar & Scheduling Tools | Internal Deal Tracking Systems

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are exceptionally organized and detail-oriented
  • Follow through without needing repeated reminders
  • Are comfortable managing high-volume, repetitive follow-ups
  • Notice when deals, tasks, or communications are becoming stale
  • Enjoy maintaining clean systems and structured processes
  • Communicate professionally and clearly in writing
  • Are dependable with recurring operational work
  • Proactively flag issues instead of waiting for someone else to notice them
  • Take ownership of tasks through completion
  • Understand that small operational details can have a significant impact on long-cycle deals

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You’ll start by reviewing HubSpot for new activity, overdue tasks, outstanding follow-ups, and deals requiring attention.

Throughout the day, you’ll send professional follow-ups, update deal stages and notes, maintain Excel and Google Sheets trackers, coordinate meetings, organize deal information, and prepare reports or materials for leadership.

You’ll also regularly review the pipeline for opportunities that have stalled and proactively ensure the appropriate next step happens.

In short: you keep the deal pipeline clean, organized, and moving so leadership never has to chase updates or wonder what happens next.

Key Metrics for Success

  • CRM data accuracy and completeness
  • Percentage of follow-ups completed on time
  • Number of overdue or missed tasks
  • Deal pipeline accuracy
  • Reporting accuracy and timeliness
  • Reduction in stale or unattended opportunities
  • Accuracy of Excel and Google Sheets trackers
  • Smooth meeting and deal coordination
  • Leadership confidence in pipeline visibility and operational execution

Why This Role Stands Out

  • No sales quotas or sourcing targets
  • No complex financial modeling
  • Clear, structured responsibilities and measurable outcomes
  • High ownership of a valuable deal pipeline
  • Direct exposure to leadership and high-value transactions
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot and deal operations
  • Fully remote opportunity for candidates in South Africa and Latin America
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Deal Operations
    • CRM Operations
    • Business Operations
    • Executive Operations
    • M&A / Transaction Support

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re highly organized, experienced with HubSpot CRM, comfortable working in Excel and Google Sheets, and relentless about following through until every task is complete, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and become the operational engine that keeps high-value deals organized, accurately tracked, and consistently moving forward.

Location:Canada

Work model:Remote

Expected compensation: Base salary starting at $90,000 CAD per annum

Vacancy status:This posting is for an existing vacancy.

About AudienceView

AudienceView is passionate about helping live event organizations bring people together through unforgettable experiences. Our unified event commerce platform helps organizations better understand, engage, and grow their audiences while creating stronger relationships and more connected experiences across the entire event journey.

We support organizations across performing arts, music, athletics, higher education, fairs, festivals, attractions, and more. By combining technology, audience intelligence, and deep industry expertise, AudienceView helps organizations make informed decisions, simplify operations, and build sustainable growth.

Four core values set the tempo for how we work:

  • We are people first.
  • We are innovative.
  • We are results-driven.
  • We are transparent.

AudienceView is made up of people who believe wholeheartedly in the power and magic of live events. Come transform live entertainment with us.

Why we'd want to work with you

We are looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to own and scale our B2B demand generation engine. In this role, you will drive pipeline growth and lower customer acquisition costs (CAC) by orchestrating high-impact paid campaigns, targeted ABM programs, and sophisticated marketing automation workflows. If you are a data-driven marketer who loves connecting the dots between paid media, email nurtures, and sales execution, we want to talk to you.

What you'll do:

  • Paid Search & Paid Ads: Own Google Ads and LinkedIn campaigns end-to-end—including strategy, budgeting, bidding, keyword research, audience building, and creative testing—to drive pipeline and optimize CAC. Expand into review platforms (G2, Capterra) where it makes strategic sense.
  • Email Marketing & Nurture:Design and execute email programs in Pardot, focusing on precise segmentation, multi-touch nurture tracks, trigger-based sends, and lifecycle campaigns tailored to key buyer personas.
  • Account-Based Marketing (ABM): Own the tooling, account scoring, and 1-to-many ABM framework. Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations to build tiered target account lists and deliver personalized, programmatic campaigns.
  • Marketing Automation & CRO: Build, maintain, and troubleshoot workflows, lead scoring models, and routing rules to ensure leads reach Sales quickly and accurately. Improve website conversion rates through landing pages, form optimization, and CRO experiments.
  • Reporting & Attribution: Track performance across paid, email, ABM, and automation. Report on spend, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and CAC by channel to guide data-driven budget allocation.
  • Test & Optimize: Continually run experiments across channels, messaging, and funnel paths to scale what works and cut what doesn't.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales, BDRs, RevOps, and Product Marketing to ensure airtight alignment on targeting, messaging, and lead handoffs.

What you'll need:

  • 4+ years of B2B digital demand generation experience, with a proven track record of scaling inbound pipeline.
  • Paid Media Expertise: Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads with a focus on efficiency (CAC) and revenue generation.
  • Marketing Automation:Strong command of Pardot (or similar enterprise automation tools), email compliance, segmentation, and lead-scoring frameworks.
  • Technical Stack:Proficiency with Salesforce, Google Analytics / GA4, and WordPress (or equivalent CMS).
  • Analytical Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving skills with a deep understanding of marketing attribution models and funnel metrics.
  • Project Management: Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Marketing and Sales teams.
  • Mindset: A curious, self-starting operator who thrives in a fast-paced environment and loves continuous learning.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • High-Intent MQLs:Volume and lead quality by channel and segment.
  • Marketing-Generated Pipeline: Total opportunity value created.
  • Pipeline Velocity & Conversion Rates:Website, funnel, nurture, and trial-to-paid conversion performance.
  • Engagement & Progression:Email engagement metrics and target account movement through the ABM funnel.

Few people tick every box on a list like this. If most of it sounds like you and the rest sounds like something you'd love to learn, we still want to hear from you.

Why work at AudienceView

  • Our work helps bring live experiences to life.From Broadway tours and symphony performances to music festivals, museums, universities, attractions, and community events, our software helps organizations of all sizes connect people with unforgettable experiences every day.
  • We're fans, not just vendors. Our teams include former box office staff, front-of-house crew, local musicians, season ticket holders, arts advocates, and lifelong eventgoers. That shared passion for live experiences is at the heart of everything we do.
  • You'll solve meaningful challenges at scale.Supporting over 2800 organizations and millions of ticket buyers means working on complex, rewarding problems. Whether it's powering major on-sales, improving the patron experience, or helping clients grow their audiences, you'll see the impact of your work firsthand.
  • We're remote-first with a live-events heart.Work alongside globally based colleagues who share a genuine passion for the arts, culture, sports, entertainment, and live experiences that bring people together.
  • Diversity and inclusion are paramount to building our culture.The data is abundantly clear that diverse teams are more successful because they offer different perspectives, increased innovation, faster problem-solving and higher employee engagement among other benefits.

How we hire — our run of show

No black holes and no endless rounds. Here's the run of show, so you know exactly what's coming and when:

  • Screening & Resume Review: Our Talent Acquisition team will evaluate all resumes and select candidates for a video screening call for 30 minutes.
  • Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes): Meet with the hiring manager to speak in detail about your relevant experience and learn more about the role.
  • Meet More of the Team (60 minutes):Meet more team members to learn more about the work culture and expectations.
  • Case Study Interview (45 minutes):Meet with the hiring manager again to complete a quick case study.

Every interview is held face to face over Microsoft Teams with a member of our team on camera. If we interview you, we will tell you whether a hiring decision has been made for this role within 45 days of your last interview.

How we use artificial intelligence in hiring

We use AI in one place only. Our hiring team may use Microsoft Copilot to transcribe interviews and draft interview notes, so that interviewers can concentrate on the conversation instead of typing. You will always know before any recording or AI note-taking begins, and you can ask us to take notes manually instead — it will not affect your application.

We do not use AI to screen, assess, rank or select applicants, and no automated system makes a hiring decision at any stage. Every shortlisting, interview and offer decision is made by people on our hiring team.

Equal opportunity, inclusion and accessibility

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at AudienceView. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our clients, the communities where we operate, and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified people of every background.

We are committed to an accessible hiring process and provide accommodations and adjustments to applicants with disabilities on request, at every stage of recruitment and employment.

How to spot a genuine AudienceView offer

AudienceView does not offer employment to anyone without first ensuring that qualified candidates speak directly with a member of the hiring team. All qualifying conversations take place face to face over Microsoft Teams. We do not make offers of employment without meeting candidates, we never make an offer by text message, and we never ask candidates to pay a fee. If you are asked for personal or financial information by text, or before you have met a member of our hiring team, please disregard it.

Ready to join the show?

If this role sounds like your kind of show and your experience lines up with what we’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you. We’re grateful for every application we receive; however, only qualified candidates selected to move forward in our hiring process will be contacted.

jobs.title: AI-First Software Developer - Softeon
jobs.excerpt: Ship more of what customers need, faster, and prove every change works.
jobs.description:
Ship more of what customers need, faster, and prove every change works.

Our applications run the warehouses that get orders out the door on time. We are changing how that software gets built: AI agents and AI-assisted CI/CD help us deliver more functionality to our customers, faster, with higher quality.

We are looking for an AI-first developer: someone who treats AI agents as a team to direct, not a fancy autocomplete. You will pair deep Java engineering with hands-on experience building through agents to deliver great new functionality across our applications, and you will help set the standard for how the rest of engineering works this way. You know that speed only counts if it comes with proof, so automated testing, validation and agent-assisted review are part of how you ship every change.

What you will do

  • Deliver great product functionality. Design and build new features and enhancements across our Java applications (receiving, inventory, picking, replenishment, shipping, integrations and user experience) that customers value and rely on.
  • Build with agents every day. Use Claude Code and similar coding agents to plan, implement, refactor and test features. Break work into clear specs, give agents strong context, and know when to delegate and when to step in.
  • Author and maintain agent skills. Write and refine skills, prompts, tool definitions and MCP servers that encode Softeon's domain knowledge, such as Elastic UI form and flow authoring, WMS configuration and integration patterns.
  • Own a fully automated delivery pipeline. Build and run CI/CD where every change passes automated builds, unit and integration tests, static analysis, security scanning and AI agent code review before a human approves it.
  • Make quality provable. Build and extend automated validation (unit, API and Playwright end-to-end tests) so that AI-generated code, configuration and integrations are verified automatically, with evidence.
  • Operate what you ship. Build the telemetry, logging and monitoring your features need, and treat performance and reliability as product requirements rather than a late pass.
  • Modernize with confidence. Use agents to understand, refactor and modernize existing code, add missing test coverage, and pay down technical debt without slowing feature delivery.
  • Measure velocity and quality. Track cycle time, defect rates and escaped bugs, and use the data to keep improving how agents and pipelines are used.
  • Work with product and customers. Turn real warehouse and supply chain needs into well-specified, testable software, and talk with product managers, customers and Ops teams in their language.
  • Raise the bar for the team. Share patterns, review others' agent workflows, measure what works, and help colleagues become effective AI-first developers.

Why it is interesting

  • Agents can write code faster than any team can review it. The hard part is no longer typing; it is deciding what to build, giving agents the right context, and proving that what comes back is correct in a domain where a plausible answer can still stop a warehouse. That means designing the specs, skills, tests and pipeline gates that let a small team ship enterprise software at a pace that used to need a much larger one, and there is no settled playbook to copy.
  • You will do this on mature, mission-critical applications with real customers, real data and real operational stakes, which is a harder and more rewarding problem than a greenfield demo.

Frameworks and tools you will work with:

Languages & core

  • Java 17+, Spring / Spring Boot, REST and messaging APIs, SQL and relational databases

Front end

  • TypeScript, Angular, and Elastic UI, our metadata-driven UI platform (XSLT forms and flows rendered as JSON schema)

Scripting & extension

  • Groovy scripts and connectors, extension APIs and scaffolding for customer and partner modifications

AI & agents

  • Claude Code and other coding agents, agent skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, LLM APIs, evaluation of agent output

Quality

  • JUnit, API and integration testing, Playwright end-to-end tests, test data and fixtures, mutation testing

Delivery & DevSecOps

  • GitHub and GitHub Actions (or Jenkins / Azure DevOps), automated agent code review, static analysis, security scanning, SBOM, Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code

Operations

  • Logging, telemetry, monitoring and observability tooling across cloud environments

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on AI and agent-based development: building production software with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agents or similar, and/or building LLM-powered features and agents (tool use, retrieval, MCP, evaluation).
  • Expert-level Java: modern Java (17+), Spring/Spring Boot, REST APIs, multithreading, performance tuning and clean, maintainable design.
  • 5+ years of professional software development, with a track record of building, shipping and operating production systems.
  • Strong experience in supply chain, automation, MRP or ERP systems. You understand how orders, inventory, materials and fulfillment flow through enterprise systems, and you can spot an answer that looks plausible but is operationally wrong.
  • CI/CD and DevOps fluency: Git-based workflows, pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps or similar), containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code.
  • Automated testing, observability and continuous delivery as part of how you build, not a separate phase.
  • Prompt and context engineering skills: clear written specs, structured prompts and the judgment to evaluate and correct agent output.
  • Comfortable across the boundary: you can write the front-end, service and database code a feature needs end to end.
  • Solid fundamentals in relational databases and SQL, system design, and secure coding practices.
  • Permanent resident of the United States, legally authorized to work in the US without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.

Also valuable

  • A platform where behavior is configured through data or metadata rather than written in code, such as low-code, rules engines or schema-driven UI.
  • Modern TypeScript and Angular (or React), including component architecture and design-system work.
  • Direct experience with warehouse management (WMS), warehouse execution (WES), transportation management (TMS) or MRP/ERP platforms, as a developer, implementer or operator.
  • Experience with warehouse automation: conveyors, sortation, pick-to-light, AMRs, goods-to-person systems or their control software.
  • Mobile or progressive web applications, including RF/handheld devices, offline behavior and poor connectivity.
  • Experience building MCP servers, custom agent tooling or AI-powered developer workflows.
  • Familiarity with XSLT and Groovy, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP).
  • Based in the US Eastern or Central time zone.

How we work

  • AI-first by default. Agents are part of the team; you are responsible for their output.
  • No change ships without proof. Automated tests, agent review and validation evidence on every pull request.
  • Close to customers. We learn from warehouse floors and Ops leaders, not just tickets.
  • Small, senior and fast. High ownership, low ceremony, measurable results.

What success looks like

  • First 30 days: you ship production changes through the full agent-assisted pipeline and know our Java platform and WMS domain.
  • First 90 days: you own a feature area end to end, have contributed new agent skills or pipeline checks, and have measurably sped up delivery without lowering quality.
  • First year: you have delivered significant product functionality and are a go-to person for AI-first engineering practices across Softeon engineering.

Location and eligibility

This is a remote, US-based role. Candidates must be permanent residents of the United States. We prefer candidates in the Eastern or Central time zones to support collaboration with our teams and customers. Occasional travel to customer sites or company offices may be required.

Overview

DecisionPoint Corporation is seeking a Senior Systems Architect to lead the architecture, integration, implementation, and sustainment of mission-critical Department of Defense (DoD)/Department of War (DoW) enterprise systems operating within secure AWS GovCloud environments. The Senior Systems Architect will serve as the technical authority responsible for defining system architecture, infrastructure strategy, cloud engineering standards, and integration approaches supporting highly sensitive data and operational workloads within Impact Level 4 (IL4) and Impact Level 5 (IL5) environments. This role provides technical leadership across platform operations, infrastructure modernization, DevSecOps, configuration management, and release management activities while ensuring compliance with DoD cybersecurity and interoperability standards. The successful candidate will work directly with government customers, senior stakeholders, engineering teams, and program leadership to translate mission requirements into secure, scalable, and resilient technical solutions supporting critical defense operations. The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect who combines DoD mission experience, AWS GovCloud expertise, enterprise architecture knowledge (DoDAF/TOGAF), and strong customer-facing leadership skills. This individual can effectively bridge strategy, architecture, engineering, and operations while leading the evolution of secure, mission-critical defense systems.

This position is fully remote.

  • Establish architecture standards, technology roadmaps, and engineering best practices supporting secure, scalable, and resilient operations.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical design sessions, and stakeholder engagements with government customers and executive leadership.

  • Ensure compliance with DoD cybersecurity requirements, Zero Trust principles, and cloud security standards.
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks related to architecture, performance, security, data management, and system integration.
  • Mentor technical staff and provide leadership across multidisciplinary engineering and operations teams.
  • Effectively communicate complex technical concepts, recommendations, and architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Education
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
Experience
  • 10+ years of experience in systems architecture, enterprise architecture, solution architecture, or systems engineering supporting federal or DoD environments.

  • Experience supporting mission-critical operational systems handling sensitive or regulated data.

jobs.excerpt: About the roleEvery project needs the right linguists at the right time, and you'll make sure it has them.
jobs.description:
About the role

Every project needs the right linguists at the right time, and you'll make sure it has them. As Resource Coordinator, you'll find the right linguists for projects on our platform, assign their tasks, and follow up so work is delivered on time, within budget, and at the quality our customers expect. You'll report to our Production Manager, be the day-to-day contact for our linguists, and help keep our linguist pools up to date and our community happy. You'll do well here if you're organized, stay calm when priorities change, and like to keep developing your skills.

What you'll do

  • Find the right linguists for running tasks on our platform, assign post-editors, revisers, and other linguists to specific tasks, and follow up on their progress.
  • Decide on and set priorities for ongoing tasks, so projects meet their deadlines, stay within cost, and meet quality expectations.
  • Communicate with linguists and make sure they have everything they need to work on their tasks.
  • Work with the Production Manager to make sure quality expectations are met, linguist pools have enough people to meet deadlines, and all pools stay up to date, and give them daily feedback.
  • Monitor how satisfied our linguist community is.

What you'll bring

  • typically 2+ years of progressive experience in resourcing, project management, or linguistic work, or equivalent experience
  • higher education, ideally at postgraduate level
  • excellent written and spoken English, and good knowledge of Microsoft Office
  • strong organization and attention to detail, delivering reports, replies, and results on time, adapting when circumstances change, and staying in control under pressure
  • good analytical and communication skills, including quickly understanding the core of a complex problem and the details that lead to a solution

Nice to have

  • a degree in languages or linguistics
  • advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • a second foreign language

If you have some of these, great. If you don't, we'd still like to hear from you.

Who we are

At Acclaro, we're more than a localization company — we're a content intelligence solutions company, and a global team of language enthusiasts, cultural connectors, and technology innovators. Our mission is to help brands speak the world's languages and resonate deeply across cultures by blending human expertise with cutting-edge technology, delivered through a follow-the-sun model that keeps our teams moving around the clock and around the globe.

With over two decades of experience, we support some of the world's most recognizable brands in expanding their global reach. And we're scaling: we've been making material investments in our own AI-native platform, one that's already reshaping how our business — and the localization industry more broadly — works. Join us on our journey to be the model localization company of the next decade, one that's loved by clients, colleagues, and communities alike.

How we work

Our values shape how we work with customers, colleagues, and partners. Here's what you can expect from us, and what we'll look for in you.

  • Be Accountable. We own our work, learn from our mistakes, and come with solutions.
  • Be Proud. We care about the work, hold a high standard, and celebrate each other's wins.
  • Be Resilient. When things get hard, we stay calm, adapt, and ask for help when we need it.
  • Be Curious. We ask why, keep learning, share what we know, and explore new ways of working, including AI.
  • Be Kind. We assume good intent, give honest feedback with care, and look out for each other.

Pay

Pay range: $21,000,000 - $23,000,000 gross per year base salary, depending on experience.

Inclusion and equal opportunity

Acclaro is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

We assess every candidate against the same criteria. If you need a reasonable accommodation to take part in any stage of our hiring process, let your recruiter know. We'll work with you to find a solution and keep what you share confidential.

You'll design and execute end-to-end robotics experiments, leveraging real-world data, simulation, and human-in-the-loop systems to evaluate and improve robot performance.

Responsibilities

Peraton is hiring an experienced Open Science Professional/Scientist to support the CDC OSQLS Knowledge Management (KM) Team in advancing Open Science, public access, research transparency, and reproducibility across the agency. The CDC OSQLS KM Team supports systems and services for electronic scientific clearance, public access, content management, document routing, research compliance, and scientific publishing across CDC Centers, Institutes, and Offices (CIOs). The team also supports the CDC Stacks public repository and internal systems that facilitate scientific research and publishing.

As CDC expands its Open Science practices, the selected candidate will help researchers develop transparent and reproducible research packages, improve KM systems and workflows, and develop training and guidance to support Open Science implementation across CDC.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Develop and co-author Open Science training materials, guidelines, and implementation resources.
  • Propose enhancements to KM systems and tools that strengthen Open Science practices.
  • Develop and recommend Open Science workflows supporting research transparency, reproducibility, and compliance.
  • Work directly with CDC researchers to integrate Open Science principles into research workflows.
  • Liaise with CDC Centers, Institutes, and Offices (CIOs) to provide Open Science outreach, instruction, and research support.
  • Provide reference and research support to researchers seeking guidance on Open Science implementation.
  • Collaborate with CDC scientific leadership and CIO staff to implement Open Science practices.
  • Participate, as appropriate, in CDC and federal Open Science committees and working groups.
  • Adapt activities and deliverables as CDC Open Science policies, practices, and implementation priorities evolve.

Qualifications

Basic Requirements:

  • 5 years with BS/BA; 3 years with MS/MA; 0 years with PhD
  • Knowledge of Open Science policies, guidelines, and practices, including U.S. Public Access policies, the Gold Standard Science memorandum, and Open Data policy and law.
  • Experience with Open Science tools such as DMPTool, Open Science Framework (OSF), GitHub, repository platforms, and data documentation tools.
  • Excellent communication, training, and documentation skills.

The successful candidate will combine strong commercial, financial, and operational judgment with technical proficiency in CRM/ERP systems, data analytics, and business process design. This position requires the ability to independently lead complex initiatives, evaluate business performance, develop actionable recommendations, and bridge the gap between commercial strategy, technical execution, and operating results.

Partner with technical and functional teams to implement solutions, improve data integrity, reconcile CRM/ERP information, and standardize reporting and process controls.

  • Change Management & Adoption: Drive implementation readiness, stakeholder communication, process documentation, training, and adoption measurement to embed new commercial capabilities into daily operations.
  • Executive Decision Support: Develop business cases, financial analyses, executive presentations, and actionable recommendations supporting commercial strategy, investment prioritization, and continuous improvement.

jobs.description:
POSITION DESCRIPTION

THE PEW CHARITABLE TRUSTS

Senior Officer, Conserving the Pantanal and Gran Chaco Wildlands

(Protected Area Management and Conservation Finance)

The Environment Portfolio at The Pew Charitable Trusts

For more than 30 years, Pew has been a major force in engaging the public and policy makers about the causes, consequences, and solutions to some of the world’s most pressing environmental challenges. Our environment work spans all seven continents with more than 250 professionals working at the local, national, and international levels to reduce the scope and severity of global environmental problems, such as the erosion of large natural ecosystems that contain a great part of the world’s remaining biodiversity, and the destruction of the marine environment. Pew’s global environmental program focuses on science-based, nonpartisan, and sustainable solutions to help protect the planet and people. We work in partnership with governments, Indigenous rights holders, intergovernmental organizations, non-governmental organizations, local stakeholders, scientists, and other researchers to advance public policy so that nature and communities can thrive.

Since 1990, Pew has worked in North America, South America and Australia to protect large and critically important terrestrial ecosystems, including rivers and other freshwater resources, coastal temperate rainforests, interior mountain ranges, the northern boreal forests, Australia’s Outback, and Chilean Patagonia. We work to ensure these natural systems remain bountiful, functioning, and resilient, providing essential ecological services such as clean air and clean water, sustenance and food security for local communities and more broadly for the welfare of current and future generations. Our work relies on the sciences of conservation, sociology, biology, and economics to advocate for practical and durable solutions to the loss of biodiversity.

In the sea, reforms to how our oceans are managed are essential to address overfishing, pollution, and loss of habitat. Pew began its oceans program in the United States, focusing on ending overfishing and protecting fragile marine habitat. Starting in 2005, Pew’s ocean conservation program expanded around the world and played a significant role in reforming marine fisheries management in the European Union and on the high seas and creating large scale marine reserves around the world. Our work is grounded in the best available science and pursues domestic and international conservation measures that are long-term and provide permanent, durable protections for marine ecosystems. We also work to address systemic threats to the ocean, including from plastics, over-and-illegal fishing, seabed mining, and climate change.

Conserving the Pantanal and Gran Chaco Wildlands

South America’s Pantanal and Gran Chaco regions are among the most ecologically significant tropical wetlands and dry forests on Earth. This area spans parts of Brazil, Bolivia, Paraguay, and Argentina and contains thousands of plant and animal species and provides vital aquatic habitat, nutrient renewal, migration routes, and flood control for millions of animals and people living downstream. The region’s extensive ecosystems are currently threatened by deforestation, drought and intensification of wildfires related to climate change, and thus urgently need conservation action.

The project works with the policy framework in each country to solidify and expand protection of the extraordinary biodiversity of the Pantanal-Gran Chaco region. Pew partners with local and international conservation organizations, government agencies, and Indigenous governments and organizations to improve management of and expand protected areas, support Indigenous organizations and communities in the management of their territories, promote sustainable management for ranching lands, and to advance long-term conservation financing mechanisms for durable protections.

Position Overview

Reporting to the Project Director, Conserving the Pantanal and Gran Chaco Wildlands, the Senior Officer will lead efforts to develop long-term financing and improve the management of protected and conserved areas in the Pantanal-Gran Chaco landscape.

The Senior Officer will focus on identifying and pursuing finance, conservation, community development, and fundraising goals that support improved management of protected and conserved lands in the region. This will include collaboration with consultants, partners, government officials and other key stakeholders, as well as facilitating the project’s engagement in public policy and advocacy related to conservation finance and improved management. This position requires demonstrated leadership in public or private sector organizations focused on promoting sustainability and conservation.

The Senior Officer will be located either in Santa Cruz, Bolivia; or elsewhere within the South America region following evaluation by Pew.

Responsibilities for the Pantanal-Gran Chaco Project:

  • Foster a work environment that inspires excellence, values impact, encourages transparency, builds mutual trust and respect, embraces and values diversity, and is collaborative, caring and compassionate. Under the Project Director’s leadership, manage aspects of Pew’s Pantanal-Gran Chaco initiative related to improving the management of the region’s protected and conserved areas. This includes organizing and coordinating high-level meetings, commissioning and conducting research, and managing strategic partnerships.
  • In collaboration with relevant Pew staff and senior management, assess opportunities to expand or develop new financing strategies for protected and conserved areas in Bolivia, Brazil, and Argentina.
  • Coordinate the development of priority financing initiatives in collaboration with Pew’s Pantanal and Gran Chaco team, consultants, and in-country partners.
  • Provide technical guidance to Pew’s Pantanal and Gran Chaco team on financing frameworks, sustainable financing mechanisms, public resource allocation, and effective management.
  • Support the Project Director in establishing and cultivating strategic alliances and launching joint initiatives with international organizations, foundations, non-governmental organizations (NGOs), government agencies, Indigenous organizations, and other institutions in the region.
  • Promote best practices and innovations in protected area management and conservation in the Pantanal Gran-Chaco through public policy engagements and outreach efforts.
  • Prepare regular updates for senior management and other audiences summarizing the initiative’s efforts and achievements toward financial sustainability of the region’s protected and conserved lands.
  • Lead analysis and research within the framework of the Pantanal and Gran Chaco strategy to gather scientific, policy, and technical information on protected area conservation lands finances and management in Latin America.
  • Represent Pew in external events online and in person, including meetings with national and local governments, multilateral organizations, and other institutions.
  • Participate in activities that support program and Pew-wide objectives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required; advanced degree in public policy, economics, business, natural resources management or related studies preferred.
  • Generally, a minimum of 10 years
  • Fluency in both English and Spanish is required, competence in Portuguese is desired.
  • Significant experience in project management, financial mechanisms, and government engagement.
  • Experience working with local and regional governments.
  • Experience in the management of protected areas or other forms of conservation lands, including development of management plans, monitoring systems, and staff training programs.
  • Acute political awareness and understanding of issues from a non-partisan perspective.
  • Demonstrated experience building relationships across individuals and organizations with a range of interests and perspectives.
  • Capacity to lead group discussions with individuals working in different roles and countries; skilled in training and guiding team members with a high degree of cultural sensitivity.
  • Demonstrated experience meeting deadlines and effectively developing and moving projects forward with a high degree of independence and autonomy.
  • Effective professional writing skills in both English and Spanish. Effectively communicates ideas, thoughts and concepts clearly and concisely and in a compelling way, both written and orally.

Travel
Travel up to 25% of the time to cities and remote locations in Bolivia, Brazil, Argentina and throughout Latin America, and to the United States as necessary.


Work Authorization

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country for which they are seeking employment without visa sponsorship.

Salary Range

The salary range represents a reasonable estimate of the annual salary based on Pew’s commitment to provide equitable and market-competitive pay. The actual salary offered will take into consideration many factors including but not limited to job-related knowledge, skills and experience, internal pay equity, and business need.

Total Rewards

This position offers a competitive salary and benefit program.

Ameresco, Inc. (NYSE: AMRC) is a leading energy infrastructure company delivering integrated solutions that provide reliable power and modernize infrastructure. Since 2000, we have served as a trusted partner to public and private sector customers across North America, the UK and Europe, delivering over $15 billion in solutions and contracting more than 5 GW of energy resources.

Ameresco currently has an opening for a Senior Project Engineer to join our Military Housing (MHPI) team to develop and implement energy efficiency, geothermal, solar PV, controls, and distributed energy projects across privatized military family housing portfolios. This is a remote U.S. position with occasional travel to installations and partner offices.


The Senior Project Engineer supports proposal, development, design, construction, commissioning, and operations of energy and infrastructure projects serving MHPI partners and military housing communities. The role bridges engineering, project management, and customer/partner coordination so projects meet guaranteed performance, schedule, budget, code, and resident-impact requirements.


Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate visits to military housing project sites to investigate and gather energy performance data for existing mechanical, electrical, HVAC, geothermal, plumbing, and control systems.
  • Perform utility and energy analysis, residential building load calculations, and preliminary engineering assessments to support project development and evaluation of potential solutions.
  • Identify opportunities for energy efficiency upgrades and distributed energy resources, including ground-source heat pumps (GSHP), water-source heat pumps (WSHP), solar PV, battery energy storage, building automation / EMS, lighting, envelope, and central plant improvements.
  • Develop preliminary and refined cost estimates covering engineering, equipment, construction, project management, commissioning, operations, and maintenance.
  • Support conceptual and detailed engineering design and coordinate with engineering/design subcontractors to develop complete, coordinated, and timely design documentation, including narrative scopes of work, drawings, specifications, and design-criteria packages.
  • Support evaluation of construction subcontractor bids and equipment vendor proposals to select best value based on performance, pricing, schedule, warranty, and compliance, including domestic content / ITC considerations where applicable.
  • Prepare written technical content for proposals, Investment Grade Audits (IGA), design narratives, progress reports, and customer/partner briefings.
  • Develop approaches for project commissioning (Cx) and measurement and verification (M&V) of energy savings in collaboration with Ameresco Cx, controls, and operations staff.
  • Ensure project scopes achieve guaranteed energy and performance metrics, meet partner and installation requirements, and comply with applicable industry standards, UFC/UFGS where relevant, codes, and MHPI contract obligations.
  • Provide engineering support through all project phases: proposal, development, design, construction, commissioning, and operations / O&M.
  • Work with the site or portfolio Project Manager on ongoing communication and coordination with MHPI partners (property managers / owners), installation stakeholders, utilities, and subcontractors, including status updates and remedies for delays or field issues.
  • Provide engineering support during construction to address field issues, support quality control, verify installation in accordance with design documents, and facilitate on-time, on-budget delivery in occupied housing environments.
  • Support controls, EMS, and MBCx platform integration for GSHP and other HVAC systems, including points lists, sequences, trending, alarming, and Yardi or other property-management interfaces where used.
  • Present reports defining project progress, problems, and recommended solutions to internal leadership and external partners.
  • Evaluate project results against energy, comfort, reliability, and financial targets and support project changes or interventions required to achieve contracted outputs.
  • Travel as required.
  • Perform other duties as required.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in an engineering discipline from a four-year accredited college or university.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.
  • Minimum 5 years of prior experience in an engineering or project development role.
  • Ability to review confidential US security information.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience working on energy savings performance contracts (ESPC), utility energy service contracts (UESC), or similar guaranteed-savings / performance-contracting structures preferred.
  • Direct experience with military family housing, MHPI partners, or other large multifamily / privatized housing portfolios preferred.
  • Experience with geothermal wellfields, indoor hydronic loops, heat-pump selection, and multifamily load diversity (interior vs. end units) preferred.
  • Demonstrated understanding of engineering principles associated with energy efficiency and renewable energy technologies, including HVAC, building automation / EMS, building envelope, solar PV, battery energy storage, cogeneration/microgrids, power systems, and water/steam or hydronic distribution preferred.
  • Knowledge of measurement and verification (M&V) procedures (IPMVP or equivalent) preferred.

  • Certification or progress toward Certified Energy Manager (CEM); CxA or similar commissioning credential preferred.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including technical presentations to partners and internal leadership.
  • Valid driver’s license issued by state of residence and in good standing.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Data Architect – PBM Data Modernization

Location: Remote (US Only) Industry:Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM)Platform:Google Cloud Platform

Role Overview

We're looking for a Data Architect to lead data modeling and source-to-target mapping for a Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) modernization program on Google Cloud. The role covers migrating legacy claims and eligibility data, and the IBM Cognos reporting built on it, into a new BigQuery-based enterprise data warehouse. It also ensures the future-state platform meets state-specific Medicaid reporting requirements, starting with the MVP.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the semantic and logical data models for MVP and future-state reporting, covering pharmacy claims, member eligibility, prescriber, pharmacy network, formulary, rebates, and pricing domains.
  • Own mapping execution end to end. Define source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, and business logic from legacy structures to the new warehouse.
  • Inventory and analyze legacy IBM Cognos (Cognos Explorer / Cognos Analytics) reports, packages, and Framework Manager models. Reverse-engineer embedded business logic and calculations, and rationalize reports for redesign on the future-state platform.
  • Set mapping standards, templates, naming conventions, and documentation practices. Direct the Data and Systems Analysts and review their work for quality and consistency.
  • Lead gap analysis and drive each gap to a decision (build, defer, workaround, or descope) with business, compliance, and technical stakeholders.
  • Translate state Medicaid reporting requirements (encounter data submissions, MCO/PBM transparency reports, spread pricing and pass-through disclosures, T-MSIS-aligned extracts) into data model and mapping specifications.
  • Define data quality rules, reconciliation checkpoints, and lineage so legacy-to-target results, including Cognos report outputs, are traceable and audit-ready.
Work with data engineers on ingestion and transformation design on GCP, and use Vertex AI and Gemini to speed up mapping, profiling, and documentation.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in data architecture or data modeling, with at least 3 years in PBM, pharmacy, or health plan data.
  • Hands-on experience with NCPDP claim standards, Medicaid and managed care reporting, and legacy migration programs.
  • Strong skills in dimensional and semantic modeling, plus advanced SQL.
  • Experience with IBM Cognos Analytics / Cognos Explorer, including Framework Manager packages, report specifications, and migrating Cognos reporting to a modern BI platform.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud data services:
  • BigQuery for warehouse design, including partitioning, clustering, and authorized views
  • Dataflow and Dataproc for transformation pipelines
  • Cloud Composer (Airflow) for orchestration

–Cloud Storage for landing zones

  • Dataform or dbt for SQL-based transformations
  • Familiarity with Dataplex and Data Catalog for metadata, lineage, and data quality, and with Looker (LookML) for building the semantic layer.
  • Proven experience leading analyst teams and running mapping governance.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA, CMS regulations, and state-level Medicaid compliance, along with GCP security controls (IAM, VPC Service Controls, CMEK).
  • Location & Work Authorization: Must currently reside in the United States and hold valid US work authorization without sponsorship.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Vertex AI or Gemini in BigQuery for AI-assisted mapping, profiling, and documentation.
  • Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect certification.

jobs.description:
Do you want a job with a purpose?

And do you want to make healthcare safer, better and more reliable?

Join our Team!


Begleite uns als Integration Specialist (m/w/d) / Schnittstellenintegration bei Dedalus, einem der weltweit führenden Unternehmen für Healthcare-Technologie, in Wien und leiste die beste Arbeit Deiner Karriere – mit einem nachhaltigen Beitrag für eine bessere Gesundheitsversorgung in einer gesünderen Welt.

Deine Aufgaben:


  • Implementierung von Schnittstellen überwiegend auf HL7- und FHIR-Basis zwischen ORBIS-KIS und Subsystemen
  • Selbständige Realisierung von Kundenprojekten - Installation, Test und Dokumentation
  • Persönliche Kommunikation mit Kunden, Fremdsystem-Herstellern, Entwicklung und Support

Dein Profil:


  • Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder entsprechend einschlägige Erfahrung im Fachbereich Informatik
  • Mit Windows und/oder den UNIX-/LINUX-Systemen kennst Du Dich bereits aus
  • Der Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken und SQL ist Dir vertraut
  • Krankenhausinterne Prozesse sind für dich kein Fremdwort
  • Kenntnisse der Schnittstellenkommunikation im Gesundheitswesen auf Basis von HL7 und/oder FHIR sind Voraussetzung
  • Eine ausgeprägte Kunden- und Serviceorientierung liegt Dir im Blut
  • Sehr gute Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse und eine generell hohe Reisebereitschaft runden Dein Profil ab

Wir bieten Dir:

  • Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag mit attraktivem Gehalt für eine langfristige Perspektive
  • Verantwortungsvolle und spannende Aufgaben in einer zukunftsorientierten Branche
  • Gesamte Hardware- und Softwareausstattung für ein angenehmes Arbeiten im Homeoffice
  • Ein nettes Team, das Dich gerne unterstützt und mit dem du auf „DU-Ebene“ bist
  • Aktuelles Firmenhandy mit Dual-Sim (Android oder iOS) auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Möglichkeit einer vergünstigten Jahreskarte für den Nahverkehr
  • Vergünstigungen bei Tickets für Freizeitveranstaltungen verschiedener Art
  • Gruppenunfallversicherung (auch für Unfälle in der Freizeit geltend)
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Das Mindestgehalt für diese Position beträgt lt. IT-KV Österreich 45.800,-- € brutto pro Jahr (38,5 WStd.), eine Überzahlung zzgl. Prämienregelung je nach Qualifikation/Erfahrung ist für uns selbstverständlich

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Online-Bewerbung mit Motivationsschreiben (bitte inkl. Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglichem Starttermin), Lebenslauf und Zeugnissen!


Schwerbehinderte Bewerberinnen und Bewerber werden bei gleicher Eignung besonders berücksichtigt.

Wir sind Dedalus – komm und werde Teil unseres Teams

Dedalus engagiert sich für ein motivierendes und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld, das die Leidenschaft widerspiegelt, mit der unsere Mitarbeitenden unsere Mission verfolgen: Ärzt:innen und Pflegekräfte dabei zu unterstützen, eine bessere Versorgung für ihre Gemeinschaften zu ermöglichen.

Wir fördern eine Unternehmenskultur, in der Lernen und Innovation ausdrücklich erwünscht sind. Gemeinsam verbessern wir klinische Zusammenarbeit und Prozesse und leisten einen bedeutenden Beitrag für Millionen von Menschen weltweit. Jeder Mensch ist Ausgangs- und Zielpunkt unserer Aktivitäten – und letztlich der wichtigste Nutznießer. Deshalb sind wir stolz auf das, was wir jeden Tag tun.


Unser Unternehmen wird von einer vielfältigen Gemeinschaft aus 7.600 Mitarbeitenden in mehr als 40 Ländern getragen, die gemeinsam Innovationen vorantreiben und bessere Gesundheitslösungen für Millionen von Patient:innen weltweit entwickeln. Wir sind die Menschen von Dedalus.

Bewerbungsschluss: 31.01.2027

Bei Dedalus beginnt Innovation mit Inklusion. Als Unternehmen, das von starken Werten getragen wird, wissen wir: Vielfalt und Inklusion sind entscheidende Erfolgsfaktoren für nachhaltiges Wachstum. Unsere internationale Präsenz verbindet Menschen auf der ganzen Welt. Wir setzen uns dafür ein, unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen wertzuschätzen und ein Umfeld zu schaffen, das die Vielfalt der Gemeinschaften widerspiegelt, für die wir arbeiten.


„Pursuing Diversity and Inclusion“ ist einer unserer Kernwerte und Teil unserer „Dedalus DNA“. Wir gestalten eine respektvolle, diverse und inklusive Arbeitsumgebung, indem wir die individuellen Bedürfnisse, Perspektiven und Potenziale aller anerkennen. Dedalus steht für Vielfalt, Inklusion, Chancengleichheit und Gleichberechtigung – und verpflichtet sich zu einer sicheren und wertschätzenden Kultur, in der jede und jeder sein bzw. ihr volles Potenzial entfalten kann.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionTripleTenis an award-winning online school among technology bootcamps.
jobs.description:
Description

TripleTenis an award-winning online school among technology bootcamps. Our mission is to help people change their lives and succeed in technology. We offer flexibility in studies, career mentoring, resume and portfolio preparation, and we guarantee employment after the course. Our employability rate among graduates is 87% across our Full Stack Development, Quality Assurance (QA) and Data Analytics.

We are now looking for a Customer Reputation Specialist to join our LATAM team!

This role focuses on managing, de-escalating, and resolving critical and high-friction student issues across the LATAM market. You will be responsible for handling sensitive student cases, mitigating reputational and legal risks, and negotiating effective solutions while ensuring an empathetic and positive student experience.

Your main goal will be to protect the company's reputation, prevent further escalation, and reach fair and effective resolutions for students and the business.

Please submit your updated resume or CV in English.

What you will do

As a Customer Reputation Specialist, you will be responsible for managing complex student complaints and high-risk cases, communicating directly with students, and coordinating with internal teams to achieve timely and effective resolutions.

Main responsibilities will include:

  • Case Analysis: Thoroughly investigate escalated cases, understanding the context, background, and specific circumstances of each student complaint.
  • Student Communication & De-escalation: Contact students directly through calls and written channels, build rapport, actively listen to their concerns, and de-escalate high-friction situations.
  • Conflict Resolution & Negotiation: Negotiate and mediate agreements with students, aiming to reach mutually acceptable solutions and prevent further escalation, including legal claims, formal complaints, or negative social media exposure.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential reputational, legal, and business risks and take appropriate action to minimize their impact.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Coordinate with internal teams to investigate cases, align on solutions, and ensure timely resolution in accordance with company policies.
  • Documentation & Follow-up: Maintain accurate records of case progress, agreements, communications, and outcomes, ensuring proper follow-up until resolution.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in customer service, customer retention, escalations, complaints management, or high-touch customer support roles.
  • Proven experience handling difficult customers, high-conflict situations, sensitive complaints, and complex customer escalations.
  • Experience managing sensitive cases involving potential legal action, formal complaints, legal claims, or reputational risks.
  • Familiarity with handling public customer complaints, social media escalations, and situations involving threats of negative brand exposure.
  • Outstanding active listening and communication skills, with the ability to handle sensitive and difficult conversations.
  • Exceptional empathy and emotional intelligence, combined with the ability to remain calm and professional under pressure.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Spanish.
  • Proficiency in English for written and verbal communication.
  • Experience using Slack, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, and Google Workspace.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple complex cases simultaneously.
  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and strong judgment when identifying and managing high-pressure, legal, and reputational risk situations.

What we can offer you

  • 100% remote work.
  • 600 USD gross per month + monthly bonuses based on KPI results.
  • Full-time role, Monday to Friday. Schedule from 9am to 19pm Mex time UTC -6 (1 hour for lunch)
  • A comfortable digital office. We use modern digital tools — Slack, Jira, HubSpot, Notion, etc. — to make the working together process seamless.
  • A diverse and tight-knit team, spread out across the US, LatAm, and more!

jobs.title: Account Executive, Strategic Health Partnerships
jobs.excerpt: Founded by Arianna Huffington in 2016, Thrive Global is a leading behavior change technology company with the mission to improve productivity and health outcomes – one Microstep at a time.
jobs.description:
Founded by Arianna Huffington in 2016, Thrive Global is a leading behavior change technology company with the mission to improve productivity and health outcomes – one Microstep at a time. Thrive helps individuals and organizations improve well-being, performance and mental resilience with its AI-powered behavior change technology platform. Thrive’s Microsteps – small, science-backed steps to improve health and productivity – have been adopted by employees at more than 230 organizations in over 160 countries, from frontline and call center workers to executives at multinational companies. For more information, visitwww.thriveglobal.com.

The Account Executive, Strategic Health Partnerships is a quota-carrying, fully sales-focused role responsible for winning new pharmaceutical, life sciences, and healthcare customers.Thrive Global helps pharma partners combine breakthrough medicines and Thrive’s science-backed behavior change methodology to support patients across their health journey, whether managing a disease state, participating in a clinical trial, or simply trying to increase longevity and quality of life. The role owns the sales cycle from first conversation to close, with a primary focus on new logos and additional responsibility for expansion in signed accounts.

This is a builder role. The Account Executive works opportunities from senior leadership and assigned accounts, and also generates new pipeline through their own network and market intelligence. Reporting to the VP, Sales & Partnerships, and supported by the GTM Strategy team, the Account Executive works closely with Product, Content, Legal, and Executive Leadership. After close, the Account Executive ensures a smooth and effective hand-off to Customer Success ensuring optimal customer experience.

How You'll Contribute

  • Turn opportunities from senior leadership into qualified deals, and create new pipeline through your network, outreach, and market intelligence (such as loss of exclusivity, launches, and competitive pressure).
  • Research and prioritize target companies by therapeutic area, portfolio, and market dynamics.
  • Position patient engagement, patient support, clinical trial engagement and retention, and communications solutions, along with the broader Thrive platform.
  • Build relationships across pharma prospects, from patient engagement, clinical, commercial, and direct-to-consumer site leaders up to the C-suite, and identify the economic buyer and champion early.
  • Identify and close projects and expansion opportunities in signed accounts, working alongside Customer Success.
  • Develop proposals, pilots, and commercial structures with Product, Content, and Finance, tied to outcomes such as adherence, engagement, retention, and brand trust.
  • Work with Legal and the customer’s MLR, compliance, privacy, and procurement teams through contracting and review.
  • Use AI tools to prepare account research, tailor outreach to each buyer, and keep Salesforce current, applying your own judgment and never putting patient or sensitive data into tools that aren’t approved for it.
  • Raise deal risks early with a recommended path forward, and represent Thrive at industry events and customer meetings
  • Therapeutic areas Thrive supports today include oncology, obesity, diabetes, migraine, sleep apnea, schizophrenia, women’s health, chronic pain, autoimmune conditions, cardiovascular, dermatology, and brain health.
  • Travel is expected to be approximately 25%.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience in pharma, life sciences, or health technology, with a track record of meeting or exceeding quota in long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Pharma experience is ideal, but strong health tech backgrounds are welcome.
  • A proven ability to generate your own pipeline, with an existing network in pharma, life sciences, or health tech.
  • Experience selling to senior stakeholders; C-suite experience is a plus but not required.
  • Familiarity with patient engagement, patient support, clinical trial, or direct-to-consumer functions at pharma companies.
  • Working knowledge of pharma compliance and regulatory review (such as MLR and privacy).
  • Strong research and structured-thinking skills, with the ability to turn market insight into a clear business case.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, G-Suite, and Microsoft products.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate and optimize sales processes using leading AI tools, principally Claude AI.
  • Passion for Thrive’s mission of science-backed behavior change.

✨ What We Offer:

  • 🌍 Mission-Driven Impact: Be part of a company that’s truly making a difference in people’s lives around the world.
  • 🚀 Career Growth: Develop within the company and help shape our growth strategy.
  • 💙 Human-Centric Culture: Thrive in a supportive environment with a range of wellness perks and benefits.
  • 💰 Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a comprehensive and rewarding total compensation package.
  • 🩺 Health & Financial Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage plus a 401(k) program with company match.
  • 🌴 Time to Recharge: Generous paid time-off programs designed to help you rest, reset, and recharge — including Thrive Time, a benefit unique to Thrive that gives employees additional paid time off after major projects or intense periods of work to truly recharge and recover.

Compensation:

On target total earnings for this role will likely fall in the $300,000-$400,000 range.

  • Please note: We provide a competitive mix of salary, performance bonus, and equity. The final offer amount will depend on factors like experience, expertise, and may differ from the range above. This range also excludes additional benefits, such as 401(k), and medical, dental, or vision insurance.

Thrive is deeply committed to creating a safe and welcoming work environment free of discrimination and harassment so that all employees can bring their whole selves to work.

Thrive is proud to ensure equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, genetics, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, family or parental status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Thrive is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please inform Thrive’s Recruiting team if you need any assistance completing any forms or to otherwise participate in the application process.

jobs.excerpt: About the roleACME Corporation is seeking an exceptionally driven, endlessly resourceful, and moderately indestructible Senior Roadrunner Acquisition Specialist to lead our primary wildlife pursuit initiatives within the Desert Operations Division.
jobs.description:
About the role

ACME Corporation is seeking an exceptionally driven, endlessly resourceful, and moderately indestructible Senior Roadrunner Acquisition Specialist to lead our primary wildlife pursuit initiatives within the Desert Operations Division. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, you will take full ownership of experimental mechanical systems, kinetic deployments, and strategic planning targeting a notoriously elusive Greater Roadrunner (Geococcyx californianus). This is a full-time, permanent position operated under a remote work policy in the American Southwest (preferably near a suspiciously straight stretch of highway).

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Pursuit & Target Acquisition: Develop and execute multi-phase capture strategies based on detailed behavioral tracking, dietary preferences, and apparent immunity to standard physical laws.
  • Experimental Engineering & Prototyping: Design, fabricate, and field-test custom kinetic systems incorporating rocket propulsion arrays, spring-loaded platforms, oversized magnets, giant slingshots, and gravity-assisted acceleration.
  • Ambush Architecture: Design and deploy elaborate ambushes involving tunnels, cliffs, strategically placed birdseed, unattended boxes, and two-dimensional painted landscape illusions (trompe-l'œil).
  • Failure Analysis & Rapid Iteration: Perform blameless root-cause analyses following catastrophic failures (preferably after regaining consciousness) to document lessons learned and iterate on mechanical reliability.
  • Operational Safety & Risk Management: Manage the end-to-end deployment of industrial explosives, pyrotechnics, anvils, rolling boulders, and high-tensile adhesives.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Convey complex technical concepts through detailed diagrams, expressive facial gestures, and strategically positioned handwritten signs.

Required Qualifications

  • Technical Expertise: PhD-level understanding of mechanical engineering, physics, classical mechanics, or rocketry (demonstrated genius preferred over formal credentials).
  • Relevant Experience: 10+ years in pursuit operations, experimental systems engineering, or repeated unsuccessful attempts to achieve a clearly defined objective.
  • Durability & Resilience: Extraordinary physical durability, high tolerance for blunt-force trauma, and proven ability to remain motivated following hundreds of consecutive failures.
  • Communication: Strong written communication skills (verbal communication is considered unnecessary).

What ACME Offers

  • Unlimited R&D budget: Access to an extensive catalog of experimental equipment without procurement oversight.
  • Flexible working hours: Pursue your target whenever inspiration strikes or the Roadrunner appears.
  • Antifragile culture: High autonomy, no micromanagement, unlimited recovery time, and generous performance bonuses upon successful acquisition.

jobs.excerpt: About Offprem Technology Offprem Technology is a Salesforce Summit Partner and Claude Certified firm, with consultants certified in both.
jobs.description:
About Offprem Technology

Offprem Technology is a Salesforce Summit Partner and Claude Certified firm, with consultants certified in both. We help organizations across industries implement, run, and get more from Salesforce and Claude, together or on their own, and we use Claude in our own delivery. Starting fresh or already live, our clients work with people who guide every decision.

We stay close to what Salesforce is shipping, from Agentforce and Data 360 to Marketing Cloud Next, so our recommendations reflect what the platform can do today. We build around your CRM, connecting marketing, sales, and service data so AI and automation work from a single view of the customer.

We’re headquartered in Indiana, remote friendly, and hire across the United States. Whether you’re an experienced consultant or want to deepen your expertise in Salesforce’s marketing and AI platforms, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Consultant to support a high-volume JumpStart delivery model in the small to medium business space.

If you're familiar with Salesforce JumpStarts you know that this work is limited engagement implementations focused on getting clients up and running quickly using out-of-the-box configuration, best practices, and standard functionality. No heavy customization, no complex development. Discovery, configuration, data import, user setup, and training. Clean, repeatable, time-boxed projects. Many times this kind of project is an entry point to longer term relationships, as such your client facing experience is paramount.

What you'll do:

Deliver Salesforce JumpStart implementations from kickoff through handoff. This includes requirements discovery, out-of-the-box org configuration, basic data migration, user setup and permissions, and end-user training.

Additionally, the Consultant will lead Salesforce Kickstart and rapid-delivery engagements, owning solution design, configuration, and client guidance for fixed-scope implementations across core Salesforce clouds. This role partners closely with clients to translate defined business requirements into best-practice Salesforce solutions, ensuring projects are delivered efficiently, on time, and aligned to Salesforce standards. The ideal candidate is hands-on, delivery-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple short-cycle projects concurrently.

Requirements:

  • 6-12 months of Salesforce solution design and delivery experience, preferably in a consulting or partner environment
  • Hands-on experience implementing Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud (additional clouds a plus)
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce data model, security, and standard automation tools (Flows, validation rules, approvals)
  • Experience delivering fixed-scope or rapid implementation, JumpStart or similar limited-engagement implementations using Salesforce best practices
  • Ability to run discovery sessions, document requirements, and translate them into scalable configurations
  • Experience supporting data imports, basic integrations, and go-live readiness including deployment best practices
  • Ability to independently manage multiple concurrent projects with tight timelines and minimal supervision
  • Salesforce Certified Agentforce Sales Consultant (formerly Salesforce Certified Sales Foundations)
  • Strong client communication skills, with the ability to confidently lead conversations, manage expectations, navigate difficult situations, and proactively communicate project status, risks, and next steps
  • Ability to run other Salesforce projects preferred

FastTrack Focus: FastTrack is Offprem’s AI-assisted delivery platform that speeds up Salesforce and Marketing Cloud implementations through reusable packages, automated documentation and a client review portal.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, managing shifting priorities, and maintaining quality and efficiency across multiple implementations.
  • Possesses some sales ability, with the confidence to identify additional client needs, recognize opportunities for expanded services, and help position or upsell clients into the next phase of implementation.
  • Understands common business operations and sales processes, with the ability to translate client needs and workflows into practical Salesforce solutions.
  • Able to follow established directions, processes, and implementation guidelines while maintaining consistency and knowing when to escalate questions or concerns.
  • Strong attention to detail and an eye for QA, with the ability to identify gaps, suggest improvements, and help refine our proprietary FastTrack tool to improve implementation efficiency and consistency.
  • Able to speak confidently about more involved Salesforce concepts, including integrations, third-party application installations, data migrations, and related implementation considerations.
  • AI Savvy: Comfortable leveraging AI tools, particularly Claude, to support implementation delivery, streamline workflows, troubleshoot challenges, improve documentation, and identify opportunities to increase efficiency through AI-assisted processes.

Company Benefits and Perks

  • Remote first culture - yes we have an office, but we don’t force you to come in!
  • Unlimited PTO
  • 4% 401k match
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance from day one!
  • Company paid STD, LTD and life insurance
  • 11 paid holidays, including the day after the Superbowl!
  • Volunteer Program, including volunteer time off and matching donations
  • Tuesday start dates for new hires, because who wants to start on a Monday?
  • Bonus or commission eligible, depending upon your role

Authenticity & Verification Notice

Salesforce certifications will be verified during the application process.
As a client facing organization we value integrity and authenticity throughout our hiring process.
Candidates may be asked to validate technical knowledge, experience, education, and certifications through structured assessment and credential verification prior to hire.
