jobs.title: Wiz Customer Engineer
jobs.excerpt: As the Wiz Customer Engineer at Foresite, you own everything pre-sales Wiz.
jobs.description:
As the Wiz Customer Engineer at Foresite, you own everything pre-sales Wiz. If a customer is interested in Wiz and hasn't bought a license yet, you are the person who gets them to a confident yes. You'll run proofs of value, workshops, and CTFs, show customers things about their cloud environment that they didn't know, leveraging the power of Foresite services, and carry those wins through to implementation and managed services. You'll work side by side with Foresite’s Business Development team, and you'll be the go-to Wiz expert on Foresite's Customer Engineering team. If you know the full Wiz platform inside and out, love putting it in front of customers, and want to be close to the deals you help win, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own Pre-Sales Wiz:Be the single owner of Foresite's pre-sales Wiz motion, including proofs of value (POVs), workshops, and capture-the-flag (CTF) events, from first conversation to readout.

  • Run POVs End to End:Scope, launch, and deliver Wiz POVs, configuring the platform, guiding customers through connectors and onboarding, and presenting findings that show clear, prioritized risk in the customer's own environment.

  • Demonstrate the Full Wiz Platform:Position and demo Wiz Cloud, Wiz Code, Wiz Defend, and Wiz One together, showing how code, cloud, and runtime context connect to reduce risk across the full lifecycle.

  • Deliver Fast Time to Value:Surface meaningful, customer-specific findings within the first days of an engagement, and turn them into the business case for purchase.

  • Partner With Google Cloud Security / Wiz:Work directly with Google / Wiz sellers and Google / Wiz sales engineers to qualify opportunities, plan POVs, and win deals together. Take part in Google / Wiz partner programs and POV enablement, including shadowed engagements early on and independent delivery afterward.

  • Work Alongside Foresite Sellers:Partner with Foresite account executives and the rest of Customer Engineering to identify and qualify opportunities, understand technical and compliance objections, and resolve blockers.

  • Move Fast:Launch POVs quickly under a streamlined SOW, so customers can start when they are ready.

  • Convert Wins to Production:Hand successful POVs to Foresite's delivery and managed services teams, and help scope the implementation, ongoing management, and expansion that follow.

  • Write and Price the Work:Author SOWs and support pricing and commercials for Wiz engagements.

  • Shape Managed Services:Share what you see in the field about where Wiz managed services fit best, and help Foresite refine its offerings with Wiz.

  • Grow Across the Portfolio:Build working knowledge of Google SecOps and Google Unified Security over time, so you can support broader opportunities as needed.

  • Be a Thought Leader:Keep up with Wiz releases and cloud security trends, and contribute to best practices and thought leadership within Foresite.

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing cloud security role, such as sales engineer, solutions architect, security consultant, or professional services. Hands-on, production experience with the Wiz platform across multiple products, including Wiz Cloud, Wiz Code, Wiz Defend, and Wiz One. Cloud-only experience is not enough.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • Highly certified across the Wiz portfolio, with a commitment to keeping certifications current.

  • Experience running POVs, pilots, or customer evaluations of cloud security platforms, from kickoff through readout.

  • Experience in cloud security: CSPM, CWPP, CNAPP, cloud detection and response, and identity and access management, across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.

  • Strong understanding of security principles and technologies, including vulnerability management, container and Kubernetes security, infrastructure as code, and application security in the software lifecycle.

  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment, with a strong willingness to learn new technologies and work positively with internal teams, partners, and customers.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally with sellers, project managers, security engineers, delivery teams, and partners.

  • Expert proficiency in using AI systems to accelerate productivity.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, including the ability to lead technical workshops and demos.

  • Experience writing technical documentation, including SOWs.

  • Experience in pricing and commercials.

  • Impeccable attention to detail.

  • Ability to travel up to 30% of the time as required

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience at Wiz, whether in pre-sales, post-sales, or customer success, or deep experience at a Wiz partner or customer.

  • Experience running Wiz CTFs, workshops, or other customer enablement events.

  • Experience with Google Cloud Security products, especially Security Command Center (SCC), Google SecOps SIEM and SOAR, Google Threat Intelligence, and Google Unified Security.

  • Experience with managed security services, and the ability to connect a POV to a managed service offering.

  • Experience with AI security solutions (Model Armor, etc.) and AI workload security in the cloud.

  • Experience developing clear architecture diagrams that show system layout, data flow, and connectivity.

  • Experience in any of these market sectors: retail, healthcare, energy, or chemicals.

  • Knowledge of cybersecurity market trends (e.g., ransomware, attack frameworks, zero trust, cloud-native threats).

Why Join Foresite?

At Foresite, we aren’t just another security provider—we are a mission-driven partner helping organizations navigate an increasingly complex threat landscape. We’ve built a global leader in SecOps and MDR by leaning into three core pillars that set us apart from the crowd:

  • The "Google Bet" Has Paid Off: Four years ago, we took a contrarian path by going all-in on Google Cloud. Today, that strategy is validated. As a Google Cloud Security Partner of the Year, we operate at the absolute cutting edge of the industry, offering our team a front-row seat to the future of security operations.

  • Practitioner Credibility: We were founded by security practitioners, and more importantly, we are still governed by them. We speak the language of the SOC because we’ve lived it. This ensures our strategy is driven by technical reality, not just marketing trends.

  • Room to Run: We are at that "sweet spot" of growth—large enough to win global contracts, but early enough that every individual’s contribution directly shapes our trajectory.

This course introduces students from all disciplines to the rapidly expanding field of artificial intelligence (AI). In this way, the students develop a personal AI portfolio of solutions to the problems in their fields of study by partnering with AI algorithms. No prior AI experience is required. Overview

DecisionPoint is hiring a Junior Help Desk Specialist to provide first-contact support for authorized users of the Defense Casualty Information Processing System (DCIPS) Future. You will troubleshoot common issues, document requests, and refer unresolved problems to the appropriate team. The work calls for accurate records, discretion, and courteous service in a sensitive Department of Defense mission.

You will work from established procedures with guidance from experienced specialists and service-desk leads. Under Total Contact Ownership, you will keep users informed and track assigned requests through resolution, including when another team handles the technical work.

This position is fully remote. The DCIPS Future user-support service window is 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, excluding government holidays. Individual work schedules are assigned to support that coverage.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Receive incidents, service requests, and inquiries through approved support channels. Record, categorize, and prioritize each contact in the service-management system.
  • Troubleshoot DCIPS Future application use, user access, and related software, hardware, and connectivity issues using standard operating procedures and knowledge articles.
  • Verify user identity and support account creation, changes, deactivation, and credential maintenance under approved security procedures. Perform account actions within assigned permissions and route other actions to authorized administrators. Follow approved least-privilege procedures consistent with Zero Trust principles.
  • Document symptoms, affected users, troubleshooting steps, and results. Escalate unresolved issues to Tier 2, Tier 3, or the responsible technical team with a clear record of work completed.
  • Track assigned tickets after escalation, communicate status and next steps, confirm the outcome with users, and record resolution and closure.
  • Recognize possible outages or security incidents and promptly notify the designated lead or response team.
  • Coordinate DCIPS-related hardware exchange, repair-service requests, and other support dependencies with the responsible service providers.
  • Identify recurring questions and gaps in documentation. Help update self-service guidance and troubleshooting articles, and provide feedback on user training.
  • Maintain accurate service-performance data and handover notes, including open actions and escalation status.
  • Protect controlled unclassified information and sensitive personal and mission data using approved tools and handling procedures.
  • Complete DCIPS-specific training and practice support workflows, use of knowledge resources, and escalation procedures before service activation and as the application changes.

Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Zero to two years of experience in technical support, a help desk, or customer service. Prior experience is not required.

Working across Development, Corporate Programs, Finance, program and delivery teams, and relationship managers, the Senior Manager proactively connects contributors, monitors commitments and ensures timely donor and client communication through established relationship channels. The ideal candidate brings extensive grant management experience, strong project management and communication skills, and an adaptable approach to improving processes

Position Functions and Responsibilities Include:

Post-Award Planning and Enterprise Coordination

  • Lead kickoffs with Finance, delivery leads and relationship managers. Confirm agreement terms, approved budgets, planned funding assignments, owners, deliverables, reporting requirements, payment triggers and handoffs.
  • Maintain one implementation plan and reporting calendar per agreement, covering milestones, dependencies and deadlines. Apply the Supervisor’s distinct grant and earned-income workflows; coordinate required financial setup with Finance.
  • Establish routine touchpoints with all relevant enterprise contributors throughout each agreement’s lifecycle. Confirm responsibilities, share decisions and changes, anticipate dependencies and connect teams before handoffs break down.

Grant and Contract Monitoring

  • As needed, support preparation of revenue agreements, agreement letters and amendments using approved templates; coordinate required information, reviews, approvals and electronic signatures; and maintain executed documents in Salesforce under supervisor’s guidance.
  • Track deliverables, funder restrictions, reporting conditions and spending deadlines against approved plans. Identify emerging compliance and execution risks, follow up with responsible owners and flag concerns to the Director and Finance.
  • Prepare agreement-level monthly status reports comparing progress with approved proposals, plans and budgets and Finance’s official results and forecast. Highlight variances and decisions for the supervisor’s portfolio review.
  • Coordinate resolution with accountable owners and track their corrective actions. Escalate unresolved issues, conflicting information and material variances with actionable recommendations.
  • Route proposed changes to scope, timing, deliverables or financial terms through the supervisor for approval before revised commitments are made; update plans and records after authorization.

Finance Coordination and Documentation

  • Obtain time records, milestone confirmations and supporting documentation for timely invoicing, revenue recognition and restricted-fund accounting. Check completeness, submit by Finance’s deadlines and resolve missing or inconsistent information.
  • Support Finance-led reconciliation by investigating discrepancies among agreements, operational records, completed milestones and financial reports. Program and delivery leaders certify completed work and source accuracy; Finance retains accounting and revenue-recognition decisions and official financial records.

Donor and Client Reporting and Closeout

  • Coordinate accurate program content, supporting documentation and approvals for funder and client reports. Keep relationship managers informed of progress, changes and risks; ensure they have timely updates and materials to communicate with donors and clients through established channels.
  • Maintain complete files, including executed agreements in Salesforce, approved changes, schedules, supporting documentation and submission records. Complete administrative closeout after program and Finance confirmation, documenting final reports, approvals, outstanding requirements and lessons learned.

Process Improvement and Project Support

  • Proactively identify process gaps and recommend practical improvements to the supervisor using recurring issues, performance data and staff feedback. Help test and implement approved changes and assess results.
  • Maintain procedures, templates, job aids and training under the supervisor’s standards. Reinforce consistent use, address adoption gaps and adapt workflows as requirements evolve.
  • Partner with CRM enablement and Salesforce Administration on reporting needs, data gaps and system improvements; maintain assigned records in approved systems.
  • Provide operational support for donor data administration and fundraising events, as capacity permits and assigned by supervisor.
  • Support time-bound cross-functional project teams (Tiger Teams), as assigned by supervisor or COO, with a defined purpose, executive sponsor, scope, capacity plan and end date.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Core Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Strong grant administration, project management and organizational skills; ability to coordinate multiple agreements, contributors and deadlines.
  • Excellent attention to agreement requirements, financial documentation and reporting; ability to translate findings into clear action.
  • Proactive communication, facilitation and follow-through; ability to build accountability across teams without direct authority.
  • Adaptability, curiosity and initiative in suggesting and testing process improvements; sound judgment in resolving and escalating issues.
  • Commitment to integrity, discretion, Points of Light’s mission and a collaborative, respectful workplace.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 7+ years of relevant experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for restricted grant management from award through reporting and closeout.
  • Demonstrated success coordinating complex cross-functional projects and partnering with Finance and delivery teams on budgets, documentation and reconciliation.
  • Grant accounting experience preferred, particularly using Blackbaud for grant setup, coding, restriction tracking or financial reporting.
  • Experience developing procedures, training colleagues and implementing process improvements.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or comparable CRM software, Excel and project management tools (Asana preferred); familiarity with Microsoft 365 collaboration tools.
  • Relevant certification or formal training in grants management, project management or process improvement (e.g., CGMS, PMP or Lean Six Sigma) preferred.
  • Ability to create a welcoming work environment for all.

Culture and Values: Points of Light has a 35-year plus history that it seeks to honor, while looking toward the future as an innovative thought leader in the social sector. We have a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Our organization values innovation, dedication, teamwork and respectfulness. We enjoy thinking big, but also working hard to deliver our best work. Our team is solution-oriented, looking for someone who is always ready to deliver on ways to solve challenges, internally and with external partners.

What We Offer:Competitive compensation and excellent benefits including a robust PTO program: 18 days of PTO (increases to 20 days after three years of service) and 10 holidays; plus, we are closed December 25-January 1. Medical, dental and vision benefits offered, free life insurance, along with long-term and short-term disability, a 403(b) program with employer match, parental leave and one day of volunteer time off per month.

jobs.description:
About Omnidian

Omnidian, Inc. is a fast-growing Series C tech-enabled service company revolutionizing performance assurance for the distributed solar and energy storage industries. Omnidian is building a more sustainable future for the planet through our passionate teams, our innovative technology, and by creating an amazing customer experience. We are a certified B Corp, headquartered in Seattle, WA

The Job

As a Senior Salesforce Developer – Field Service at Omnidian, you will design, develop, and optimize Salesforce Field Service solutions that power our technician experience and field operations. You'll leverage the latest Salesforce AI capabilities to automate workflows, improve technician productivity, and enhance customer experiences while building scalable, secure, and maintainable platform solutions.

You are a hands-on Salesforce engineer with deep expertise in Field Service who embraces AI-assisted development and modern engineering practices. You'll partner closely with Product, Operations, Customer Experience, and Engineering teams to deliver intelligent solutions that improve scheduling, dispatching, work execution, and operational efficiency.

What You'll Do

    At Omnidian we believe in trust and autonomy. How you create an impact is ultimately up to you. Here is an outline of some of the things you’ll be doing:

    Salesforce Field Service Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce Field Service solutions using native platform capabilities and custom development.
  • Configure and customize Field Service functionality, including Work Orders, Service Appointments, Service Resources, Service Territories, Work Types, Scheduling Policies, Dispatcher Console, and Field Service Mobile.
  • Build modern Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex services, Flows, and Platform Events that support technician and dispatcher experiences.
  • Develop mobile-first solutions that improve field technician productivity and customer service.

    • AI-Driven Engineering

  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery, improve code quality, and automate repetitive development tasks.
  • Design and implement AI-powered Salesforce solutions using capabilities such as Agentforce, Einstein AI, Prompt Builder, and Model Builder where appropriate.
  • Build intelligent automations that improve technician recommendations, work order routing, knowledge retrieval, and operational decision-making.
  • Evaluate emerging Salesforce AI capabilities and recommend practical use cases that improve business outcomes.
  • Partner with Product and Operations teams to identify opportunities where AI can reduce manual effort and improve field service efficiency.

    • Platform Engineering

  • Develop high-quality solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Flow, Platform Events, and Custom Metadata.
  • Balance declarative configuration with custom development to build scalable, maintainable solutions.
  • Ensure applications meet Salesforce best practices for security, performance, scalability, and governor limits.
  • Perform code reviews, maintain automated testing, and contribute to engineering standards and platform quality.

    • Integrations & Automation

  • Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce Field Service and enterprise applications using REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and platform-native integration capabilities.
  • Design reliable automation that supports scheduling, dispatching, technician workflows, and customer communications.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve operational processes through intelligent automation and platform enhancements.

Who You Are

  • You're an experienced Salesforce developer with deep expertise in Salesforce Field Service and Service Cloud.
  • You have embraced AI-assisted software development and use modern AI tools to improve engineering productivity and solution quality.
  • You understand how AI can enhance business workflows and customer experiences - not just generate code.
  • You know when to configure Salesforce, when to build custom solutions, and when AI capabilities can deliver business value.
  • You enjoy solving complex technical challenges while keeping user experience and operational efficiency at the center of your decisions.
  • You collaborate effectively across engineering and business teams and communicate technical concepts clearly.
  • You mentor teammates, promote engineering best practices, and continuously improve how software is built and delivered.

Experience You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience with Service Cloud and Salesforce Field Service.
  • Strong experience customizing Field Service capabilities, including Work Orders, Service Appointments, Service Resources, Service Territories, Dispatcher Console, Scheduling Policies, and Field Service Mobile.
  • Proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, Flow, Platform Events, and Custom Metadata.
  • Experience building integrations using REST APIs and Salesforce integration patterns.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted software development tools (such as GitHub Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar) to improve development velocity, testing, documentation, and code quality.
  • Experience designing or implementing Salesforce AI capabilities such as Agentforce, Einstein AI, Prompt Builder, or AI-powered automation.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, governor limits, data modeling, and platform architecture.
  • Experience working in Git-based, source-driven development environments with modern CI/CD practices.
  • Proven ability to own features from design through deployment and production support.

Experience That’s a Plus

  • Salesforce Field Service Consultant certification.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer II certification.
  • Experience implementing Agentforce for customer service or field service use cases.
  • Experience building AI-powered technician assistants, intelligent scheduling, or knowledge retrieval solutions.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with ERP, telephony, GIS, or customer communication platforms.
  • Experience with MCP, or enterprise AI integration patterns.
  • Experience in renewable energy, utilities, asset management, or home services industries.
  • Experience working in high-growth SaaS or technology organizations.

Work-Life & Culture

  • We provide outstanding benefits including family medical, dental, vision, disability, 401(k) administration and $1k match per year and thoughtful paid time off
  • We offer 12 weeks of paid parental leave to all FTE employees (birthing and non-birthing) after 1 year, and four-week paid sabbatical leave after four years

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

This is a remote role based in the DC/VA/MD area,

Why You'll Love This Role

Cribl is investing in its Federal Systems Integrator ecosystem, and this role is its technical foundation. As the dedicated Partner Solutions Engineer for our Federal SI and consulting partners, you will make the market's leading integrators technically self-sufficient on the Cribl portfolio — and work alongside their architects to design Cribl into large Federal programs before they are awarded. You will build the reference architectures, enablement programs, and technical champion network that let partners position, demo, deploy, and support Cribl at program scale. Success in this role is measured in partner capability and programs won, not a personal sales quota.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Serve as the dedicated technical advisor to Cribl’s Federal Systems Integrator (SI) and consulting partners, from initial technical briefings through hands-on architecture workshops.

  • Design and deliver recurring partner enablement programs—including training, bootcamps, whiteboarding sessions, and certification pathways—across the Cribl portfolio (Stream, Edge, Search, and Lake).
  • Deliver executive technical briefings to partner CTOs, chief architects, and practice leads, while developing technical champions within each strategic partner.
  • Provide post-award technical support to partner delivery teams through office hours, architecture reviews, and sizing and deployment guidance.
  • Team with Cribl account SEs, sales, and partner managers on SI-led opportunities, maintaining shared account plans and regular technical interlocks
  • Represent partner needs internally by bringing field insights and feedback to Cribl’s product and go-to-market teams.
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours


If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • 5+ years in pre-sales solutions engineering / solutions architecture for data, security, or observability platforms
  • Hands-on depth in data pipeline architecture and at least one major SIEM/analytics ecosystem, with the ability to author reference architectures others deploy

  • Experience working with partners, channel organizations, or systems integrators as a primary technical audience, or equivalent experience within a Federal SI.
  • A portfolio of reusable technical content you personally created, such as reference architectures, implementation guides, labs, or training materials.
  • Strong executive- and practitioner-level communication skills, with the ability to lead audiences ranging from CTO briefings to hands-on engineering workshops.
  • Experience working effectively in a remote environment.
  • Regular presence at partner sites across the National Capital Region
  • Willingness to travel approximately 25–35%.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience supporting Federal capture, proposal, or recompete cycles
  • Previous partner/alliance solutions engineering experience at an enterprise software vendor.
  • Broad observability and data-engineering expertise alongside strong security experience.
  • Relevant cloud, security, or vendor certifications.
  • Active or prior U.S. security clearance is a plus, but not required.
  • Established relationships across the Federal SI ecosystem.
  • Residence in the DC/VA/MD area.

The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

$110,000—$190,000 USD

The Marketing & Demand Generation Specialist will take ownership of building and executing a structured B2B marketing program for an established technology services business. This is a hands-on role for an experienced marketer who can combine strategic thinking with practical execution across content, campaigns, demand generation, marketing automation and sales enablement.

Working closely with leadership, sales, business development and technical subject matter experts, you will strengthen brand visibility, communicate complex technology solutions clearly and create coordinated marketing activity that generates and nurtures qualified opportunities.

About the Client

You will be working with an established, New Zealand-owned technology services provider supporting businesses with integrated IT, communications and digital solutions.

The organisation combines technical expertise with a strong understanding of commercial needs, helping customers improve productivity, security, resilience and long-term business performance. Its capabilities span managed IT services, cybersecurity, cloud solutions, AI readiness and governance, Microsoft productivity solutions, business intelligence, connectivity, and voice and communications services.

With a partnership-led approach, the business works closely with customers to simplify their technology environments and deliver measurable value through practical, reliable solutions.

Required Experience & Qualifications

Marketing Strategy & Planning

  • Assess existing marketing activity, brand presence, audiences, content and systems.
  • Develop a practical marketing plan aligned with growth and new-business objectives.
  • Define ideal customer profiles, priority segments and key buyer personas.
  • Translate technical services, expertise and customer outcomes into compelling market-facing value propositions.
  • Recommend appropriate campaign, communication and content priorities.
  • Maintain a rolling marketing calendar covering campaigns, content, events and sales enablement.
  • Establish meaningful marketing benchmarks and reporting processes.

Brand Positioning & Content

Demand Generation & Campaign Management

Life at Labelbox

We believe data will remain crucial in achieving artificial general intelligence. As AI models become more sophisticated, the need for high-quality, specialized training data will only grow. Join us in developing new products and services that enable the next generation of AI breakthroughs.

Labelbox is backed by leading investors including SoftBank, Andreessen Horowitz, B Capital, Gradient Ventures, Databricks Ventures, and Kleiner Perkins. Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading AI labs.

This is an engineering leadership role embedded within Engineering and Architecture teams in the Office of the CTO, accountable for designing security into products from first principles through to what ships and runs in production, rather than reviewing other teams' work from the outside.

We operate AI-first: Claude and LLM-driven workflows are how the team performs threat modeling, secure design reviews, vulnerability analysis, and developer enablement today, and this role is expected to operate at that level from day one and help extend that practice further. The ideal candidate brings 10+ years of hands-on software engineering and security architecture experience, deep expertise in threat modeling and attack surface reduction at scale, and practical experience applying LLM platforms to security engineering work.

  • Embed secure-by-default patterns directly into product development, contributing reference architectures, reusable components, and automated guardrails, and building self-service security capabilities that let engineers make secure decisions without a bottleneck.
  • Own and expand the Product Security handbook, a living system that feeds the team's AI workflows to enforce secure design standards, architecture guidance, and engineering best practices.
  • Set technical direction for secure design across the org as a principal-level engineer, mentoring engineers, architects, and Security Champions on secure design, attack surface reduction, and AI-first security workflows.
  • Help evolve BeyondTrust's AI-first Product Security Architecture strategy, identifying where AI workflows can replace manual processes, where they need human oversight, and where the next capability gaps are.

What You’ll Bring

  • 10+ years in Software Engineering, Security Architecture, Product Security, or Application Security, with a track record of owning architecture for shipping products
  • Deep, practical experience with threat modeling, attack surface analysis, secure design reviews, and architecture risk analysis at scale, not just in theory
  • Strong hands-on engineering background, with the ability to read and contribute to the codebase, design systems, and earn credibility with senior engineers as a peer
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native systems, APIs, endpoint agents, thick clients, and identity/security platforms
  • Hands-on experience using LLM platforms (Claude, OpenAI, or similar) in engineering or security workflows
  • Ability to influence engineering and product teams from within, acting as a persuasive, credible, and practical partner rather than a gatekeeper
  • Builder mindset, having created scalable security workflows, frameworks, or enablement programs, not just consumed them
  • Experience building AI-native security workflows, plugins, agents, or developer tooling

What Success Looks Like

  • Measurable reduction in product attack surface and recurring architecture risks, measured by risk eliminated, not findings produced
  • Security architecture for owned product lines is defined, documented, and demonstrably adopted in shipping products
  • Increased scale and consistency of secure design reviews through AI-first workflows
  • Faster identification and remediation of design-level and architecture-level risks
  • Engineering teams actively using self-service security capabilities that have been built
  • Expansion of AI-first Product Security Architecture capabilities across the SDLC

Nice To Have

  • Background in securing endpoint technologies, identity systems, or enterprise security platforms
  • Offensive security experience or adversarial testing background
  • Cloud security experience across AWS, Azure, or Kubernetes environments

Better Together

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

jobs.excerpt: About us: Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company.
jobs.description:
About us:
Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company. We help businesses re-engineer how work actually gets done by placing AI orchestrators inside their teams to redesign workflows, deploy agents, and rewire operations end-to-end.

Job Summary:
The Principal AI Process Orchestrator is a key role. This is the person who decides what work humans do and what work AI does, and then designs and ships the systems that make both happen.

You will front every engagement. You will earn trust with the client’s executive team in week one. You will lead the work from workflow audit to shipped automation. You will carry 3-4 concurrent clients and lead Associate Orchestrators through implementation.

This is a senior individual contributor role. We are not hiring a manager. We are hiring the sharpest business analyst you know, the one who also spends their weekends building AI agents and has strong opinions about which tool to use for which job.

Job Description:

  • Lead client engagements end-to-end: You are the face of the engagement. You sit across from the client’s COO or CEO in week one, not week six. You own the weekly update, the monthly business review, and the strategic direction of the work.
  • Map the business: In the first 30 days of any engagement, you learn how work flows through the client’s organization. You produce an opportunity map that identifies the 5-10 workflows where AI can materially change the economics of the business.
  • Design the future state: For the 2-3 workflows selected for transformation, you design the rewired version. What humans do. What agents do. Where the handoffs live. What the evals look like. How success is measured.
  • Ship the implementation: You scope the work, direct the Associate Orchestrators on the engagement, review their output, and ship the first automation to production within 60 days of engagement start.
  • Grow the engagement: You identify when a client needs a Build pod, a Rescue, or ongoing Support, and pull the right Creative Chaos resource in. Transformation is the front door. You open the rest of the house.
  • Own the outcome: You report on measurable client impact: hours saved, error rates reduced, throughput gained. Numbers, not narratives.

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience as a business analyst, solutions engineer, or technical consultant in software delivery, product, or enterprise SaaS. You have sat between business stakeholders and technical teams. You have interviewed users, mapped workflows, written specs, and owned the result. You are on an individual contributor track and not looking to manage people.
  • Deeply AI-native: Not “uses ChatGPT daily.” You have built and deployed real agents. You use Claude Code as a daily tool, not a curiosity. You have opinions about Cursor vs. Windsurf, LangChain vs. LlamaIndex, and which MCP to use when, because you have actually tried all of them. You can name the right tool for the right job and defend the choice.
  • Portfolio over resume: You can show us a GitHub, side projects, deployed agents, and public writing on what you have built. We do not hire anyone who cannot show us what they have built with their own hands. A resume is not enough. A repo is.
  • Business-native English and executive poise: You have worked with or inside US or Western companies. You can run a stakeholder workshop with twelve people in the room without losing control of it. When you walk into a US CEO’s office, you command the meeting from minute one.
  • Curious and hungry: You learn a new tool every week on your own time. When you are given a well-understood problem, you dig into something adjacent that nobody asked you to look at. You built something last weekend because you wanted to see if you could.

How we hire

This is a portfolio hire, not a resume hire.

Portfolio review: We read everything before we talk to you. If the work is not there, there is no interview.

Technical conversation: 45 minutes. We walk through your agent, your design decisions, and the tools you reached for.

Live exercise: 48 hours. We share a real workflow from one of our portfolio companies. You design how you would rewire it, map the humans-vs-agents split, and sketch the 30/60/90 implementation plan.

Final conversation with the Leader: 60 minutes. Direct, a go or no-go decision within 48 hours.

What Creative Chaos offers

- Direct access to the managing partner and a small senior team

- A clean mandate: you own the engagement, we clear the path

- Best-in-class tooling: Claude, Claude Code, MCPs, and every agent framework worth trying

- The chance to define a new category of work before the market has a name for it

- Compensation open and based on capability and experience

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Murmuration, we believe that America's promise is shaped and reshaped by the best ideas and ideals of its communities, and the dreams of the people who believe in a better life for themselves, their families, and each other.

We help organizations build power in their communities in four key ways: We organize a network of values-aligned partners; we provide deep, data-driven insights into people, places, and perspectives; we develop tools that make organizing and engagement easy and more effective; and we offer services that strengthen our partners' capacity to lead change in their communities.

We envision an America where every community has what it needs to help people lead healthy, free, and dignified lives. We work to redesign the systems and structures we all depend on — how we learn, live, govern, and solve problems — so that they are just, equitable, resilient, and rooted in shared responsibility. By strengthening the ties that hold communities together, we aim for civic life defined by collective action and care, with effective leadership that truly represents everyone.

We are a collaborative, curious, and creative team of organizers, scientists, teachers, technologists, campaign veterans, and more who share the unwavering belief that we can use our gifts in service of transforming America — together.

We've built our team guided by the belief that the whole is greater than the sum of its parts. And so we support each other relentlessly — rallying together to face challenges the same way we celebrate each other's wins.

About the Position

Do you see yourself as a mission-driven Senior Engineering Manager who believes that great products emerge from strong teams? Do you have a curiosity and passion for bringing related areas together and coaching people of different backgrounds and technical expertise into a cohesive, collaborative team? Do you thrive in inclusive, thoughtful environments where engineers hold themselves to high standards of technical excellence, ownership, and impact at scale?

The Murmuration Engineering Team is seeking an experienced Senior Engineering Manager to grow and develop the multidisciplinary team (DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps) that builds and maintains the shared systems that all of our teams depend on. Your guidance and influence on this team will raise the bar across the engineering organization.

Murmuration builds technology that helps our partner organizations strengthen civic engagement and organize more effectively in their communities. Our products weave together engagement, outreach, demographic, and voter data into intuitive applications that help partners better understand and act within the communities they serve. Our team is intentionally multidisciplinary and partner-focused. We succeed together by aligning planning, execution, and learning across engineering, product, design, research, data, and partner success. We build complex, data-driven systems that need to work reliably during critical moments, scale as our partners grow, and remain understandable and maintainable as communities and their needs evolve.

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you'll join the Platform Team to support both production and prototype applications and the services they're built upon. You'll coach and grow a small, cross-discipline team that owns the outcomes for the org's build/deploy/run systems, with accountability for other teams' ability to ship fast, safely, and reliably. The team’s disciplines span DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps domains.

Your leadership actively shapes the team's operating model, evolving it to serve the Engineering organization's current and future needs. Your strategic thinking turns vision into sequenced deliverables and adapts as priorities shift without losing sight of where the team is headed. Your commitment to high-quality documentation improves knowledge sharing, onboarding, and long-term product maintainability across Murmuration.

Your ability to work across engineering teams, understanding their goals and shaping the org's engineering roadmap around them, is key to making the Platform Team successful.

This role suits a deeply experienced Senior Engineering Manager who can evaluate where we are today, absorb shifts in direction, and keep us on track. Your commitment to building inclusive, high-trust, high-performing teams is visible across the technology organization. And you believe, as we do, that how we build is just as important as what we build.

Job Level: M4

Drive & Model

  • Shape technical strategy for the team: Build an engineering roadmap that keeps the team focused on big-picture objectives and that reflects tradeoffs among competing priorities, dependencies, and complexities across DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps. Propose clear recommendations and plans, and present well-reasoned documentation of tradeoffs and alternatives.
  • Manage technical debt and process health: Maintain a steady cadence of debt paydown, prioritizing which debt to tackle and communicating the reasoning behind those choices. Own the schedule of dependency and application updates so end-of-life deadlines are handled proactively rather than as last-minute fire drills.
  • Deliver production-ready platforms: Own the platforms and tooling that give other teams a stable, observable foundation of reliability, performance, and operational excellence so they can focus on building and testing their own applications on top of it.
  • Strengthen application security: Introspect codebases to identify vulnerabilities early, and own data privacy and access control as first-class concerns; deliver solutions that support secure coding practices across the org without owning how other teams write their code.
  • Enable FinOps visibility: Build and own the single panes of glass that give engineering leadership and the C-suite a clear, trusted view of cloud and infrastructure costs, supporting both short-term budget decisions and long-term cost strategy.
  • Architect for the long term: Design and build systems and architectures that will serve Murmuration for years with scale, reliability, security, and maintainability as first-class concerns.

Elevate the Team

  • Coach and empower emerging leaders: Coach leaders to lead at every level: Within their own teams, as good, collaborative, and experienced peers, and through mentoring ICs around them.
  • Resolve ambiguity: Actively shape and bring structure and clarity (not perfection) to specs.
  • Listen and elevate: Stay closely attuned to how other teams approach test strategy, code quality, and system design, and use that insight to ensure that what our team builds and delivers elevates their developer journey.
  • Be like Ted Lasso: Believe, coach the whole team, build trust, and demonstrate kindness, empathy, optimism, curiosity, and vulnerability.

Lead Beyond Platform

  • Lead beyond the Platform team: Own objectives that span multiple teams and align with division and organizational goals.
  • Be the voice: Lead with ownership and accountability on behalf of DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps; seek opportunities to add clarity, make high-quality recommendations, and be a decision-maker in discussions with product and leadership.
  • Identify risk: Identify, document, and follow-up in a timely manner on vulnerabilities and operational risk across the full platform, including applications built by other teams.
  • Lead incident response: Involve the right people across DevOps, App Security, SRE and FinOps, lead the response, conduct root cause analysis, and follow through until learnings are shared, incorporated, and remediation is complete.

Build with Vision

  • Build one internal engineering system, not four Platform teams: Treat DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps as interdependent subsystems where the outcome depends on how well they integrate, not how well each performs alone.
  • Present a cohesive voice and narrative externally: Lead with expertise and a cohesive single voice about the Platform Team’s mission and deliverables to our peer teams.
  • Be curious about people, not just systems: Identify opportunities to foster curiosity and ease communication between people who come from different backgrounds, experiences, and technical lenses.
  • Use AI to amplify: Surface risks and gaps that manual review would miss, and measure team progress together towards shared goals.

Requirements

Technical Depth and Judgement

  • Deep, hands-on expertise across DevOps and SRE: Your direct prior experience informs your approach to prioritizing competing work, communicating tradeoffs clearly, and explaining how a decision in DevOps, SRE, AppSec, or FinOps supports the organization as a whole.
  • Sound judgment under imperfect information: Make tradeoff calls to generate clarity in ambiguous situations.
  • Communicates effectively: Explain to non-technical leadership why an architecture decision is sound without needing the original author in the room.
  • Champions team decisions: Advocate for the team's technical decisions to peers, product, and leadership.

Scope, Initiative, and Execution

  • Lead execution at scale: Lead technical execution for initiatives spanning multiple teams or systems, balancing quality, performance, and cost while keeping stakeholders aligned on tradeoffs and risks.
  • Turn strategy into shipped deliverables: Translate objectives aligned with division and organizational goals into clear epics, stories, and tickets, anticipating technical challenges and proposing solutions before they become blockers.
  • Plan through ambiguity: Estimate large, cross-team projects with unknowns, building mitigation plans for what’s unresolved, and breaking work into milestones and iterations to reduce risk and deliver incremental value.
  • Drive to completion: Involve decision makers, delegate clearly, communicate consistently, and follow through as an owner, in a timely manner, until an outcome is delivered.
  • Multiply team effectiveness: Use technical leadership, tooling, infrastructure, and process improvements to multiply the impact of both the Platform Team and the Engineering organization.

Organizational Impact

  • Influence beyond the team: Shape outcomes beyond your own team through role modeling, documentation, and advocacy.
  • Mentor future leaders: Develop future technical leaders, building their judgment, ownership, and skills through 1:1 guidance and small-group knowledge sharing.
  • Raise the engineering bar: Drive the standards and best practices that raise the bar across the organization, creating processes that instill ownership behavior in others.
  • Lead by example: Proactively share context and learnings with an eye to creating the kind of high-trust, high-performing team culture that makes everyone better.

What You Bring to the Table

Foundations

  • 10+ years of professional software manager engineering experience with demonstrated fluency across infrastructure, systems, and application layers, and a track record of delivering in production across a variety of languages, tools, and technology stacks.
  • A quality-driven mindset with experience writing, maintaining, and driving infrastructure and deployment safety checks at the team or product level.
  • A track record of effective collaboration with product, data science, and R&D teams, bridging technical and domain-specific perspectives across disciplines.

DevOps

  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and release engineering practices.
  • Production experience with AWS, including compute, storage, and networking services.
  • Proficiency with Docker, Make, or similar build tools, as well as environment scripting.
  • Fluency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or equivalent) across AWS, GCP, and Azure providers sufficient to evaluate design decisions, not just approve them.

App Security

  • Experience driving secure coding practices, data privacy principles, and access control patterns as applied in production systems.
  • Familiarity with security practices such as vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and secure SDLC.
  • Knowledge of compliance and regulatory frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, NIST CSF) and how they shape engineering decisions.

SRE

  • Deep experience with cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, and production-grade software at scale.
  • Direct experience with observability tooling (logging, metrics, and tracing) using tools such as Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus, or Grafana.
  • Working knowledge of incident management practices: On-call rotations, escalation, and postmortem processes.

FinOps

  • Familiarity with cloud cost and billing platforms sufficient to build tooling that supports both short- and long-term budget decisions.

Nice to Haves

  • Familiarity with Voter File Data;
  • Experience with or interest in political data; and/or
  • A background in political tech, civic tech, advocacy, or mission-driven organizations.

Talented Senior Engineering Managers come from all walks of life and career. If you are passionate about civic engagement and technology, please apply, even if you do not check every box!

to candidates anywhere in the United States.

jobs.description:
At Terabase Energy, we believe that digitalization and automation will drive the next wave of innovation and cost reduction in large scale solar. To fully unlock the potential of this opportunity, Terabase is developing an interconnected software and construction automation platform. We work alongside project developers, owners, and engineering & construction firms to support the design, optimization, and construction of huge solar projects around the world. Our team is a blend of solar-industry veterans and newbies, thought-leaders, dreamers, software, electrical and mechanical engineers, coders, product managers, project managers, and sales and marketing professionals. We are based in Northern California, with several other offices in the United States and around the world.

We are seeking a Design Engineer to create PV power plant designs for projects from early stages of the project life cycle to detailed engineering for construction. Design Engineers are capable of creating highly detailed array layouts based on project site conditions, customer preferences, and their own knowledge of current technologies during the conceptual stages to optimize the value of the project. During the detailed engineering phase of the project, the Design Engineer will coordinate with internal and external resources as needed to generate the engineering package, obtain necessary construction permits, and assist in construction administration during the installation of the system.

The ideal candidate has demonstrated experience in utility power plant scale solar PV systems design, a knack for problem solving, is comfortable in dynamic situations, and detail-oriented. Experience in AutoCAD and Civil 3D is a must.

Requirements

Responsibilities

  • Follow standards and goals for the engineering department
  • Assist in documenting and developing industry best practices, standards and guidelines
  • Attend project meetings, develop reports and status of design deliverables
  • Prepares detailed mechanical, electrical, civil, and structural designs for solar arrays
  • Coordinates with Project Managers, and other project participants to define project design basis and project goals
  • Work with internal and external design and engineering partners:
  • Architecting and developing detailed design documentation including System Architecture Diagrams, Device Points List, IP lists, Logic Diagrams, etc.
  • Uses understanding of system performance, construction logistics, material and labor costs to optimize designs
  • Responsible for creating and maintaining design packages
  • Adopts necessary document control measures to manage internal and external design documentation
  • Creates Bills of Materials for projects
  • Holds design review meetings with internal and external parties as needed to maintain proper QC/QA on their projects
  • Assists in development of departmental processes and best practices for the team

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Technology, or related field
  • Ability to effectively communicate with team members and business partners
  • Minimum of 3 years project engineering experience in the design/build, EPC or utility SCADA solar (PV) and Battery (BESS) generation field producing technical CAD documents
  • Experience with communications architectural design
  • Proficient AutoCAD skills, SolidWorks is a plus
  • Working knowledge of electrical and SCADA design, materials and methods of installation
  • Experience in the solar PV industry or other power generation sectors, and experience creating utility scale permitting and construction documents
  • Working knowledge of communications and network design principles
  • Experience working on multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Participated in or led continued improvement/lessons learned programs

jobs.excerpt: JOB SUMMARYThe QA Specialist plays an integral role in the review process as they are responsible for communicating with the customer, reviewer, and management to ensure a completed report is delivered by the customer requested due date.
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The QA Specialist plays an integral role in the review process as they are responsible for communicating with the customer, reviewer, and management to ensure a completed report is delivered by the customer requested due date.

The QA Specialist is responsible for the timely completion and overall completeness of a reviewer report. Completeness is determined by customer requirements, company best practices, and clinical accuracy. In addition, the QA Specialist participates in improving DS processes and works with the Manager to ensure high efficiencies are achieved.

Dane Street’s success relies on individual and team contributions every day. We care for our customers, each other and Dane Street. It is the responsibility for all of us to maintain a positive working environment that promotes client satisfaction and results.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Interaction

  • Provides regular report status updates to the client.
  • Evaluates the Quality of physician’s report and determines if the report will meet all client and jurisdictional standards; the QA Specialist is also responsible for ensuring that the clinical rationale supports the physician’s determinations.
  • Clarifies ambiguous report questions with clients.
  • Distribute final report back to client according to client specific requirements.
  • Receives, coordinates & executes all aspects of clarification & addendum requests from the client.
  • Participates in phone calls OR meetings with client(s) when a report is in question.
  • Follow up with the client for any missing information that is pertinent to the referral.

Physician Interaction

  • Works directly with physicians to ensure that all client questions are answered and supported by clinical rationale.
  • Conduct regular follow up with the physician or their office staff to ensure an on-time delivery of the report.
  • Compose and provide verbal or written feedback to the doctor regarding report quality.
  • Compose and provide verbal or written requests to the physician or their office staff for clarifications.
  • Receive written or verbal confirmation from the physician that a report has the doctor’s approval and ensures the doctor provides his/her signature for the final report.

Report Analysis

  • Review each physician report for data accuracy including spelling, grammar & punctuation.
  • Responsible for ensuring that all state requirements for reporting are met.
  • Responsible for report format and adhering to each client’s specific requirements.
  • Must ensure that all client special handling instructions with regard to report completion and delivery are met.

Additional Duties

  • May provide oversight to the work of the team members.
  • Continuously improves processes that help to facilitate better turnaround time, peer to peer success rates and lessens returned reports by clients for clarification purposes, ultimately resulting in higher client satisfaction.
  • Responsible for the final approval on cases for release to the client.
  • Will act as a liaison and coordinate quality issue reports along with all new reviewer reports with the VP of Clinical Operations.

Other duties & special projects, as assigned and based on business needs.

Requirements

EDUCATION/CREDENTIALS:

An Associate’s Degree or Bachelor’s Degree is preferred.

JOB RELEVANT EXPERIENCE:

Business experience in a healthcare and/or insurance setting is preferred.

JOB RELATED SKILLS/COMPETENCIES:

Present exceptional communication skills with a clear understanding of company business lines. The ability to apply critical thinking, manage time efficiently and meet specific deadlines. Computer literacy and typing skills are essential.

WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Any lifting, bending, traveling, etc. required to do the job duties listed above. Long periods of sitting and computer work.

WORK FROM HOME TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Supply and support their own internet services.

Maintaining an uninterrupted internet connection is a requirement of all work from home position.

This job description is subject to change at any time.

Benefits

Join our team at Dane Street and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and peace of mind. We offer a range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Additionally, we offer voluntary life insurance options for you, your spouse, and your children. We also offer other voluntary benefits which include hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident indemnity, and pet insurance plans. Employees receive basic life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage at no cost. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have time to relax and recharge, while our 401k plan with a company match helps you plan for your future. Apple equipment and a media stipend are provided for remote workspace.

ABOUT DANE STREET:

A fast-paced, Inc. 500 Company with a high-performance culture, is seeking insightful forward-thinking professionals. We process over 200,000 insurance claims annually for leading national and regional Workers’ Compensation, Disability, Auto, and Group Health Carriers, Third-Party Administrators, Managed Care Organizations, Employers, and Pharmacy Benefit Managers. We provide customized Independent Medical Exams and Peer Review programs that assist our clients in reaching the appropriate medical determination as part of the claims management process.

Full Stack Engineer

Next.js, React, Python, AI & Marketing Technology | Remote | EST Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours – EST

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients—a fast-growing marketing agency serving 150+ home service businesses—is hiring a Full Stack Engineer to build and scale the technology powering its marketing, lead generation, tracking, and revenue operations.

This is a hands-on builder role, not a strategy-only engineering position.

You’ll work across:

  • Full-stack application development
  • Marketing data and attribution
  • Meta Pixel & Conversion API (CAPI)
  • AI-powered marketing workflows
  • CRM integrations and automation
  • Internal dashboards and operational tools

You’ll work directly with leadership, media buyers, and operators to turn real business problems into production-ready systems that improve campaign performance, lead conversion, and operational efficiency.

If you’re a strong full-stack engineer who understands both software engineering and performance marketing technology, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Full-Stack & Internal Tool Development — Primary Focus

Build, deploy, and maintain internal applications using:

  • Next.js
  • React
  • Python

You’ll:

  • Develop marketing dashboards and reporting systems
  • Build internal operational tools used by media buyers and teams
  • Replace repetitive manual workflows with scalable software
  • Develop reliable backend services and integrations
  • Take systems from concept through production deployment
  • Continuously improve tools based on real user and campaign needs

Marketing Data, Tracking & Attribution — Core Focus

Own and improve the technical infrastructure connecting advertising performance to actual business outcomes.

You’ll:

  • Implement and optimize Meta Pixel
  • Work hands-on with Meta Conversion API (CAPI)
  • Configure accurate event tracking
  • Handle event deduplication
  • Improve attribution accuracy
  • Troubleshoot tracking discrepancies
  • Build pipelines connecting:

Ad Platforms → Backend Systems → CRM → Reporting Dashboards

Develop reporting systems that give teams visibility into metrics such as:

  • ROAS
  • CPL
  • CAC
  • Conversion rates
  • Lead quality
  • Campaign performance

AI Integration & Marketing Automation

Build AI directly into live marketing and operational workflows.

Use APIs such as OpenAI and similar AI platforms to develop systems for:

  • Ad copy generation
  • Creative ideation
  • Lead scoring
  • Lead qualification
  • Campaign analysis
  • Performance insights
  • Automated reporting
  • Operational workflow automation

This role requires someone who actively uses modern AI tools—not someone with only theoretical exposure.

CRM & Lead Lifecycle Automation — Critical

Integrate and automate CRM platforms such as:

  • GoHighLevel
  • Close CRM
  • HubSpot
  • Similar CRM systems

Build workflows connecting the entire lead lifecycle:

Lead Capture → CRM → Routing → Follow-Up → Pipeline → Conversion → Attribution

You’ll also:

  • Automate lead routing and assignment
  • Build pipeline management workflows
  • Configure webhooks and API integrations
  • Sync CRM conversion outcomes back to advertising platforms
  • Support offline conversion and CAPI event tracking
  • Maintain data consistency across systems
  • Troubleshoot broken integrations and automation workflows

APIs, Webhooks & Systems Integration

Build reliable connections between marketing and operational platforms.

You’ll work extensively with:

  • REST APIs
  • Webhooks
  • Third-party integrations
  • Automation platforms
  • CRM APIs
  • Advertising APIs
  • AI APIs
  • Backend data flows

Ensure systems remain accurate, scalable, and reliable as campaign volume grows.

Rapid Execution & Iteration

This is a fast-moving environment where engineering directly impacts revenue.

You’ll:

  • Ship production-ready solutions quickly
  • Test systems using real campaign data
  • Iterate based on performance and user feedback
  • Work closely with media buyers to identify bottlenecks
  • Troubleshoot operational and technical issues
  • Prioritize solutions that create measurable business impact
  • Balance speed with reliability and maintainability

Required Experience & Skills

Non-Negotiables

  • 4–6+ years of hands-on software engineering experience
  • Strong full-stack development experience with:
    • React
    • Next.js
    • Python
  • Proven experience building and deploying production-level applications or internal tools
  • Strong experience with:
    • APIs
    • Webhooks
    • Third-party integrations
    • Automation systems
  • Active use of AI tools in day-to-day engineering work

Marketing / Ad Tech Experience

Hands-on experience in a marketing, advertising, performance marketing, or ad tech environment is required.

You should have experience with:

  • Meta Pixel and/or Conversion API (CAPI)
  • Event tracking
  • Event deduplication
  • Attribution
  • Marketing analytics
  • Campaign reporting
  • Advertising data pipelines

Experience building dashboards or reporting systems for paid marketing campaigns—particularly Meta Ads—is strongly preferred.

CRM & Automation Experience

Hands-on experience integrating or automating platforms such as:

  • GoHighLevel
  • Close CRM
  • HubSpot
  • Similar CRM systems

You should understand:

  • Lead capture
  • Lead routing
  • Pipeline management
  • Follow-up automation
  • Conversion tracking
  • Offline events
  • CRM-to-ad-platform attribution

Nice to Have

  • Experience working inside a performance marketing agency
  • Experience supporting high-volume lead generation campaigns
  • Familiarity with paid media metrics such as:
    • ROAS
    • CPL
    • CAC
    • Conversion rate
  • Experience with:
    • Zapier
    • Make
    • Similar automation platforms
  • Understanding of marketing data pipelines
  • Familiarity with attribution challenges caused by:
    • iOS privacy changes
    • Browser restrictions
    • Cookie limitations
  • Experience supporting home services or local lead-generation businesses

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Are a builder first
  • Prefer shipping working systems over creating theoretical architecture
  • Understand how engineering connects to marketing performance and revenue
  • Can move comfortably between frontend, backend, APIs, CRM systems, and marketing technology
  • Troubleshoot problems independently
  • Understand attribution beyond simply installing a tracking pixel
  • Use AI practically in your development workflow
  • Work well with non-technical stakeholders such as media buyers and operators
  • Move quickly without sacrificing system reliability
  • Take ownership from problem identification through deployment

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Building a new internal tool in Next.js and React
  • Developing Python backend functionality
  • Troubleshooting Meta CAPI or Pixel tracking
  • Investigating attribution discrepancies
  • Connecting CRM conversion data to advertising platforms
  • Building or improving a marketing performance dashboard
  • Creating an AI-powered lead qualification workflow
  • Developing API or webhook integrations
  • Automating repetitive operational processes
  • Meeting with media buyers to understand campaign bottlenecks
  • Shipping improvements and monitoring their real-world impact

In short: you build the technology layer connecting advertising, leads, CRM data, AI, attribution, and revenue operations.

Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build industry-first products that make retirement accounts simple and easy for employers to support and participants to use. You will collaborate with domain experts to design, build and test new features and systems. As reliability and auditability is key to earning our customers’ trust, you will build robust systems that are observable, maintainable, and scalable. As an engineering organization, we:

  • Value continuous improvement - we care about documentation, security, durability, not just throwing features over the wall.
  • Help each other be better engineers - we leave things better than we found it.
  • Aspire to collaborate seamlessly - we ensure our software is improving the customer experience.

What you get to do every day

  • Design, build, and maintain our user experiences for both external and internal customers
  • Work on business-critical, foundational services which serve as the data funnel of our entire platform
  • Improve complex processes and systems to make them more robust and require less human intervention
  • Collaborate with other engineers and stakeholders to share knowledge and build expertise
  • Develop ownership over domains in our system and make informed engineering tradeoffs
  • Advocate for and delight internal and external users
  • Direct AI agents across the full development lifecycle, from prototyping and implementation to debugging and code review. Operate as the architect and decision-maker while AI handles the building
  • Expand what's possible with AI tooling and identify opportunities to automate repetitive engineering work, improve code quality through AI-driven review, and share effective patterns with your team

What you bring to the role

  • 6+ years of experience building and maintaining software in production
  • Desire to work with the following technologies: Node, TypeScript, Kotlin, React, AWS, PostgreSQL, Kafka

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

WEKA is looking for a Product Manager to own the roadmap and go-to-market for Augmented Memory Grid (AMG), part of the NeuralMesh platform. This is a deeply technical PM role sitting at the intersection of AI inference infrastructure, high-performance networking, and enterprise storage. You will work directly with engineering, GPU/inference partners (NVIDIA, hyperscalers, GPU clouds), and enterprise customers running large-scale LLM inference to define what AMG needs to do next.

Bring Your Expertise – and Your Passion

  • Leadership Skills: Strong leadership skills with a history of successfully leading cross-functional teams. Product Managers are expected to inspire and motivate team members to achieve ambitious goals while maintaining a collaborative and positive working environment. You understand how to influence without authority, and your recall of meaningful details supports verbal and written agility.
  • Strategic Vision: You are a strategic thinker who can develop and execute product strategies that align with market trends and customer needs, as well as think critically about existing strategies. You have a proven ability to translate strategic goals into actionable plans and deliver results.
  • Communication Skills: You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable presenting product strategies and roadmaps to internal teams and external customers.

What you’ll do

  • Own the AMG product roadmap: KV-cache/prefix-cache offload, memory tiering, and integration with inference engines and orchestration layers (vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/TensorRT-LLM/NIM, Kubernetes-based serving).
  • Partner with engineering to define architecture trade-offs across GPU memory, networking (RDMA, GPUDirect, NVMe-oF), and distributed storage — translating inference performance bottlenecks (time-to-first-token, throughput, context length) into product requirements.
  • Work directly with enterprise customers and GPU cloud partners: Nebius, CoreWeave, TogetherAI, etc., running production inference workloads to gather requirements, validate benchmarks, and prioritize features that reduce cost-per-token and improve SLAs at scale.
  • Partner with NVIDIA and other silicon/inference-stack partners on joint roadmap and certification work.
  • Define and track benchmarks (TTFT, throughput, cache hit rate) that demonstrate AMG's value versus standard GPU-memory-only inference.
  • Support sales and field teams with technical positioning, competitive differentiation, and enterprise deal support.

Must-have qualifications

  • Inference ecosystem depth: hands-on product or engineering experience with LLM inference serving — vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/TensorRT-LLM/NIM, Ray Serve, or comparable — and fluency in concepts like KV-cache, prefix/context caching, quantization, and batching strategies.
  • Model & systems familiarity: working knowledge of how modern LLMs are served in production (context windows, multi-tenant serving, GPU scheduling) well enough to translate model-level constraints into infrastructure requirements.
  • Networking/infrastructure fluency: comfort with the fundamentals of high-performance networking and distributed systems — RDMA, GPUDirect Storage, NVMe-oF, or equivalent — and how they affect inference performance.
  • Enterprise customer experience: track record working directly with large enterprise accounts — requirements gathering, production deployments, SLAs — not solely self-serve/PLG products.
  • 10+ years of product management experience, ideally with some portion in infrastructure, ML platforms, or developer-facing technical products.

Nice-to-have

  • Prior experience at a GPU cloud, inference platform, or AI infrastructure startup.
  • Familiarity with storage systems (parallel/distributed file systems, object storage) in AI/ML pipelines.
  • Experience partnering directly with NVIDIA or other accelerator/silicon vendors.
