jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

The Military DoD SkillBridge program is an opportunity for Service members to gain valuable civilian work experience through specific industry training, apprenticeships, or internships during the last 180 days of service. SkillBridge connects Service members with industry partners in real-world job experiences under Dept. of Defense Instruction 1322.29. Separating Service members can be granted up to 180 days of permissive duty to focus solely on training full-time with approved industry partners after unit commander (first O-4/Field Grade commander in chain of command) provides written authorization and approval. GE Aerospace as a Skill Bridge partner offers real-world training and work experience in in-demand fields of work while having the opportunity to evaluate the Service member’s suitability for the work. Military DoD SkillBridge participants are not eligible for compensation from GE Aerospace, as they continue to receive military compensation and benefits as active-duty service members.

Job Description

The Senior Operations Planning Analyst is responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving production and operations schedules that support customer demand, business priorities, and execution performance. This role partners closely with operations, supply chain, materials, manufacturing, sourcing, logistics, and program teams to align schedules with capacity, material availability, and shop readiness. The role requires strong analytical capability, operating rigor, and proactive problem solving to identify schedule risks, drive recovery actions, and improve Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost outcomes.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Own development, maintenance, and execution support of production and operations schedules for assigned value streams, product lines, programs, or sites
  • Translate demand, backlog, forecast, and business priorities into executable schedules aligned with capacity, labor, material availability, and operational constraints
  • Analyze schedule attainment, loading, throughput, bottlenecks, and resource constraints to identify risks and recommend corrective actions
  • Partner with manufacturing, materials, sourcing, logistics, quality, and program teams to align schedules with operational readiness and customer commitments
  • Lead schedule reviews and planning routines to communicate priorities, risks, constraints, and recovery plans
  • Monitor schedule adherence, past due orders, recovery progress, and output performance; escalate issues that may impact delivery or business commitments
  • Perform scenario analysis to evaluate schedule options, tradeoffs, and impacts to capacity, fulfillment, and customer delivery
  • Drive schedule stabilization through improved planning logic, operating discipline, and cross-functional action management
  • Develop and maintain planning dashboards, reports, and metrics related to schedule attainment, backlog, constraint management, and on-time delivery
  • Support operating cadences including daily management, weekly reviews, and leadership updates with clear, data-driven insights
  • Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities to improve schedule accuracy, flow, visibility, and predictability

Required Qualifications

  • Active Military personnel on their last 180 days of Military service
  • Significant experience in operations planning, production scheduling, supply chain, manufacturing, or related analytical roles
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
  • Experience using ERP/MRP systems and planning or scheduling tools
  • Ability to work across functions and influence stakeholders in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Aerospace, aviation, or other complex regulated manufacturing environments
  • Excel and data analysis capability
  • Experience leading planning reviews, schedule recovery efforts, and cross-functional action tracking
  • Knowledge of operational metrics including plan attainment, schedule adherence, throughput, backlog, and on-time delivery

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong ownership, accountability, and follow-through
  • Clear communicator with the ability to simplify complex scheduling issues
  • Comfortable making recommendations in a dynamic operating environment

Overview

Lumicera Health Services is seeking a Pharma Business Development Executive to join our team!

The Pharma Business Development Executive is responsible for developing, managing, and expanding strategic relationships with pharmaceutical and biotechnology manufacturers for Lumicera. This role serves as the primary relationship lead for assigned manufacturer partners, driving access, growth, retention, contracting support, program innovation, and value creation across specialty pharmacy services.

The Pharma Business Development Executive collaborates closely with internal teams, including trade relations, contracting, operations, clinical services, data and reporting, finance, legal, market access, and implementation, to deliver manufacturer programs that improve patient access, support therapy performance, and strengthen long-term partnerships. This role combines deep specialty pharmacy expertise, provider relationship management experience, operational leadership capabilities, and business acumen to drive significant growth and organizational performance across Lumicera Direct.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Build and maintain executive-level and day-to-day relationships with assigned pharmaceutical manufacturer partners.
  • Develop and execute account strategies that support manufacturer objectives, specialty pharmacy growth, patient access, and long-term relationship retention.
  • Serve as the internal and external point of contact for assigned manufacturer accounts, ensuring clear communication, timely issue resolution, and alignment across stakeholders.
  • Lead negotiation for assigned manufacturer programs including data programs, enhanced services, purchase agreements, and access agreements.
  • Identify new business development opportunities, including limited distribution access, expanded therapy access, patient support services, adherence programs, data and reporting solutions, and other specialty pharmacy service offerings.
  • Partner with contracting and finance teams to support contract renewals, amendments, pricing discussions, acquisition economics, service agreements, and value-based opportunities.
  • Lead Quarterly Business Reviews, strategic planning meetings, performance discussions, and manufacturer governance routines.
  • Collaborate with specialty operations, clinical, implementation, product, analytics, legal, compliance, and trade teams to design and execute manufacturer programs.
  • Monitor specialty pharmacy market trends, pipeline therapies, therapeutic category dynamics, manufacturer priorities, payer trends, and competitive activity.
  • Translate complex operational, financial, clinical, and data-driven insights into clear recommendations for manufacturer partners and internal leadership.
  • Escalate and resolve manufacturer concerns related to service performance, patient access, implementation, reporting, contractual commitments, or operational execution.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of specialty pharmacy services, pharmacy distribution models, hub services, patient support programs, data reporting requirements, and manufacturer market access priorities.
  • Support organizational growth by identifying opportunities to improve service offerings, expand manufacturer partnerships, and enhance the specialty pharmacy value proposition.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, pharmacy, life sciences, finance, or a related field, or equivalent work experience, required. MBA, MHA, or advanced degree in relevant field preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in specialty pharmacy, pharmaceutical manufacturer account management, trade relations, market access, healthcare business development, pharmacy benefit management, or related healthcare services required.
  • Demonstrated experience managing pharmaceutical manufacturer relationships, strategic accounts, contract discussions, or complex healthcare partnerships required.
  • Strong understanding of specialty pharmacy operations, manufacturer services, limited distribution networks, patient access challenges, payer dynamics, and specialty therapy lifecycles required.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving operations, contracting, analytics, clinical, finance, compliance, legal, and implementation teams required.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple manufacturer priorities, negotiate through ambiguity, and drive measurable business outcomes required.
  • Experience with manufacturer data reporting, adherence services, patient support programs, launch planning, and limited distribution drug access strategies required.
  • Familiarity with contract performance metrics, service-level expectations, patient journey metrics, and manufacturer scorecards required.
  • Experience with large specialty pharmacy, PBM, health plan, distributor, or pharmaceutical manufacturer organizations required.
  • Participate in, adhere to, and support compliance program objectives.
  • The ability to consistently interact cooperatively and respectfully with other employees.

What can you expect from Lumicera?

  • 401K company match of up to 5% - No vesting requirement

jobs.description:
UX/UI Designer – Figma, Product Design & User Experience | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a UX/UI Designer to create intuitive, visually polished, and high-performing digital experiences across web and mobile products.

This is more than a visual design role. You’ll own the design process from user research and UX strategy through wireframing, prototyping, high-fidelity UI design, design systems, and developer handoff.

You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, QA, and leadership to understand user problems and translate them into digital experiences that are easy to use, scalable, accessible, and aligned with business objectives.

If you combine strong UX thinking with polished UI execution and enjoy solving real product problems through design, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

User Research & UX Strategy

  • Conduct user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and behavioral analysis
  • Identify user needs, pain points, and friction across digital experiences
  • Translate research into:
    • Personas
    • User journeys
    • User flows
    • Information architecture
    • Wireframes
  • Use behavioral and analytics tools such as:
    • Hotjar
    • FullStory
    • Google Analytics
  • Combine qualitative and quantitative insights to identify UX opportunities
  • Recommend improvements based on user behavior, research, and product goals

Wireframing & Prototyping

  • Create low-fidelity wireframes to validate concepts and workflows
  • Build interactive prototypes for usability testing and stakeholder review
  • Develop high-fidelity product mockups using:
    • Figma
    • Adobe XD
    • Sketch
  • Rapidly iterate based on:
    • User testing
    • Stakeholder feedback
    • QA findings
  • Clearly communicate interaction patterns and intended product behavior
  • Move concepts efficiently from early exploration to production-ready design

UI & Product Design

  • Design clean, modern, and user-friendly interfaces
  • Create responsive experiences across:
    • Desktop
    • Tablet
    • Mobile
  • Balance usability, aesthetics, accessibility, and business objectives
  • Design user flows and conversion paths that minimize friction
  • Apply strong visual hierarchy, typography, spacing, and layout principles
  • Ensure interfaces are visually polished and production-ready
  • Maintain consistency across features and product experiences

Design Systems & Scalability

  • Build and maintain scalable design systems and component libraries
  • Establish consistent standards for:
    • Typography
    • Color
    • Spacing
    • Layouts
    • Components
    • Interaction patterns
  • Create reusable components that improve design and development efficiency
  • Maintain organized design files, assets, specifications, and documentation
  • Ensure consistency across products, features, and platforms
  • Evolve design systems as product requirements grow

Accessibility & Usability

  • Apply WCAG accessibility standards throughout the design process
  • Consider:
    • Contrast
    • Readability
    • Keyboard accessibility
    • Responsiveness
    • Overall usability
  • Conduct usability reviews
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows
  • Improve:
    • Task completion
    • Navigation
    • Conversion paths
    • Overall product usability
  • Incorporate accessibility into designs from the beginning rather than treating it as a final check

Product & Engineering Collaboration

  • Work closely with:
    • Product Managers
    • Developers
    • QA
    • Leadership
  • Participate in sprint planning, product discussions, and feature prioritization
  • Collaborate with engineering throughout implementation rather than only at handoff
  • Deliver developer-ready designs using:
    • Figma Dev Mode
    • Zeplin
    • InVision Inspect
  • Provide clear specifications, assets, and interaction documentation
  • Review implemented designs
  • Identify and resolve inconsistencies before release
  • Help ensure the final product accurately reflects the intended user experience

Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional UX/UI or Product Design experience
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating:
    • UX problem-solving
    • UI craftsmanship
    • Responsive design
    • Product design thinking
  • Advanced proficiency with:
    • Figma
    • Adobe XD
    • Sketch
  • Experience creating:
    • User flows
    • Wireframes
    • Interactive prototypes
    • High-fidelity interfaces
    • Responsive layouts
    • Design systems
  • Strong understanding of:
    • UX and usability principles
    • Interaction design
    • Accessibility
    • Responsive design
    • Mobile-first design
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to clearly explain and defend design decisions
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in a remote product environment
  • Availability during U.S. client business hours

Preferred Experience

  • Experience designing:
    • SaaS products
    • Mobile applications
    • E-commerce platforms
  • Experience building or maintaining scalable design systems
  • Familiarity with:
    • HTML/CSS fundamentals
    • Developer workflows
    • Agile/Scrum environments
  • Experience with behavioral analytics tools such as:
    • Hotjar
    • FullStory
    • Google Analytics
  • Experience conducting A/B tests or design experiments
  • Understanding of Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • Experience collaborating directly with engineering teams through implementation

Tools & Technology

Figma | Figma Dev Mode | Adobe XD | Sketch | Zeplin | InVision Inspect | Hotjar | FullStory | Google Analytics | HTML/CSS | Design Systems | Prototyping & Usability Testing Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Think about user journeys and product problems, not just individual screens
  • Combine strong visual design skills with practical UX thinking
  • Can clearly explain the reasoning behind your design decisions
  • Are comfortable using research and data to challenge assumptions
  • Understand how UX impacts adoption, engagement, conversion, and satisfaction
  • Collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Care about consistency, accessibility, and the small details that make products feel polished
  • Can iterate quickly without sacrificing design quality
  • Understand how designs translate into real products during development
  • Take ownership from initial research through final implementation

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing user behavior, product feedback, or upcoming feature requirements to identify UX opportunities and potential friction.

Throughout the day, you could create user flows and wireframes, build and test interactive prototypes, design polished interfaces in Figma, or refine the product’s design system.

You’ll collaborate closely with Product and Engineering during sprint execution, incorporate feedback from usability testing and QA, and prepare developer-ready designs with clear specifications and interaction details.

You’ll also review implemented features to ensure the final experience maintains the intended design quality and consistency.

In short: you turn user needs and business requirements into intuitive, scalable, accessible, and visually polished digital products.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Improved product usability and user satisfaction
  • Increased engagement and product adoption
  • Reduced friction across critical user journeys
  • Improved task completion and conversion flows
  • Consistent implementation of design systems
  • Reduced design-related development revisions
  • On-time delivery of developer-ready designs
  • Strong accessibility and responsive design standards
  • High-quality implementation of approved designs
  • Positive feedback from users and internal stakeholders

Why This Role Stands Out

  • End-to-end ownership of UX and UI design
  • Opportunity to influence real product strategy and user experience
  • Close collaboration with Product and Engineering leadership
  • Opportunity to build and improve scalable design systems
  • Use of research and analytics to influence product decisions
  • Hands-on involvement from discovery through implementation
  • Fully remote environment aligned with U.S. clients
  • Strong career progression into:
    • Senior Product Designer
    • Lead UX/UI Designer
    • Design Systems Lead
    • Head of Product Design

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Portfolio Review + Practical Design Task
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Background Verification

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have a strong UX/UI portfolio, are highly proficient in Figma, and can take a product from research and wireframes through polished, developer-ready UI, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help create digital products that are intuitive, accessible, scalable, visually polished, and genuinely enjoyable to use.

jobs.excerpt: Maybe you call yourself a Senior Data Engineer, a pipeline architect, a "why-is-this-TOS-data-a-mess" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam.
jobs.description:
Maybe you call yourself a Senior Data Engineer, a pipeline architect, a "why-is-this-TOS-data-a-mess" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam. Whatever you call yourself, you'll join Terminal.exe, All Your BI's AI-native data platform for container terminal operators, and build the core of it: the pipelines and data model that turn fragmented, hard-to-trust terminal data into something operators run their day on.

What you get

  • A salary between €85,000-€99,000 per year inclusive of holiday allowance, based on your experience.

  • €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it.

  • 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months.

  • Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings.

  • €500 home-office budget and a great laptop.

  • A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", so now and then.

  • Fully remote, within Europe.

Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR.

About us

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. We work according to Holacracy: little hierarchy, lots of ownership. Serious work. Serious fun.

About Terminal.exe

Terminal.exe is All Your BI's SaaS platform for container terminals. It unifies fragmented data, TOS, maintenance, gate, sensors, into one governed model, so every site works from the same numbers instead of rebuilding its own reporting from scratch. The platform is growing fast. You'll help shape the engineering foundations that need to scale next: multi-tenant data architecture, near-real-time pipelines from 24/7 operations, and a standardized data model that works across terminals worldwide.

What the job looks like

You will design and build the pipelines that move data from terminal operating systems (such as Navis N4) into our platform, and the transformation layer that turns raw operational data into curated, documented datasets.

Concretely, you will work on:

  • ELT pipelines from on-premises terminal databases into our Azure-based platform, with near-real-time refresh (3-minute microbatch) for operational reporting and daily batch for analytics. Extraction uses watermark-based incremental queries over Kafka (Azure Event Hubs) to PostgreSQL staging.

  • A multi-tenant data architecture on Azure PostgreSQL with database-per-tenant isolation and a standardized STG → ODS → DataMart layer structure driven by our internal declarative transformation framework (dewi)

  • Our internal connector tooling written in Go, which you will help develop and extend

  • Data quality monitoring: gap detection, freshness alerting, and reconciliation

  • The standardized terminal data model: mapping source data from different TOS versions and configurations onto shared definitions of moves, calls, and equipment events

You will work directly with terminal operations staff, without intermediate layers.

Requirements

What you bring

  • Attitude and experience: curiosity and a genuine appetite for architectural ownership, and 5+ years of data engineering experience, including end-to-end ownership of production data platforms. This is a product under active development, we need you comfortable deciding, not just executing.

  • Core stack: strong SQL and Python; Go experience is a significant plus (our connectors and consumers are written in Go). Solid experience with SQL Server as a source system and PostgreSQL as a target store.

  • Pipelines and streaming: experience building and operating ELT pipelines against operational source systems, including watermark/incremental or CDC/replica-based extraction, and with event-driven or streaming architectures, we use Azure Event Hubs with a Kafka-compatible endpoint.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionMetalBear is remote-first, early-stage, and product-led.
jobs.description:
Description

MetalBear is remote-first, early-stage, and product-led. We're building mirrord, a Kubernetes development platform that lets developers and AI coding agents run code against a live cluster before it's deployed.

The problem we solve is the wait. In any organization running microservices, checking whether a change actually works means building an image, pushing it, deploying to a shared environment, and waiting on a pipeline to tell you. That loop runs many times a day per engineer, and it's the single biggest tax on how fast an organization ships. With mirrord, the service runs wherever the work is already happening: on a laptop, in CI, or inside an agent's sandbox. Its traffic, environment variables, and file access are forwarded to and from a shared staging cluster, so the service behaves exactly as it would if it were deployed, without deploying it. Feedback arrives in seconds instead of minutes, against real APIs, real schemas, and real traffic rather than mocks or a hand-maintained local stack.

That matters more every month, because AI agents now write a large share of the code our customers ship. An agent generating code from static files is guessing at how the rest of the system behaves, and a human has to catch the guesses. mirrord gives the agent the real context to write against and a real feedback loop to verify against, so what lands in review is something a reviewer can trust.

mirrord is used by thousands of developers worldwide, including at Fortune 500 companies.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineering leader to lead the Cloud Integrations Team. Description

MetalBear is remote-first, early-stage, and product-led. We're building mirrord, a Kubernetes development platform that lets developers and AI coding agents run code against a live cluster before it's deployed.

The problem we solve is the wait. In any organization running microservices, checking whether a change actually works means building an image, pushing it, deploying to a shared environment, and waiting on a pipeline to tell you. That loop runs many times a day per engineer, and it's the single biggest tax on how fast an organization ships. With mirrord, the service runs wherever the work is already happening: on a laptop, in CI, or inside an agent's sandbox. Its traffic, environment variables, and file access are forwarded to and from a shared staging cluster, so the service behaves exactly as it would if it were deployed, without deploying it. Feedback arrives in seconds instead of minutes, against real APIs, real schemas, and real traffic rather than mocks or a hand-maintained local stack.

That matters more every month, because AI agents now write a large share of the code our customers ship. An agent generating code from static files is guessing at how the rest of the system behaves, and a human has to catch the guesses. mirrord gives the agent the real context to write against and a real feedback loop to verify against, so what lands in review is something a reviewer can trust.

The RSM is accountable for territory revenue driven by these motions, direct sales where appropriate and productive resource utilization. Success is defined less by what the RSM personally closes and more by how well the RSM directs, enables, and holds accountable the sellers, branches, and partners operating in the territory. The position requires channel management discipline, branch-level relationship ownership, Partner Program execution, and the judgment to know when to sell directly versus when to scale through the Reps.

  • Lead the Rep Firm Channel in Territory: Manage, enable, and hold accountable the Rep Firm Reps operating in the territory. Build joint territory plans with the Reps, run a weekly cadence, drive partner adoption, and use sell-through data to manage their performance. The RSM is the leader of the sellers in the territory and executes the Rep Firm strategy set at the corporate level.
  • Own and Drive National Dealer Branches: Serve as the named RSM contact for every National Dealer branch and local sales team in territory. Support and drive sales inside these large enterprise security dealers and integrators, execute every corporate-led play at the branch level, and surface field intelligence back to Strategic Accounts leadership.
  • Grow the Partner Program Through Distribution: Recruit, enroll, certify, and develop indirect security dealers who buy through distribution. Drive Partner Program enrollment and tier progression and use distributor sell-through data to find buyers worth growing.
  • Own Regional Distributor and Direct OEM Accounts (Direct): Act as the primary, direct account owner for every Regional Distributor in territory (single-territory distributors under $25M in annual revenue), including relationship, planning, and revenue growth.
  • Revenue Accountability: Own and deliver the territory revenue quota across all four motions. Influence product mix, solution expansion, and Inovonics Intrusion System (IIS) adoption throughout the territory.
  • IIS (Inovonics Intrusion System) Adoption: Drive introduction and adoption of the Inovonics Intrusion System (IIS) across the Reps, National Dealer branches, and Partner Program dealers in territory. Facilitate warm handoffs to the IIS Sales Specialist, support onboarding and activation, and achieve IIS adoption targets.
  • Salesforce Discipline: Log every customer interaction in Salesforce with the required Task Type, keep account plans current on every key account, and maintain accurate channel, branch, and certification data.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of experience in territory, channel, or account management, preferably in security, technology, or B2B sales

  • Experience with new product launch and adoption management
  • LinkedIn proficiency and comfort with social selling

The Atria Health Institute is a membership-based primary and specialty health care practice with a focus on prevention and longevity. All care, including primary care, advanced screening and diagnostics, urgent care, specialty care, 24/7 home visits, and imaging is included in members’ annual fee.

After successfully opening our flagship Institute in New York in 2022 and expanding to South Florida in 2024, we are now bringing the Atria experience to the West Coast with the launch of our Los Angeles Institute in late spring 2026.

Atria Health is seeking a Senior Software Engineer for our DevOps team to help design, build, and operate the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and observability that the rest of engineering relies on every day.

This is an individual contributor role focused on:

  • Owning infrastructure, CI/CD, and automation initiatives end to end; from design through rollout, adoption, and iteration
  • Setting the patterns and standards that keep our systems reliable, observable, and secure as we scale
  • Reducing operational toil and raising the bar on developer productivity across engineering

You'll partner with the Tech Lead and other DevOps engineers to shape our infrastructure-as-code, build and release process, and monitoring and security posture — and you'll help define the standards others build on. You'll work closely with the Platform, Data Engineering, and domain product teams (Clinical Experience, Member Experience, and Care Delivery) to anticipate their needs and make their path to production smoother. You'll care deeply about both how we build and what we achieve, while working to accelerate the work of our client teams.

Infrastructure & Automation

  • Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform using Terraform, and help define the patterns and standards the team builds on.
  • Own and improve CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions to make deployments fast, safe, and repeatable.
  • Identify and eliminate sources of operational toil, building automation and tooling that scales across engineering.

Reliability & Observability

  • Establish meaningful monitoring, dashboards, and alerting in Datadog, and drive down alert noise across the team's systems.
  • Lead incident response within the on-call rotation, and drive postmortems and follow-ups that improve uptime for our applications.
  • Define and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for our core infrastructure and build systems, and hold the team to them.

Developer Enablement

  • Partner with product engineering teams on deployment pipelines, environment issues, and build troubleshooting, and proactively remove recurring friction.
  • Own preview and staging environments, including reliable data sync, masking, and cleanup routines so teams can test against realistic data.
  • Improve developer experience through better tooling, clear runbooks, and documentation.

Quality & Collaboration

  • Write well-tested, well-reviewed infrastructure code, and lead design reviews and RFCs with a pragmatic, operations-focused perspective.
  • Design systems and changes to meet the team's goals, weighing tradeoffs across reliability, performance, and security.
  • Give thoughtful code reviews and mentor other engineers through pairing, knowledge sharing, and documentation.

Tech Stack

  • Languages: TypeScript, Python, Bash
  • Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Terraform, Cloudflare
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions
  • Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis
  • Observability & Incident Management: Datadog, Sentry, Rootly
  • Integrations: Athena EMR, wearable platforms, third-party healthcare APIs

Requirements

Core Experience

  • ~5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure, or backend engineering in production environments.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure in at least one cloud provider (ideally Google Cloud Platform).
  • Track record of owning and shipping automation, pipelines, or infrastructure that made a team measurably more productive or reliable.
  • An enthusiasm for developer productivity and making our teams as impactful as possible.

Technical Skills

  • Deep experience with infrastructure-as-code (ideally Terraform) and building CI/CD pipelines (ideally GitHub Actions).

  • Strong instincts for monitoring and observability, and confident debugging across logs, traces, and metrics.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to leading incident response, on-call, and postmortem practices.

jobs.description:
About Scaling.com

Scaling.com helps established business owners 10x their companies in three years or less. We work with entrepreneurs doing $1 million or more in revenue who are ready to stop being the bottleneck and build a company that scales. Our creative library includes books, podcasts, keynotes, live events, member interviews, case studies, trainings, webinars, founder content, and years of verified customer stories.

Why This Role Exists

Scaling.com tests hundreds of paid hooks each week. When a hook or angle proves it can earn attention, you will turn it into a family of visual concepts for paid static ads. We are looking for a designer who has already produced conversion-focused creative at the volume and quality required to support multiple millions of dollars in monthly ad spend.

You will receive a winning hook or developed angle. You are not waiting for a finished layout. Your job is to decide how the idea should be visualized, which evidence or source material strengthens it, and how to create multiple distinct concepts that can be tested quickly.

This is one high-ownership in-house role, not a contractor-management position and not a brand-polish role.

Requirements

Your Core Workflow

Receive a winning hook, proven ad, or developed angle from the creative strategy team, along with winners, losers, hook data, creative references, and testing requests supplied by our Head of Content and paid-media team.

  • Understand why it worked and what the visual must communicate in the first second.
  • Use AI to search our content and proof library for relevant testimonials, founder material, book passages, customer stories, screenshots, frameworks, podcast moments, event excerpts, and visual references.
  • Develop several genuinely different visual concepts before polishing one direction. Continually contribute original concepts, competitor references, visual devices, and new test ideas to the team's shared concept pool.
  • Design paid statics around books, highlighted passages, frameworks, customer proof, founder material, screenshots, UGC-style assets, photography, and original visual metaphors.
  • Create meaningful variations across headline, hierarchy, composition, image choice, proof, framing, CTA, and visual hook.
  • Use AI to accelerate research, composition exploration, image cleanup, controlled asset generation, and repetitive production while retaining human control over the concept and final craft.
  • Ship clean, editable Figma files and platform-ready exports.
  • Review the winners, losers, hook data, and performance feedback supplied by our Head of Content and paid-media team, then turn the learning into new visual families.

What You Own

  • Visual concepting
  • Hook visualization
  • AI-assisted research
  • Proof visualization
  • Static ad design
  • Typography and hierarchy
  • Image and asset creation
  • Meaningful variations
  • Figma organization
  • Quality control
  • Winner iteration
  • Performance learning

What Your Day Actually Looks Like

  • Review winners, losers, hook data, creative references, and testing directions supplied by our Head of Content and paid-media team.
  • Select an approved hook or developed angle and generate several distinct visual approaches.
  • Search the content library with AI for the strongest supporting proof and imagery.
  • Build net-new concepts with disciplined hierarchy, typography, imagery, credibility, and platform-safe composition.
  • Create useful variations that isolate a real hypothesis.
  • Inspect legibility at feed size, source accuracy, visual artifacts, alignment, export settings, and file structure.
  • Use the supplied results and team analysis to build the next visual family from what worked.

What Success Looks Like

  • A proven hook becomes several distinct, testable visual concepts rather than one layout with color changes.
  • The idea reads immediately and the visual earns attention without cheapening trust.
  • Proof remains legible, accurate, and credible for a sophisticated business audience.
  • AI expands useful research and output without replacing design judgment.
  • Winning concepts are recombined and extended as the paid-media team scales them.
  • Editable files remain organized for rapid reuse and iteration.

What We Need to See

A portfolio of conversion-oriented paid ads with measurable outcomes such as spend, qualified leads, CTR, conversion, booked calls, revenue, or lift against a control. Your past work should demonstrate the volume, quality, and judgment required to sustain multiple millions of dollars in monthly ad spend.

  • Strong typography, hierarchy, composition, image craft, and concept range across more than one visual style.
  • Personal ownership of the concepts and editable files you show.
  • Experience designing for a sophisticated or high-consideration audience where credibility matters as much as stopping power.
  • A testing example that explains the hook, visual hypothesis, variants, controlled differences, result, and next decision.
  • A repeatable AI-enabled Figma or design workflow with a finished example and credible impact on speed or output.

This Role Is Not

  • An organic social designer
  • A brand-only portfolio role
  • A production artist waiting for layouts
  • Template swapping at volume
  • AI imagery without design
  • A contractor-management position
  • Beauty without response

How to Apply

Choose one paid static campaign you personally designed. Explain the winning hook or starting angle, the audience, the visual hypothesis, the concepts and variations, the measurable result, and what you created next. Include the numbers and show the editable working-file structure.

Then show us how AI materially improved the research, concepting, or production workflow without replacing your design judgment.

Benefits

  • PTO
  • US Holidays

jobs.description:
The University of Nevada, Las Vegas (UNLV) appreciates your interest in employment. We ask that you keep in mind the following when completing your application:

  • Once you start the application process you cannot save your work. Please ensure you have all required attachment(s) available to complete your application before you begin the process.
  • Required attachments are listed below on the posting. Your application will not be considered without the required attachments.
  • Please note that applications must be submitted prior to the close of the recruitment.

Once a recruitment has closed, applications will no longer be accepted. If you need assistance or have questions regarding the application process, please contact Human Resources at (702) 895-3504 or .

Job Description

The University of Nevada, Las Vegas invites applications for Research Administrator, Pre Award with the Office of Sponsored Programs (REMOTE) [R0153457]

ROLE of the POSITION

The Research Administrator, Pre Award assists faculty members, principal investigators, and department grant administrators in the development, preparation, and submission of sponsored proposals for research, service projects, and other creative activities. The following are a few responsibilities but not limited to: Prepare, review and submit proposals and ensure proposals are complete, in compliance with university and NSHE/UNLV policies, state and federal laws and regulations, and align with the policies, procedures and requirements of sponsoring agencies. Assist faculty and staff with the development and review of proposal budgets. Submit applications through federal and non-federal online submission platforms to funding agencies including but not limited to NASA, NIH, NSF, DOE, etc. Submit highly complex proposals to an extensive variety of agencies involving one or more of the following situations: multiple departments/units; multiple institutions (subawards); institutional cost-sharing; institutional commitment proposals; training grant applications, etc. Educate and train faculty and staff on all aspects of proposal development and submission. Utilize and become proficient in Cayuse for grant management activities.

Primary Job Duties

Proposal Development & Submission: Provide critical analysis and guidance in the review and interpretation of funding opportunity announcements. Answer inquiries involving an explanation of rules, regulations, and procedures that require knowledge of the individual program and a high degree of problem-solving, and analytical and creative thinking. Responsible for managing a significant volume of proposals. Prepare, review, and educate faculty and staff on detailed proposal budgets. Provide proposal component review on budgets, required templates, standard forms, etc. Provide guidance to faculty and staff regarding research administration issues, interpreting PP&Gs and regulations, etc. Educate and Provide Training to Faculty and Staff: Assist in educating faculty, departmental administrators and other staff members in understanding all areas of proposal development and submission including proposal and budget development, and unique sponsor requirements. Educate and train faculty and staff on the use of the Cayuse grants management system. Special Projects and Assignments: Work independently or with others on various projects such as surveys, policy/procedure development, form development, or special reports. Participate in and contribute to process improvements. Maintain Knowledge of Federal Regulations and Sponsor Requirements: Maintain expertise in federal, state and university regulations, policies, and procedures. Regularly review federal sponsor policies and proposal guides and participate in webinars, trainings, and/or conferences to remain current on ever changing regulatory compliance pertaining to grants and research administration.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Knowledge of the functional areas of sponsored program administration (Pre-award through Post-award) and a good general knowledge of the nature of research in all academic disciplines.

General understanding of the nature and requirements of sponsored project contracts, grants, cooperative agreements, requests for proposal or quote.

Understanding of research administration guidelines of Federal and non-Federal sponsors supporting research and educational activities.

Possess knowledge of federal procurement regulations, including the CFR & FAR, agency CFR/FAR implementations, and the Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 and audit regulations (Single Audit) that pertain to institutions of higher education.

Knowledgeable of sponsor-specific policies, intellectual property policy, conflict of interest requirements, publication rights, application of indirect cost rates and other complex concepts in research administration

Experience working in grant submission platforms such as ASSIST, Research.gov, Grants.gov, NSPIRES, etc. Experience with Excel and budget development.

Demonstrated customer service focus and an ability to communicate verbally and in writing clearly and effectively, presenting ideas, answering questions and documenting activities.

Strong analytical, organizational and interpersonal skills.

Self-starter, diplomatic, pro-active, ability to manage stress. Ability to handle multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Ability and capacity to work with a high degree of independence within a fast paced environment that is deadline driven and a multi-tasking operating environment.

Ability to interact and collaborate with multiple constituencies as well as excellent analytical, organizational, interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.

Demonstrated ability to interpret policies and act independently in a highly complex regulatory/legal environment.

BACKGROUND SCREENING

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre-employment criminal background and/or credit check.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

This position requires a Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university as recognized by the United States Department of Education and/or the Council on Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA) and related professional experience, related to research administration within non-profit, higher education, hospital, etc. Credentials must be obtained prior to the start date. 2-4 years of experience in job area. Central office operations related to working in a Pre Award office; to include proposal submission, review and interpretation of funding agencies/sponsors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Certified Research Administrator (CRA), through Research Administrators Certification Council (RACC) Previous Cayuse experience

COMMITMENT to DIVERSITY and CAMPUS VALUES

A successful candidate will support diversity, equity, and inclusiveness and contribute to a respectful, positive work environment. They will use our Campus Values to guide their decisions and actions and demonstrate our Rebel spirit.

SALARY

Salary range is $ 68,000 – $77,000.

BENEFITS OF WORKING AT UNLV

  • Competitive total rewards package including:
    • Paid time off, sick leave, and holidays
    • Excellent health insurance including medical, dental and vision
    • Comprehensive retirement plans and voluntary benefits programs
  • No state income tax
  • Tuition discounts at Nevada System of Higher Education (NSHE) schools
  • Tuition discounts for spouses, domestic partners, and dependents

PERKS & PROGRAMS

  • Employee recognition and appreciation programs
  • UNLV athletics ticket discounts
  • Statewide employee purchase program discounts
  • RebelCard discounts on and off campus
  • Wellness programming for all UNLV faculty and staff at no cost
  • Opportunity for career advancements to leadership roles
  • Connect with colleagues with shared interests
  • Personal and professional development opportunities
  • A comprehensive onboarding program,Rebels: Onboard
  • Support and resources available for veteran applicants — contact  or visit our Veterans Webpage.

HOW TO APPLY

Submit a letter of interest, a detailed resume listing qualifications and experience, and the names, addresses, and telephone numbers of at least three professional references who may be contacted. References will not be contacted until the search chair notifies you in advance.

Applicants should fully describe their qualifications and experience, with specific reference to each of the minimum and preferred qualifications because this is the information on which the initial review of materials will be based. Materials should be addressed to Michele Padilla, Search Committee Chair.

Although this position will remain open until filled, review of candidates’ materials will begin on Monday, October 5th, 2026.

Applications must be submitted electronically through Workday. Please note that emailed materials will not be accepted.

Veterans are encouraged to apply. UNLV values the skills of those who have served. Learn more at Veterans Webpage or contact for support.

For assistance with the application process, please review instructions on How to Apply. For further assistance contact UNLV Human Resources at (702) 895-3504 or .

SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS FOR INTERNAL NSHE CANDIDATES

UNLV employees or employees within the Nevada System of Higher Education (NSHE) MUST use the “Find Jobs” process within Workday to find and apply for jobs at UNLV and other NSHE Institutions. Once you log into Workday, type "Find Jobs" in the search box which will navigate to the internal job posting site. Locate this specific job posting by typing the job requisition number, “R0153457” in the search box.

If you complete an application outside of the internal application process, your application will be returned and you will have to reapply as an internal applicant which may delay your application.

PROFILE of the UNIVERSITY

Founded in 1957, UNLV is a doctoral-degree-granting institution comprised of approximately 30,000 students and more than 3,600 faculty and staff. To date, UNLV has conferred more than 152,000 degrees, producing more than 130,000 alumni around the world. UNLV is classified by the Carnegie Foundation for the Advancement of Teaching as an R1 research university with very high research activity, and is a recipient of the Carnegie Classification for Community Engagement. The university is committed to recruiting and retaining top students and faculty, educating the region's diversifying population and workforce, driving economic activity through increased research and community partnerships, and creating an academic health center for Southern Nevada that includes the launch of a new UNLV School of Medicine. UNLV is located on a 332-acre main campus and two satellite campuses in Southern Nevada.

Here at UNLV, we have come together and created one of the most affirmative and dynamic academic environments in the country. UNLV sits in the top spot in U.S. News & World Report's annual listing of the nation's most diverse universities for undergraduates. Type: Full-time

Salary: Up to $3000

Job description:

Team Summary

You'll be joining a digital marketing agency that is small but mighty growth team-a tight-knit group where no two days are the same and every detail matters. We master the art of professional juggling, seamlessly managing client relationships and campaigns because when clients trust us with substantial marketing plans and budgets, 100% accuracy isn't just preferred, it's non-negotiable. We're seeking someone with proven agency experience who understands the fast-paced, client-focused nature of digital marketing agencies-someone equally comfortable serving as a client's trusted strategic advisor and driving new account growth-and who can hit the ground running with our SEO and PPC operations. To succeed in this role, you should anticipate a balanced workload where approximately 50% of your time is dedicated to client management, 20% to internal management, and 30% to new sales efforts.

Responsibilities

Strategic Planning and Execution:

  • Contribute to the development of the company’s long-term strategy by providing operational insights and recommendations.
  • Translate strategic goals into actionable plans for the operations team.

Oversee Day-to-Day Operations:

  • Provide leadership and direction for daily operational activities across departments.
  • Monitor performance metrics, ensuring operational goals align with the company’s strategic objectives.
  • Address operational challenges promptly to maintain seamless workflow and productivity.
  • Manage resource allocation to optimize efficiency and support business priorities.

Drive Initiatives for Efficient Processes:

  • Identify inefficiencies in current workflows and implement solutions to improve productivity and cost-effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to streamline operations and eliminate redundancies.
  • Lead the adoption of tools and technologies to enhance operational efficiency and reporting.

Develop Processes for Consistency:

  • Establish standardized processes, procedures, and policies to ensure consistency and scalability across operations.
  • Regularly review and update processes to align with evolving business needs and industry best practices.
  • Ensure employees are trained and equipped to adhere to established operational guidelines.

Oversee Production to Ensure Client Satisfaction:

  • Supervise production teams and processes to meet client requirements and maintain high-quality standards.
  • Monitor production timelines to ensure on-time delivery of goods or services.
  • Implement quality control measures and continuously seek client feedback to enhance satisfaction.
  • Act as a liaison between production teams and clients to resolve issues and address concerns effectively.

Team Leadership and Development:

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing operations teams to support company goals.
  • Foster a collaborative and results-oriented culture that encourages accountability and innovation.
  • Provide regular feedback, coaching, and professional development opportunities for team members.

Performance Analysis and Reporting:

  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate operational efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Prepare and present performance reports to the executive team, highlighting successes, challenges, and areas for improvement.
  • Use data-driven insights to guide decision-making and strategic planning.

Risk Management and Compliance:

  • Identify potential operational risks and implement strategies to mitigate them.
  • Ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and company policies across all operational activities.
  • Maintain and enforce safety standards to protect employees and assets.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Partner with leadership in finance, marketing, sales, and other departments to align operational goals with overall business strategies.
  • Facilitate communication and coordination between teams to ensure smooth execution of company initiatives.

Budget Management:

  • Develop and manage operational budgets, ensuring alignment with company financial goals.
  • Monitor expenses and implement cost-control measures to maintain profitability.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement by encouraging innovation and adaptability.
  • Stay informed about industry trends and emerging technologies to keep the company competitive.

Skills and Competencies

  • Strategic and Operational Leadership: Ability to translate company goals into clear production priorities, workflows, and measurable outcomes.
  • Team and Resource Management: Ability to develop high-performing teams and effectively manage capacity, workloads, deadlines, and accountability.
  • Process and Quality Management: Ability to improve operational efficiency while maintaining consistent quality and reducing errors, delays, and rework.
  • Data-Driven Collaboration: Strong financial, analytical, communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional decision-making skills.

Requirements

Preferred Qualifications

***MUST HAVE previous experience working at a digital marketing agency***

  • Minimum 3-5 years of proven experience in a digital marketing agency environment, preferably with home improvement or contractor clients
  • Leadership experience in production, operations, project management, or service delivery, preferably within a digital marketing agency or client-service environment.
  • Proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams, multiple client projects, production schedules, and team capacity.
  • Experience developing scalable workflows, quality-control procedures, performance metrics, and operational improvement initiatives.
  • Experience managing departmental budgets, labor costs, resource allocation, utilization, and production profitability.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, operations management, project management, marketing, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with SEO, paid advertising, website development, reporting, and automation.
  • Experience managing remote or internationally distributed teams and using project-management, workflow, and reporting platforms.
  • Familiarity with process documentation, artificial intelligence, automation tools, or relevant project-management and operations certifications.

What We Offer

Work Environment

  • Remote Flexibility: Fully remote position.
  • Growth Opportunity: Join a fast-growing company with significant advancement potential
  • Values-Driven Culture: Work in an environment that champions Ownership, Continuous Improvement, Adaptability, and Drive
  • Inclusive Team: Collaborative, supportive team environment that encourages diverse perspectives

Benefits

  • Client Relationship: You will be directly working with the client. This means that you will communicate with the client, provide services, and address any client-related matters independently.
  • Payments: All payments for your services will be handled by the client. Elevate and Delegate is not involved in processing your payroll. Your salary will directly go to you.
  • Vacation Leaves and Holidays: While we may have recommendations or guidelines regarding vacation leaves and holidays, the decision is entirely at the discretion of the client. You are expected to align your schedule with the client’s business needs and any specific policies or preferences they may have in this regard.

---

Application Process:

  • As part of your application, you’ll be asked to record your responses to the initial interview questions through a Loom video (questions & instructions are in the application page).
  • Our team will carefully review your submission, and if shortlisted, we’ll share your responses with the client for their review and next steps.
  • Please treat this recording as you would a real interview:
    • Come prepared and make sure you’re clearly visible on camera.
    • Record your answers in a quiet, well-lit, and clutter-free space with a stable internet connection.
  • We’re excited to get to know you better! Show us your personality and strengths. We encourage you to answer authentically and in your own words, without reading from a script or using AI tools.

jobs.description:
We build cloud CPaaS/CCaaS infrastructure - the routing, messaging and real-time layer that contact centres run on. High traffic, event-driven services, and a UI that has to stay correct while thousands of live conversations move through it.

We're hiring a senior engineer for a team where AI agents are part of the normal development loop, not a pilot. You'll own features end-to-end across a Go backend and a React/TypeScript frontend, and you'll be accountable for everything you ship — including the parts an agent wrote.

This is not a prompt-engineering role. It's a senior engineering role where AI-assisted delivery is the default working method.

Requirements

What will you do at MMDSmart?

  • Own features end-to-end across Go backend and React/TypeScript frontend;
  • Design and develop solutions for high-load and distributed production systems;
  • Use AI coding agents as an integral part of your everyday development workflow;
  • Guide AI agents, review and verify their output, and take ownership of the final result;
  • Build and evolve backend services, APIs, frontend functionality, and external integrations;
  • Investigate complex production issues and drive them to resolution;
  • Contribute to architecture decisions, technical discussions, and system improvements;
  • Help improve our codebase and development practices to make AI-assisted engineering more effective.

You are a perfect match if you have:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience and strong Senior-level engineering fundamentals;
  • Strong hands-on production experience with Go - 4 years of experience;
  • Practical experience with React and/or TypeScript; you don’t need to be a frontend expert, but you should be comfortable working with frontend code;
  • Hands-on experience with high-load and distributed production systems;
  • Experience designing, building, and debugging production services and APIs;
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, or similar - beyond simple autocomplete;
  • Ability to use AI to work effectively across different parts of the stack while critically reviewing and verifying its output;
  • Strong engineering judgement, ownership, and ability to make technical decisions independently.

Our Tech Stack:

  • Backend: Go, microservices, REST APIs, GraphQL
  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Zustand / Redux Toolkit, WebSocket / SSE
  • Event-driven: Kafka, NATS / JetStream, RabbitMQ, event-driven architecture
  • Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB
  • Infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code
  • Observability & Performance: structured logging, metrics, tracing, profiling, high-load and concurrency tooling

  • Polyglot persistence: Redis for caching and ephemeral state, PostgreSQL where a document model is the wrong fit; plus the judgement to tell the difference. MongoDB Atlas or self-managed cluster operations.
  • Internal tooling, evals or automation built on LLM APIs.
  • Open-source contributions, especially in Go.

What you get:

  • An AI-first engineering environment where AI is part of real production development;
  • The opportunity to use AI to work across the full stack and expand beyond your primary expertise;
  • Work on high-load communication products with real business impact;
  • A team where Senior Engineers influence technical decisions and architecture;

Benefits

Embrace the opportunity to work in a company that cares about:

Your Happiness: Enjoy the company of cool teammates, a friendly atmosphere, a strong mentorship, and a variety of bonuses & corporate gifts.

Your Career: Focus on your professional development in a supportive environment.

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you’ll be responsible for:

As an Accountant, you will take end to end ownership of assigned accounting areas across operating costs, cash transactions, payroll and employee related costs, share based compensation, fixed assets and intangible assets, including internally developed intangible assets. You will own the accounting, close and controls for your areas, while developing a strong understanding of the underlying data and processes and using AI and automation to improve quality, efficiency and scalability.

  • Analyse balance sheet and P&L movements, get to the root cause of unexpected results and provide clear, evidence based commentary on key drivers.

  • Develop a strong understanding of the business activity, data and systems behind your accounting areas. Approach unfamiliar or non routine transactions with curiosity, research the accounting and form a point of view under relevant U.S. GAAP, escalating complex matters where appropriate.

  • Prepare supporting schedules, financial reporting and assigned SEC disclosures, and perform relevant ICFR and SOX controls with high quality documentation and testing readiness.

  • Take ownership of problems and drive them through to resolution, working across Finance and the wider business to improve upstream data, processes and controls rather than simply addressing issues at month end.

  • Support audit, tax and compliance requirements, proactively resolving issues and maintaining high quality supporting documentation.

  • Use AI and automation as part of how you work: experiment with new tools, challenge manual processes and identify, design and implement solutions that improve the speed, quality and scalability of accounting, while maintaining appropriate human judgement, governance and controls.

What you’ll bring to Circle:

We are looking for someone who combines strong accounting fundamentals with curiosity, judgement, ownership and a bias for action. You will enjoy solving problems where the answer is not immediately obvious, communicate a clear point of view and continually look for better ways to work.

Core Requirements:

  • 2+ years of relevant accounting or audit experience.

  • ACA, CPA, ACCA or equivalent professional accounting qualification, with.

  • Strong problem solving skills and curiosity, with the ability to work through ambiguity, investigate large or complex datasets, identify root causes and drive issues through to resolution.

  • High ownership, resilience and bias for action. You are comfortable taking initiative, making progress with incomplete information and learning quickly when faced with something unfamiliar.

  • High standards for accuracy and execution, with the ability to prioritise competing demands and deliver quality work at pace.

  • Clear, structured communication skills, with the ability to explain issues, articulate a point of view and collaborate effectively with Finance and non Finance stakeholders.

  • A strong AI and automation mindset, with hands on experience using AI, automation or data tools to solve problems or improve how work gets done. You are curious about emerging tools, willing to experiment and able to apply appropriate judgement, governance and controls.

  • Strong understanding of audit, ICFR and SOX requirements and experience working effectively with internal and external auditors.

  • Ability to learn quickly and collaborate constructively with a global, cross functional team across multiple time zones.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience in a leading professional services firm and/or a U.S. public company, including exposure to SEC reporting and SOX.

  • Experience in digital assets, payments, FinTech, technology or financial services industry. Understanding of blockchain technology and digital assets is a plus.

  • Experience in one or more areas such as operating costs, payroll and employee related costs, share based compensation, fixed assets, internally developed intangible assets or lease accounting

  • Experience with Oracle Fusion or another large scale ERP and practical experience with analytical, AI or automation tools.

Valkyrie Aero is seeking a software engineer to develop computer vision and sensor fusion software for an airborne mission system. Software Engineers in this role develop real-time detection, classification, and tracking software, fuse multiple sensor inputs into a single track picture, and deliver track state to the control software and operator interface. This includes model development and evaluation, inference optimization for embedded hardware, and the dataset pipeline. This is a fully remote position.

  • Develop and maintain the dataset pipeline, including collection, labeling, curation, augmentation, synthetic data, and retraining from field data
  • Establish the evaluation framework and metrics, measured under operational conditions
  • Deliver track state (position, velocity, identity, uncertainty) to control software and the operator interface

  • Work with hardware engineers on camera, optics, and sensor selection
  • Support integration and test, including diagnosing and resolving issues on target hardware

  • Professional experience developing real-time computer vision and multi-object tracking pipelines

•Experience with sensor fusion

•Proficiency in Python and C++

  • Experience working with hardware and real-time data

•Must be a U.S. citizen

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with PyTorch, TensorRT, ONNX, DeepStream, or GStreamer
  • Experience with thermal, infrared, or multispectral imaging
  • Experience with multi-modal sensor fusion across EO/IR, radar, or acoustic sensors
  • Experience with synthetic data generation and sim-to-real

•Experience deploying on NVIDIA Jetson

  • Experience with embedded Linux and device I/O (cameras, gimbals, sensors)

•Experience with gRPC or WebSockets

  • Experience in defense or other safety-critical computer vision

•Personal robotics or hardware projects
