Job Description

A bit more about this role:


Devoted Medical was founded on the belief that if we treat each member like we would our loved ones, we can meaningfully improve healthcare experiences and outcomes for some of America’s most vulnerable patient populations. The Complex Care Department is at the heart of this goal: we are a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary team of physicians, nurse practitioners, case managers, social work care managers, community health workers, and outreach coordinators united by our mission to build a better care delivery system for Devoted’s most complex members. Through a mixture of in-home and virtual interventions, we provide whole-person clinical, social and logistical support for patients with complex chronic conditions, frail elders, and patients at high risk of hospital admissions. Our outreach team plays the vital role of program ambassador, resourceful connector, and scheduling logistics maestro, working in close partnership with the rest of our multidisciplinary team to ensure we’re treating each patient as we would our own family.


The Manager of Outreach and Engagement position is an amazing opportunity for a super energetic, detail-oriented servant leader & advocate, a creative problem solver who inspires & enables those they lead by deeply understanding their team’s day-to-day reality, and continuously anticipates & demolishes barriers to individual & program-wide success. As a manager, you will directly supervise outreach coordinator supervisors and will be responsible for the performance of the Complex Care Outreach team. You will work closely with Complex Care Department leadership, frontline managers for interdisciplinary roles, our non-clinical trainer, and cross-functional teams across Devoted Medical to optimize outreach and engagement workflows across Complex Care. This includes playing a critical role in team growth planning, conducting audits and tracking team performance, and providing thoughtful feedback to the supervisors with guidance on process improvement to the Complex Care leadership team. This role is both a people leader and an operator. You'll coach and develop our continuously growing team, and you'll own the operational engine behind it: analyzing performance, refining workflows, and making daily operations run smoothly across the Complex Care programs.


Your responsibilities and impact will include:

  • Leading a team of supervisors and outreach coordinators, fostering a collaborative environment, and supporting professional growth through coaching and goal setting.
  • Developing and monitoring an effective data-driven performance management system to track progress against goals and identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
  • Designing, documenting, and refining workflows to make outreach operations effective and efficient and improving engagement across programs.
  • Working closely alongside other leaders in the Complex Care department to ensure cohesive interdisciplinary leadership and achieving shared goals.
  • Being the primary point of contact for the Complex Care Outreach team, independently resolving most people-management and operational questions.
  • Partnering with product and technology teams to improve tooling, including automation and AI-assisted opportunities.

Required skills and experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in service, contact center, digital support, or healthcare operations, with accountability for quality and productivity
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience managing front-line teams
  • Analytical Skills: Confident using analytical tools and data to understand operations, set quantitative targets and track goals
  • Tech-Savvy: Quick to learn new workflows and tools and curious about automation and AI tools that improve the patient experience
  • Communication: Clear, empathetic communication and the ability to communicate operational updates and risks to leadership

Desired skills and experience:

  • Scaling Teams: Proven ability to build, mentor, and scale operational teams in a fast-growing environment
  • Building Analytical Tools: Demonstrated ability to develop and implement analytical tools (e.g., create dashboards)
  • AI Experience: Prior experience designing and deploying AI tools is a plus

Salary range: $73,000 - $98,000 annually

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. Peraton is seeking a Security Engineering Lead to provide technical leadership for the design, implementation, and evolution of enterprise security capabilities across complex federal environments. This role leads security architecture and engineering initiatives that protect cloud infrastructure, applications, networks, identities, and sensitive data while supporting mission requirements and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate brings demonstrated experience engineering security solutions for FedRAMP High environments and implementing Zero Trust architectures at federal enterprise scale. The role requires the ability to translate security requirements into scalable technical controls, integrate security capabilities across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, and collaborate with architecture, infrastructure, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, compliance, and operations teams.

Experience applying artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, or automation to cybersecurity use cases is a plus.

We bring together a community of 33,000+ procurement leaders from 750+ leading global companies to exchange insights, accelerate decision-making, and drive strategic success. Through globally recognized events, we foster meaningful discussions and connections featuring C-suite speakers from iconic brands.

Job Description

As the Managing Director for APAC, this role plays a pivotal leadership role in the continued expansion of both Procurement Leaders and the broader World 50 Group across the Asia-Pacific region. Operating with a 70/30 split in responsibilities, the role sits at the intersection of product delivery, community strategy, commercial objectives, and regional market expansion.

Responsibilities

1. Procurement Leaders Regional Strategy & Execution (70%)

  • Senior Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to regional CPOs and executive teams, facilitating peer connections and guiding strategic procurement initiatives.
  • Commercial Enablement: Partner closely with commercial directors and account management to deliver high-impact advisory experiences that showcase product value and accelerate pipeline conversion.
  • Market Insights: Aggregate regional market trends and member feedback to inform global product development and content strategies.
  • Member Value & Retention: Support regional onboarding, engagement planning, and custom value delivery to ensure maximum member satisfaction and high renewal rates.

2. World 50 Group Regional Pioneer & Growth (30%)

  • Community Building: Mobilize and activate senior executives across APAC, building a strong sense of regional identity and belonging within World 50.
  • Brand Elevation: Partner with the global team on regional communications, external positioning, and market presence to position World 50 as the premier peer network for C-suite leaders in APAC.
  • Ambassador & Partner Management: Drive the strategy for regional executive advocates and partner ecosystems to generate organic growth and referral pipelines.

3. Cross-Brand Network Activation & Events

  • Executive Event Chairing: Host, moderate, and chair physical and virtual executive convenings, ensuring world-class facilitation and dialogue.
  • Program Execution: Partner with global content teams to execute bespoke APAC event calendars that align with global themes while reflecting local nuances.

Key Success Metrics

The success of the Managing Director will be evaluated against both operational activities and explicit quantitative outcomes:

  1. Member Retention & Growth: Achieving specified target renewal rates, net member expansion, and engagement depth metrics across APAC for both PL and W50.
  2. Commercial Enablement Impact: Measured contribution to regional sales pipeline speed, win-rate lift on deals with advisory involvement, and expansion revenue.
  3. W50 Identity Launch: Successful delivery of the 12–18 month W50 APAC roadmap, measured by regional member attendance, ambassador activation, and network cohesion.
  4. Executive Relationship Quality: High Net Promoter Scores (NPS) and qualitative value feedback from regional C-suite participants.

Candidate Profile & Experience

  • Consistent track record of delivering above-target performance across bookings, revenue, and EBITDA.
  • International experience, with a proven ability to operate successfully across different countries and cultures.
  • Strong analytical and operational capabilities, including the ability to prioritise based on data and translate insights into effective execution.
  • Senior executive engagement, with a track record of personally building and maintaining relationships with senior stakeholders.
  • High emotional intelligence (EQ) and a demonstrated ability to build trust, influence others, and create strong followership.
  • Proven people leadership, including coaching and mentoring, making tough talent decisions, and building an A+ team.
  • Exceptional cross-functional collaboration, with the ability to optimize performance at both the individual business unit level and across the broader business.
  • Entrepreneurial building and scaler who has demonstrated success in scaling established networks (Procurement Leaders) and building new market propositions from the ground up (World 50).
  • Exceptional executive presence with proven capability in moderating C-suite roundtables and panel discussions.
  • Regional mobility that allows for regular regional travel to convene executive networks, chair key market events, and build high-trust relationships with C-suite members and partners across APAC key hubs.

Why World 50 Group?

We are driven by a shared commitment to create impact, learn, and belong. As we aggressively expand across the Asia-Pacific region, we offer the unique opportunity to scale an established powerhouse (Procurement Leaders) while pioneering the World 50 proposition.

Here is what we expect from our APAC leader, and what we provide to help you thrive:

What You Give (Our DNA)

  • Entrepreneurial Builder: You are member-obsessed and thrive in 0-1 market launches. You adapt to APAC’s fragmented markets by testing, learning, and rapidly iterating to aggressively capture market share.
  • Cross-Functional Catalyst: You co-create as one team, rejecting the "lone wolf" mentality. You effortlessly optimize synergy between your regional team and Global HQ, driving commercial outcomes without friction.
  • Credible, Humble Advisor: You act as a true peer to regional CPOs and executives. You stay curious, listen deeply, and seamlessly translate executive advisory into commercial leverage to advance deals.

What You Get (Our Promise)

  • Unparalleled C-Suite Exposure: Direct access to top executives across the Asia-Pacific region. You will chair exclusive convenings, moderate roundtables, and shape strategic initiatives for the region’s most influential leaders.
  • Legacy-Defining Impact: A safe, human-centered culture where you have the mandate to architect our 12–18 month regional roadmap and build a market presence that truly matters.
  • Commercial Growth & Rewards: A highly rewarding compensation structure (AUD 243,210 TCC) tied directly to your ability to drive above-target performance, pipeline acceleration, and massive expansion revenue.
  • True Autonomy & Flexibility: The trust to build your market from an Australia-based remote setup, balancing necessary regional travel across key APAC hubs with your personal and team needs.

Aptive Resources is seeking a Program Analyst, Sr to support research program operations for the Department of Veterans Affairs Office of Research and Development (ORD) Health Systems Research team, supporting the Field Enterprise Research Support Services contract. The role supports ORD’s implementation science and health systems research activities by providing program-level coordination, operational analysis, and performance tracking across project processing, peer review coordination, special projects, budget-related workflows, and data management functions.

This position supports day-to-day program operations by leading and coordinating project workflows, supporting review and processing of project and budget requests, synthesizing program data, and identifying opportunities to improve program effectiveness. The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to independently manage workstreams, coordinate across stakeholders, and support program-level decision-making through analysis and recommendations in a structured, fast-paced environment. The role also serves as a day-to-day coordination partner to HSR leadership, supporting project management, special projects, and scientific review processes. This position requires strong client interaction skills and a demonstrated ability to work autonomously while supporting multiple program priorities and stakeholders. An ideal candidate will be a self-directed learner who can quickly get up to speed through independent research, with guides and broad orientation provided by the client team. Final programmatic and scientific decisions rest with VA leadership; this role provides coordination, analysis, and recommendations in support of those decisions.

This is a 100% remote position.

  • Prescreen, review, and facilitate processing of project modification requests, budget requests, and project initiation materials related to implementation science work and/or peer review research initiatives.

  • Assist HSR staff in understanding and applying reporting guidelines for funded projects, including preparing job aids and reminders.
  • Support special projects and cross-team priorities for HSR leadership, including planning, milestone tracking, and status updates.

jobs.title: SOC Analyst (12:00–21:00 UTC)
jobs.excerpt: About the jobThe SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center.
jobs.description:
About the job

The SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center. This position reports to the SOC Lead. The role goes beyond acknowledging alerts: the focus is on understanding what each alert means, investigating suspicious activity end to end, responding to real threats, and handing over cleanly between regions so that nothing is lost across shifts. The ideal candidate has solid SOC experience, a strong investigative mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, triage, and analyze security alerts and events from the organization's security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

  • Investigate security incidents end to end, from initial triage through analysis, containment, eradication, and post-incident documentation, coordinating with relevant teams throughout.

  • Determine the scope, severity, and impact of security events, separating true positives from false positives and escalating confirmed incidents according to defined procedures.

  • Execute response actions within the security platforms, such as isolating endpoints, blocking indicators, disabling compromised accounts, and enforcing access restrictions.

  • Ensure structured, high-quality shift handovers across regions in the follow-the-sun model, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

  • Proactively threat hunt across endpoint, network, and log data to uncover suspicious activity that existing detections may have missed, mapping findings to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Provide feedback on detection quality and contribute to the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules to reduce noise and improve coverage.

  • Enrich investigations with threat intelligence, including indicators of compromise, attacker techniques, and emerging campaigns relevant to the organization.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks.

  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

  • Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, triaging alerts and investigating security incidents in a production environment.

  • Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

  • Experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, BTL1, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and across time zones.

About You

You are a hands-on security analyst who wants to understand what is really happening behind an alert, rather than only closing tickets. You dig into the data, follow the evidence, and know when and how to escalate. If you have also stood up or tuned the tools you work with, or written your own detections, even better. You are structured, reliable, and comfortable working independently in a remote, follow-the-sun team, and you take pride in leaving a clear handover for the next shift. You are curious about new threats and technologies, and you enjoy working closely with both technical teams and end users to raise the security bar across the environment.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe are looking for a Patient Services Representative based in the Philippines to join our patient experience team.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Patient Services Representative based in the Philippines to join our patient experience team.

This role is focused on one thing: listening to our patients and understanding their experience.

You will contact existing patients after their appointments to ask how their experience went, whether they have any feedback, and if there is anything they would like our team to know. You are not expected to solve every problem or provide clinical guidance. Your primary responsibility is to seek to understand, listen carefully, document accurately, and communicate what you learn.

This is an excellent position for someone with experience in phone-based customer service, reception, concierge services, sales, hospitality, or patient/customer support who is naturally curious, empathetic, organized, and comfortable speaking with people over the phone.

What You'll Do

  • Make outbound calls to existing patients following their appointments

  • Ask patients about their appointment and overall experience

  • Use open-ended questions to encourage honest feedback

  • Listen carefully and allow the patient to fully explain their experience

  • Identify themes, concerns, compliments, suggestions, and opportunities for improvement

  • Take clear and accurate notes during each conversation

  • Document the outcome of every call in our database/CRM

  • Accurately categorize and record patient feedback

  • Escalate information to the appropriate internal team when something requires follow-up

  • Maintain a professional, warm, and conversational tone throughout every interaction

  • Complete call and documentation requirements consistently and accurately

  • Protect patient privacy and follow all company policies and procedures

What This Role Is NOT

This is not a heavy problem-solving or troubleshooting position.

You are not expected to have an answer for every patient concern. In fact, one of the most important skills for this role is knowing when not to jump into solution mode.

Your job is to:

Listen → Understand → Document → Escalate When Appropriate

The goal is to collect honest, useful information from our patients so our team can understand what is happening across the patient experience and identify areas where we can improve.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Fluent spoken and written English, minimal accent

  • Excellent English comprehension

  • Strong phone communication skills

  • Previous experience in phone-based customer service, sales, reception, concierge, hospitality, or a similar customer-facing role

  • Comfortable making outbound calls

  • Excellent listening skills

  • Strong note-taking and documentation abilities

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented

  • Able to accurately enter information into a database or CRM

  • Strong computer and typing skills

  • Professional and friendly phone presence

  • Ability to remain calm and professional when speaking with frustrated or unhappy customers

  • Reliable internet connection and a professional remote-work environment

The Ideal Candidate

You are someone who:

  • Genuinely enjoys talking to people

  • Knows how to make someone feel heard

  • Asks good follow-up questions without interrogating the patient

  • Can distinguish between what a patient said and what you assume they meant

  • Takes thorough but concise notes

  • Is comfortable having conversations that don't follow a script exactly

  • Doesn't become defensive when receiving negative feedback

  • Is naturally curious and wants to understand the "why" behind someone's experience

  • Can recognize when something should be escalated rather than attempting to solve it independently

  • Is highly consistent with documentation and follow-through

  • Understands that accurate data collection is just as important as the conversation itself

Example of the Approach We Want

Instead of:

"I'm sorry you had a bad experience. Let me see if I can fix that for you."

We want someone who can say:

"I'm sorry to hear that. I'd really like to understand what happened. Can you tell me a little more about your experience?"

Then listen, ask appropriate follow-up questions, document the details, and make sure the information gets to the right person.

Experience That Translates Well

Candidates with backgrounds such as the following may be especially successful in this position:

  • Call center/customer service

  • Medical or healthcare reception

  • Patient services

  • Concierge services

  • Hospitality

  • Hotel front desk

  • Sales or inside sales

  • Account management

  • Customer success

  • Appointment scheduling

  • Client relations

  • BPO/customer experience

  • Administrative support

Healthcare experience is helpful but not required.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Quality and accuracy of patient notes

  • Completion of assigned outbound calls

  • Professionalism and communication quality

  • Accuracy of information entered into the database

  • Ability to effectively capture patient sentiment and feedback

  • Appropriate identification and escalation of issues

  • Reliability and consistency

  • Ability to follow established workflows and documentation standards

Schedule

Full-Time | Remote | Philippines

Specific working hours will be discussed during the interview process and may be aligned with Eastern Standard Time U.S. business hours.

Why Join Us?

This role provides an opportunity to directly influence how we understand and improve the patient experience. The information you collect will help our team identify patterns, recognize what we're doing well, and understand where patients may be experiencing friction.

If you are a great listener, excellent communicator, organized note-taker, and genuinely interested in people, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to join our Patient Services team.

Email Marketing Specialist – HubSpot, Klaviyo, Automation & Campaigns

Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Email Marketing Specialist to build, execute, and optimize email campaigns, automated workflows, and audience segmentation strategies that drive engagement, conversions, and revenue.

This is a hands-on email marketing role where you’ll own the full lifecycle — from campaign creation and copywriting to automation, list management, deliverability, testing, and performance analysis.

If you know how to turn email into a measurable growth and revenue channel, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Email Campaign Development & Execution

  • Build and launch email campaigns using platforms such as:
    • HubSpot
    • Klaviyo
    • Marketo
    • Mailchimp
    • ActiveCampaign
  • Write compelling:
    • Subject lines
    • Email copy
    • Calls-to-action (CTAs)
  • Tailor messaging to different audience segments and lifecycle stages
  • Build and edit responsive email templates
  • Make basic HTML/CSS adjustments when required
  • Ensure campaigns are tested and error-free before launch

Email Automation & Nurture Workflows

  • Build automated email sequences and behavioral workflows
  • Create and optimize:
    • Lead nurture sequences
    • Drip campaigns
    • Re-engagement campaigns
    • Abandoned cart flows
    • Lifecycle campaigns
  • Configure triggers, timing, conditions, and audience rules
  • Test automation workflows to ensure accurate execution
  • Continuously improve sequences based on engagement and conversion data

Audience Segmentation & List Management

  • Manage email databases ranging from 20K to 200K+ contacts
  • Segment audiences based on:
    • Persona
    • Lifecycle stage
    • Engagement
    • Geography
    • Customer behavior
  • Maintain clean and organized contact data
  • Remove or suppress bounced, inactive, and high-risk contacts
  • Protect overall list quality and sender reputation

Deliverability & Compliance

  • Monitor email deliverability, inbox placement, and sender reputation
  • Support configuration and management of:
    • SPF
    • DKIM
    • DNS settings
    • Suppression lists
  • Monitor bounce rates, spam complaints, and unsubscribe activity
  • Maintain compliance with applicable requirements including:
    • CAN-SPAM
    • GDPR
    • CCPA

Testing & Performance Optimization

  • Run structured A/B tests across:
    • Subject lines
    • Email copy
    • CTAs
    • Send times
    • Content variations
  • Track key performance metrics including:
    • Open rates
    • Click-through rates (CTR)
    • Conversions
    • Unsubscribe rates
    • Bounce rates
  • Identify underperforming campaigns and implement improvements
  • Use performance data to continuously improve engagement and conversion

Reporting & Revenue Attribution

  • Build weekly and monthly email performance reports
  • Track conversions and revenue attribution across ESP, CRM, and analytics platforms
  • Identify trends and opportunities within campaign data
  • Translate performance results into actionable recommendations
  • Share insights with marketing and sales teams

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional email marketing experience
  • Hands-on proficiency with at least one major ESP:
    • HubSpot
    • Klaviyo
    • Marketo
    • Mailchimp
    • ActiveCampaign
  • Experience building email campaigns and automated workflows
  • Strong audience segmentation and list management skills
  • Strong email copywriting skills
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for email templates
  • Strong proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets, including:
    • VLOOKUPs
    • Pivot tables
    • Data segmentation
  • Understanding of email marketing metrics and optimization
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Strong written and verbal English communication
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing databases of 50K+ contacts
  • Experience with deliverability tools such as:
    • Litmus
    • GlockApps
    • Postmark
  • Experience in SaaS, e-commerce, or B2B services
  • Experience integrating ESPs with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot
  • Experience with Google Analytics, Looker, or marketing dashboards
  • Strong understanding of revenue attribution and lifecycle marketing

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You understand email as a performance and revenue channel, not simply a communication tool
  • You’re comfortable building campaigns from start to finish
  • You combine strong copywriting with analytical thinking
  • You understand segmentation, automation, and customer lifecycle marketing
  • You pay close attention to deliverability and database health
  • You test continuously and use data to improve performance
  • You’re organized and comfortable managing multiple campaigns simultaneously

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by reviewing campaign performance and deliverability metrics, then build or optimize an upcoming email campaign.

Throughout the day, you could write email copy, create audience segments, troubleshoot automation workflows, clean contact lists, run A/B tests, and analyze conversion performance.

You’ll also monitor automated nurture sequences and prepare reports showing how email contributes to engagement, conversions, and revenue.

In short: you own the systems, campaigns, automation, and optimization that turn email into a scalable growth channel.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Open rates of approximately 20–40%
  • Click-through rates of approximately 3–5%+
  • Continuous improvement in conversion performance
  • Bounce rates below 2%
  • Unsubscribe rates below 1%
  • Healthy sender reputation and deliverability
  • Clean and accurately segmented contact databases
  • Clear conversion and revenue attribution

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Full ownership of email marketing execution and optimization
  • Direct impact on engagement, conversions, and revenue
  • Opportunity to build sophisticated lifecycle and automation programs
  • Work with leading ESP and marketing automation platforms
  • Data-driven environment focused on testing and measurable results
  • Fully remote role with strong autonomy
  • Growth opportunities into Lifecycle Marketing, CRM Marketing, Marketing Automation, or Growth Marketing

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Pavago Recruiter Interview
  4. Practical Email Marketing / Automation Task
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

jobs.excerpt: About Tantalus Systems (TSX: GRID)Tantalus is a technology company dedicated to helping utilities modernize their distribution grids by harnessing the power of data across all their devices and systems deployed throughout the entire distribution grid – from the substation to the EV charger located behind the meter.
jobs.description:
About Tantalus Systems (TSX: GRID)

Tantalus is a technology company dedicated to helping utilities modernize their distribution grids by harnessing the power of data across all their devices and systems deployed throughout the entire distribution grid – from the substation to the EV charger located behind the meter. We offer smart grid solutions across multiple levels: intelligent connected devices, communications networks, data management, enterprise applications and analytics. Learn more at .

Come join us if you’re interested in being part of an entrepreneurial team, solving complex technical problems and delivering innovative solutions that will directly impact the electrification of everything and the decarbonization of our society.

We have operations throughout the United States and Canada with offices in Burnaby (British Columbia, Canada), Raleigh (North Carolina, USA), and Norwalk (Connecticut, USA).

This position offers a competitive salary plus variable compensation based on performance targets and business objectives. Tantalus also offers generous benefits, including medical, dental and vision plans, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending accounts and paid time off.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Manager, Advanced Applications Support, the SCADA Implementation Technician installs, configures, commissions, and troubleshoots Tantalus solutions at utility customer sites. The role focuses on SCADA, distributed energy resources (DER), behind-the-meter integrations, and advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) networks.

Role Location

This position is remote within the United States, preferably in the Central or Eastern states, and requires up to 25% travel.

Specifically, the Advanced Application Support Specialist will:

  • Install and commission Tantalus gateways, collectors, and field hardware.
  • Configure device networking, including IP addressing, VLANs, routing, firewalls, VPNs, and LTE/APN settings.
  • Integrate devices with customer SCADA and head-end systems, validating point mapping, polling, and controls.
  • Implement TRUGrid SCADA as a replacement for an existing system or as a customer’s first SCADA system.
  • Commission and test DNP3, Modbus, IEEE 2030.5, IEC 61850, and other protocol communications.
  • Troubleshoot hardware, firmware, network, and protocol issues using packet capture, signal analysis, and device logs.
  • Query SQL databases to validate deployments and support root-cause analysis.
  • Apply operational technology (OT) security best practices, including segmentation, secure remote access, and NERC CIP awareness.
  • Support pilots, proof-of-concept testing, and field trials with Engineering.
  • Document configurations, network diagrams, and support cases.

What you Bring:

Education and Experience

  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in a technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of networking and security experience in corporate, utility, or OT networks.
  • 3+ years of field implementation, commissioning, or technical support experience in the utility or energy sector.
  • Hands-on experience with SCADA, RTUs, PLCs, or IEDs.
  • Working knowledge of DNP3 and Modbus.
  • Working knowledge of SQL.
  • Valid driver’s license.

Preferred Qualification

  • Experience with IEEE 2030.5 and IEC 61850.
  • Experience with AMI, RF mesh, or LTE networks.
  • Experience with Linux and scripting in Bash or Python.
  • Network+, Security+, CCNA, or GICSP certification

Personal Attributes Required

  • Strong troubleshooting skills.
  • Clear communication with customers and internal teams.
  • Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently in the field.

Ready to be a Titan?

ServiceTitan is the leading software platform for the trades, powering the businesses that keep the world running. This is a high-touch, high-visibility role at the center of how we hire our most senior leaders. As the Executive Recruiting Ops Specialist, you will be the glue between our Executive Recruiting team, our C-suite and their Executive Assistants, and the senior candidates we're courting for Senior Director, VP, SVP, and confidential roles across every function. You will define and drive the experience for our internal and external customers, from the first candidate touchpoint through a smooth onboarding handoff. At ServiceTitan, Executive Recruiting is not a support function, and neither is this role.


You will report to the Global Head of Talent Acquisition and partner directly with Executive Recruiting across both of our portfolios: R&D (Engineering, Product Management, and Design) and GTM & G&A (every non-technical function). You'll join a 25+ person global TA team and work closely with C-suite leaders, their Executive Assistants, and People team partners. You'll be resourceful, creative, and collaborative, and you'll help Executive Recruiting scale without losing the white-glove experience our senior candidates expect.


What You'll Do

Master Dynamic Executive Schedules

  • Own scheduling and coordination for executive interviews, virtual and onsite, using Ashby, from first availability request through candidate confirmation
  • Manage highly dynamic calendars across C-suite leaders, interview panels, and candidates in multiple time zones, rebooking quickly and calmly when plans change
  • Anticipate conflicts, hold and release time proactively, and keep everyone informed so no search stalls on logistics
  • Coordinate onsite logistics, candidate travel, and reimbursements across ServiceTitan's global locations

Be the Glue Across Executive Recruiting

  • Partner directly with Executive Recruiting on R&D and GTM & G&A searches, from intake through offer close and onboarding handoff
  • Act as the single point of coordination for each search, keeping recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, and candidates aligned
  • Handle confidential searches, candidate information, and internal processes with full discretion

Define and Drive the Experience

  • Define and own the end-to-end experience for our internal and external customers, from first outreach to onboarding handoff
  • Deliver a white-glove candidate experience through prompt follow-up, polished logistics, and clear, personalized communication
  • Elevate the interviewer and employee experience, including interviewer prep, feedback loops, and candidate NPS
  • Partner with C-suite Executive Assistants to manage senior leader calendars, interview panels, and last-minute changes

Build the Systems That Scale

  • Create and refine processes for executive hiring, from scheduling and interview prep to offer and onboarding handoff, so every search runs consistently
  • Keep Ashby accurate for every executive search: pipelines, stages, scorecards, and data hygiene
  • Build executive-ready materials for Executive Recruiting, such as candidate slates and search trackers
  • Act as a strategic partner on ops challenges, spotting scalable fixes through data, tools, automation, and documentation

What You'll Bring

  • Proven experience managing complex, fast-changing calendars for senior leaders and multi-stage interview processes, with the judgment to prioritize and reshuffle on the fly
  • Experience in recruiting coordination, recruiting operations, or executive support in fast-paced, high-growth environments, ideally supporting senior leaders
  • A customer-first mindset and comfort being highly customer-facing: you build rapport and earn trust fast, from candidates to C-suite leaders
  • Resourcefulness and creativity: you find a way, design a better experience, and don't wait to be told how
  • A collaborative approach to working across recruiters, Executive Assistants, hiring managers, and People partners
  • A track record of improving workflows, operational processes, or systems at scale
  • Fluency with tools like Ashby, Slack, Google Workspace, Navan, and LinkedIn
  • High organization, sharp prioritization instincts, and the ability to move fast
  • A detail-oriented, proactive, and solutions-first approach to operational challenges
  • A "no task too big or too small" attitude, with the professionalism and discretion to support candidates at any level

Bonus if you have:

  • Experience supporting executive or confidential searches, in-house or at a retained search firm
  • Experience coordinating across global time zones and cross-border candidate travel
  • Experience building or improving processes in Ashby

Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.


Use of AI Technology:

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.


What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Strategic thinker who can set technical and operational vision while staying hands-on with execution

JOB SUMMARY:

NORC is currently seeking Field Managers nation-wide to lead regional data collection efforts and ensure project quality. The role combines staff supervision, field planning, training, and production management.

This position is responsible for managing a team of Field Interviewers on an assigned project, and responsible for tasks related to the planning and execution of data collection. Accountable for the quality of data collected within the assigned region. Field Managers provide direction and support to our Field Data Collectors and are often involved in the hiring, training process, project planning, and goal setting. They are additionally responsible for managing production and cost targets while assuring data quality.

This is a Full Time Field Manager position that reports to a Regional Manager (RM).

Location: This is a fully remote position that may be performed from any location within the United States.

DEPARTMENT: Field Operations

Field Operations is primarily responsible for collecting data in support of NORC studies, in a timely and efficient manner, while meeting the highest standards for quality and integrity. Field collaborates across research areas, support departments to coordinate project plans, and ensure appropriate resources are applied to achieve data collection success.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Supervise Field Interviewers and their data collection activities (usually 6-18 depending on project requirements.)

  • Manage all project field data collection tasks within a geographical area.

  • Provide guidance when problems arise; interpret and clarify data collection procedures.

  • Develop strategies during all project phases to include overall fielding plans, travel, cost and Production and project shutdown. Assign and re-assign (or re-distribute) cases to interviewing staff.

  • Motivate field interviewers and make data driven decisions using a variety of reports.

  • Give work related performance and quality feedback to interviewing staff.

  • Conduct Field Interviewer training including telephone training, in-person training, refresher training during project, and other training deemed necessary by project.

  • Assist with interviewer recruiting tasks, writing, and reviewing project materials, mentoring the interviewing staff, and other relevant tasks as directed by the Regional Manager.

  • Occasionally serve as an interviewer, with responsibilities including but not limited to gaining cooperation from groups of respondents, listing segments, conducting interviews, and other additional tasks required by a project.

REQUIRED SKILLS:
  • Must be at least 18 year of age.
  • High School Diploma or GED. Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Prior NORC Field Manager experience preferred.
  • Must have experience managing and mentoring staff.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills both in person and on the telephone, and experience in team building and development.
  • Ability to work a flexible, full time schedule, including evenings and weekends.
  • Must be comfortable contacting people in-person at their home, often without notice.
  • Able to lift and carry up to 10 lbs. up and downstairs as needed.
  • Valid driver’s license, automobile insurance, and access to reliable transportation.
  • Qualified applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S. We regret that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position.
SALARY AND BENEFITS:

The pay range for this position is $26.92 - $40.38, depending on experience and geographic area.

This position is classified as regular. Regular staff are eligible for NORC’s comprehensive benefits program. Benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Generously subsidized health insurance, effective on the first day of employment

  • Dental and vision insurance

  • A defined contribution retirement program, along with a separate voluntary 403(b) retirement program

  • Group life insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance

  • Benefits that promote work/life balance, including generous paid time off, holidays; paid parental leave, bereavement leave, tuition assistance, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

NORC is committed to equity and transparency in its pay practices. We publish salary ranges and benefit information for every job. The listed hiring range reflects what we, in good faith, expect to pay at the time of posting, though actual compensation may vary and may be adjusted over time. A candidate’s placement within the range depends on factors such as competencies, education, qualifications, experience, skills, performance, and organizational needs.

WHAT WE DO:

NORC at the University of Chicago is an objective, non-partisan research institution that delivers reliable data and rigorous analysis to guide critical programmatic, business, and policy decisions. Since 1941, our teams have conducted groundbreaking studies, created and applied innovative methods and tools, and advanced principles of scientific integrity and collaboration. Today, government, corporate, and nonprofit clients around the world partner with us to transform increasingly complex information into useful knowledge.

WHO WE ARE:

For over 80 years, NORC has evolved in many ways, moving the needle with research methods, technical applications and groundbreaking research findings. But our tradition of excellence, passion for innovation, and commitment to collegiality have remained constant components of who we are as a brand, and who each of us is as a member of the NORC team. With world-class benefits, a business casual environment, and an emphasis on continuous learning, NORC is a place where people join for the stellar research and analysis work for which we’re known, and stay for the relationships they form with their colleagues who take pride in the impact their work is making on a global scale.

About Phaedon

Phaedon is a leading loyalty partner for organizations across travel, hospitality, and retail, helping brands humanize loyalty by transforming customer interactions into meaningful, lasting relationships. Trusted by leading and growth-focused brands, Phaedon helps clients turn loyalty into a sustained driver of growth and long-term competitive advantage. Learn more at wearephaedon.com.

About the Role:

Paragraph format summary of the position

As Phaedon's first dedicated partnerships leader, you'll have the opportunity to make your mark by building our technology and referral partner program from the ground up and scaling it into an enterprise-grade engine for growth.

We're seeking a builder who has done this before in the loyalty space with someone who has stood up a partner organization at a loyalty or commerce platform, signed and launched the integrations enterprise buyers expect, and turned those relationships into sourced and influenced pipeline. You'll design the program, own the integration roadmap alongside Product, and sell side by side with our new-business team on deals that typically exceed $1.5M in total contract value.

This position reports to the VP of Sales and is a key member of a collaborative Growth team spanning sales, marketing, proposals, analyst relations, and business development. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Client Services, and leadership to make sure every partnership earns its place: by closing a gap for our clients, opening a door for our sellers, or both.

At Phaedon, we recognize that exceptional talent comes with diverse experiences. This position offers the flexibility to be filled at either the Director or Senior Director level. The final title and compensation will be thoughtfully determined using factors including but not limited to relevant work experience, skills, certifications and competencies that align to the specified role.

At Phaedon, we recognize that exceptional talent comes with diverse experiences. This position offers the flexibility to be filled at either the Director or Sr Directorlevel. The final title and compensation will be thoughtfully determined using factors including but not limited to relevant work experience, skills, certifications and competencies that align to the specified role.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

Design and launch the partner program 

  • Own the strategy. Define Phaedon's partnership thesis, partner taxonomy, and tiering across technology, referral, agency, and systems-integrator partners, tied directly to our new-logo goals in travel and hospitality, specialty retail, and eCommerce. 
  • Build the commercial framework. Create the partner agreement suite (referral, reseller, co-sell, technology/integration, and white-label or data terms), pricing and incentive models, and the governance to run them. 
  • Stand up the operating system. Partner intake and scoring, onboarding, enablement, certification, and a partner portal or hub, plus clean attribution in HubSpot so sourced and influenced revenue is measured from day one. 

Own the integration ecosystem 

  • Close the parity gap. Prioritize and land the integrations Tally needs to win head-to-head against established loyalty platforms: CDP, ESP and messaging, CRM, POS, payments, e-commerce, online ordering, PMS and booking engines, and mobile/app partners. 
  • Run integration as a product. Partner with Product and Engineering on a standard intake, SOW, and certification process; build the integration roadmap; and track adoption and attach rates once integrations ship. 
  • Keep the cost of integration in check. Negotiate partner terms, rev-share, and marketplace listings that are mutually beneficial and scale without adding headcount. 

Drive partner-sourced and influenced revenue 

  • Co-sell with the new business team. Map partner accounts against our target list, run joint account plans, and bring partners into active pursuits and RFPs where their presence changes the outcome. 
  • Build the agency and SI channel. Develop relationships with the digital agencies, consultancies, and systems integrators that shape loyalty platform decisions, and earn a place on their shortlists. 
  • Amplify the Phaedon brand. Use joint marketing, co-hosted events, partner content, and industry conference presence (CRMC, Loyalty360, and similar) to grow awareness of Phaedon and Tally in the market. 

Scale the team and the motion 

  • Prove the model, then scale it. Start as a hands-on individual leader and build the case, hiring plan, and playbooks for a partnerships team as the program grows. Mentor Growth team members, providing guidance on partnership strategy and execution. 
  • Report on what matters. Own partner-sourced pipeline, influenced bookings, integration delivery, and partner health metrics, and present them to leadership on a regular cadence. 
  • Own the ongoing partner relationships. Serve as the primary liaison between Phaedon and its strategic partners, ensuring partnerships are well-managed, mutually beneficial, and aligned with company growth goals. 

Location:

This role may be based out of our office in the Designer’s Guild building in the heart of Minneapolis’ North Loop neighborhood. We embrace a hybrid model with two in-office days per week to ensure a mix of collaboration and flexibility to support our employees’ success. 

We are also open to fully remote candidates for this position. Note that remote employees may occasionally be asked to travel to our Minneapolis HQ for company events.

This role should expect regular travel to partner meetings, client pursuits, and industry events. 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 7+ years in partnerships or business development, including at least 5 years building technology, integration, or referral partner programs at a B2B SaaS platform. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
  • Direct experience in the loyalty, CRM, martech, or commerce platform ecosystem. You know the vendors, the agencies, and how enterprise brands buy loyalty technology. 
  • A track record of building a partner program from zero, with measurable results: partners that sourced or influenced a meaningful share of new-logo revenue. 
  • Hands-on experience launching integrations across categories like CDP, ESP, POS, payments, and digital ordering, and working with Product and Engineering to scope, certify, and ship them.

Preferred Skills:

Seit Jahren legt ein automatisiertes System aus Event-IDs Search-Kampagnen im Lower Funnel an. Search-Konto steuern und optimieren
Du betreust das Google-Ads-Konto (Search, Lower Funnel) laufend: Gebote, Keywords, Anzeigen, Budgets. Ziel ist, die hohe Profitabilität zu halten und weiter auszubauen.

Kampagnen-Automatisierung neu aufsetzen
Du baust das System neu auf, das aus Event-IDs automatisch Search-Kampagnen erzeugt, sauber dokumentiert und wartbar.

KI-basierte Eventintegration umsetzen
Du lässt Veranstaltungsname, Pfad, Keywords und Beschreibung automatisiert aus den Eventtexten im Content-System generieren, statt sie manuell einzupflegen.

Gemeinsam mit der internen Softwareentwicklung zapfst Du die neue Schnittstelle an und bringst die Eventdaten zuverlässig in Google Ads.

Job Summary

At Fuze Health, we put patients first and tirelessly address the most pressing needs in healthcare. We empower millions to digitally connect with care providers, essential health resources and needed treatments – and enable care providers, employers, health plans and life sciences companies to meaningfully enhance quality, outcomes and value. We are dedicated to helping our partners evolve and modernize to meet emerging patient and marketplace needs.

Fuze Health’s foundation is built upon the strategic combination of several proven, technology-powered innovators in the digital health, diagnostics, and pharmacy sectors. Our growing portfolio brings together the capabilities of industry leaders including LetsGetChecked, Truepill, and Alto Pharmacy, to create a distinctive, unified force in healthcare. Together, we have the shared vision, advanced capabilities and talented teams to deliver next-generation solutions that patients and healthcare partners need today and into the future.



Job Description

The Staff Product Analyst, Care at Fuze Health plays a critical role in driving operational and strategic decision-making across the business through data analysis, reporting, and cross-functional collaboration. This role is responsible for analyzing prescription processing and patient care operations, designing scalable data models, and developing dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across Finance, Product, Engineering, Growth, and Operations. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with business acumen to influence strategy, improve operational efficiency, and contribute to building a strong data-driven culture within the FuzeRx organization.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Operational Analysis: Perform in-depth analysis of prescription processing and patient care operations to support key business and operational decisions.
  • Data Modeling & Analytics: Design and build scalable data models that improve access to insights, enable data democratization, and support faster decision-making.
  • Dashboard Development: Design, implement, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions using SQL, Looker, Tableau, or similar BI tools to measure product and operational performance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Finance, Product, Engineering, Growth, and Operations teams to provide analytical visibility, identify opportunities, and recommend data-driven solutions.
  • Strategic Insights: Translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable business recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Data Infrastructure Support: Utilize SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis across large datasets to support reporting, operational monitoring, and strategic initiatives.
  • Business Impact & Decision Support: Influence business strategy by delivering high-quality analyses that drive measurable operational and financial impact.
  • Team & Culture Development: Contribute to the growth of the Data Science & Analytics function through peer collaboration, mentorship, process improvement, and fostering a strong data culture.
  • Continuous Improvement: Stay current with emerging analytics tools, technologies, and industry best practices to continuously improve analytical capabilities and business outcomes.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or another quantitative field.
  • 8+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a related technical role.

  • Strong experience building dashboards and visualizations using Looker, Tableau, or similar BI platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence business strategy and deliver measurable impact through data-driven insights.
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills with a strong focus on actionable outcomes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex insights to non-technical audiences.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally in fast-paced, data-driven environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience within the healthcare or pharmaceutical industry.

Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. At this time, Fuze Health is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa.

Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.

Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.

Why This Role Exists

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
  • CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
  • Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
  • Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
  • A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
  • The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world
  • Meaningful technical challenges: security, compliance, scale, and reliability at the intersection of Node.js and Salesforce
  • A culture that rewards ownership, speed, and craftsmanship over politics and hierarchy
  • Remote-first flexibility with a results-oriented work environment

jobs.title: SOC Analyst (16:00–01:00 UTC)
jobs.excerpt: About the jobThe SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center.
jobs.description:
About the job

The SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center. This position reports to the SOC Lead. The role goes beyond acknowledging alerts: the focus is on understanding what each alert means, investigating suspicious activity end to end, responding to real threats, and handing over cleanly between regions so that nothing is lost across shifts. The ideal candidate has solid SOC experience, a strong investigative mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, triage, and analyze security alerts and events from the organization's security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

  • Investigate security incidents end to end, from initial triage through analysis, containment, eradication, and post-incident documentation, coordinating with relevant teams throughout.

  • Determine the scope, severity, and impact of security events, separating true positives from false positives and escalating confirmed incidents according to defined procedures.

  • Execute response actions within the security platforms, such as isolating endpoints, blocking indicators, disabling compromised accounts, and enforcing access restrictions.

  • Ensure structured, high-quality shift handovers across regions in the follow-the-sun model, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

  • Proactively threat hunt across endpoint, network, and log data to uncover suspicious activity that existing detections may have missed, mapping findings to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Provide feedback on detection quality and contribute to the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules to reduce noise and improve coverage.

  • Enrich investigations with threat intelligence, including indicators of compromise, attacker techniques, and emerging campaigns relevant to the organization.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks.

  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

  • Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, triaging alerts and investigating security incidents in a production environment.

  • Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

  • Experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, BTL1, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and across time zones.

About You

You are a hands-on security analyst who wants to understand what is really happening behind an alert, rather than only closing tickets. You dig into the data, follow the evidence, and know when and how to escalate. If you have also stood up or tuned the tools you work with, or written your own detections, even better. You are structured, reliable, and comfortable working independently in a remote, follow-the-sun team, and you take pride in leaving a clear handover for the next shift. You are curious about new threats and technologies, and you enjoy working closely with both technical teams and end users to raise the security bar across the environment.

Product Management | PTC Modeler | Systems Engineering

Reporting to: Vice President of Product Management - AI/MBSE

Remote: US


Overview

PTC is seeking an experienced, customer-focused Sr. Principal Product Manager to lead PTC Modeler and help shape the next generation of systems engineering at PTC. This role combines direct product management responsibility for an established enterprise MBSE solution with the opportunity to influence how PTC evolves beyond today's traditional modeling tools and workflows.

The role reports to the Vice President of Product Management - AI/MBSE, whose portfolio spans Codebeamer, AI, Pure Variants, and Modeler. The Product Manager will own the strategy, roadmap, discovery, and business outcomes for Modeler while serving as a key strategic partner to the VP of Product Management - AI/MBSE and other product and technology leaders defining PTC's longer-term direction for MBSE and systems engineering.

PTC believes the future of systems engineering will require more connected, accessible, and intelligent experiences. We are exploring how AI and agentic experiences, connected engineering information, open standards, and deeper integration across the product lifecycle can create new ways for engineers to understand, design, analyze, communicate, and evolve complex systems. This Product Manager will bring the perspective of customers, practitioners, partners, and the market into that work.

The ideal candidate combines strong product management judgment with systems thinking technical curiosity, commercial awareness, and credibility with engineering customers. This is an opportunity to deliver meaningful value for Modeler customers today while helping PTC explore what comes next for model-based and systems engineering.


Responsibilities:

Lead PTC Modeler

  • Own and communicate the product strategy, roadmap, priorities, and measurable outcomes for PTC Modeler.
  • Balance near-term customer commitments, product quality, platform evolution, competitive differentiation, and longer-term strategic opportunities.
  • Translate strategy and customer problems into prioritized product outcomes, investment proposals, and clear requirements for R&D and UX.
  • Partner closely with R&D and UX throughout discovery and delivery, making timely decisions based on customer value, business impact, usability, technical feasibility, and risk.
  • Define success measures and use product telemetry, adoption data, customer evidence, and commercial results to evaluate outcomes and guide future investment.

Shape the Future of Systems Engineering

  • Partner with the VP of Product Management - AI/MBSE and other product and technology leaders to help shape PTC's long-term vision for MBSE and systems engineering.
  • Bring customer, market, competitive, and practitioner insight into decisions about how traditional MBSE tools and workflows should evolve.
  • Explore how AI, agentic experiences, connected engineering information, open standards, and modern user experiences can improve how complex systems are designed, analyzed, reviewed, communicated, and changed.
  • Identify opportunities that extend beyond traditional modeling and connect systems engineering more deeply with requirements, software development, product architecture, product-line and variability management, PLM, simulation, and the broader digital thread.
  • Develop and validate product hypotheses with customers, partners, and systems-engineering practitioners, then translate emerging direction into product concepts, investment recommendations, and roadmap opportunities.
  • Challenge conventional assumptions constructively and help make systems engineering more accessible, connected, intelligent, and valuable across the engineering organization.

Understand Customers, Practitioners, and the Market

  • Build trusted relationships with strategic customers, users, partners, and industry practitioners to understand their goals, workflows, constraints, and unmet needs.
  • Lead continuous product discovery, test assumptions, and translate evidence into clear problem definitions and differentiated product opportunities.

  • Collaborate across the broader PTC portfolio spanning Codebeamer, AI, Pure Variants, Modeler as well as PLM offerings to identify cross-product customer value and avoid treating MBSE as an isolated discipline.

Required Skills and Experience
