About Accelerant

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. Accelerant was founded in 2018 by a group of longtime insurance industry executives and technology experts who shared a vision of rebuilding the way risk is exchanged – so that it works better, for everyone. The Accelerant risk exchange does business across more than 20 different countries and 250 specialty products, and we are proud that our insurers have been awarded an AM Best A- (Excellent) rating. For more information, please visit .

Solution Architect

Accelerant

London or US|Full-time|Reports to VP, Solution Architecture

ABOUT ACCELERANT

Accelerant is a Risk Exchange that connects underwriting talent with capacity. We combine proprietary data, technology, and deep insurance expertise to help members build and scale specialist insurance businesses. We are growing quickly and investing heavily in the platforms and capabilities that underpin our exchange.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Accelerant is in an exciting period of growth and transformation. We are modernising our platforms, expanding our data capabilities, and embedding intelligent automation across the business - all at pace. Solution Architecture sits at the centre of that effort, connecting technology decisions to business outcomes across underwriting, claims, finance, and operations.

This is a hands-on role. You will be embedded in delivery squads, owning the design end-to-end from requirements through to go-live - not handing off a diagram and stepping back. The quality of your upfront design work directly determines whether delivery runs smoothly or stalls, so thoroughness and attention to detail matter as much as the ability to think at a high level. You will report directly to the VP of Solution Architecture.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the design of integration and platform solutions from requirements through to delivery, working across a wide variety of programmes and business domains.
  • Gatekeeper requirements before design begins - ensuring functional scope is clear, agreed, and documented before a squad is formed or build starts.
  • Produce design documentation thorough enough for developers to build from and testers to derive test targets from, without needing to escalate back to you for answers.
  • Stay embedded in delivery squads through build and test, providing design authority when questions arise rather than being pulled in retrospectively to firefight.
  • Translate complex business requirements - from underwriting, claims, finance, and operations - into clear, actionable technical designs, using MuleSoft as the primary integration platform.
  • Work alongside data, platform, and product engineering teams to define connectivity patterns across event-driven, API, and file-based channels.
  • Contribute to architecture governance, ensuring integration decisions are made at the right point in delivery rather than discovered mid-sprint.
  • Support the adoption of AI-native development tooling and emerging integration capabilities as we modernise how we build.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essential

  • Proven experience as a solution architect or lead integration developer, with MuleSoft as your primary integration platform.
  • A track record of seeing designs through delivery, not just producing them - you have been the person in the room when things get difficult, and you have the scars to show for it.
  • Solid understanding of insurance or reinsurance operations - you can hold a substantive conversation with underwriters and claims managers, not just engineers.
  • Comfort working in ambiguity: you can move a design forward when requirements are still forming, and you know when to decide vs. when to ask.
  • Strong requirements discipline - you push back when scope is unclear before build starts, because you know what happens when you do not.
  • Strong business translation skills - the ability to understand what a stakeholder actually needs and express it as a workable design, not just a literal interpretation of the ask.
  • Experience producing formal architecture documentation (design specifications, integration records, data-flow maps) at a level of detail that delivery teams can genuinely use.
  • Familiarity with event-driven and API-led connectivity patterns.

  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.
  2. A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.
  3. A 15 minute call with the founder.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. Aptitude tests. These inform us, they do not decide.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

    1. Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.
    2. Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
    3. Strong written English.
    4. Based in Bulgaria.
    5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

2100 USD per month from day one, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

jobs.description:
Hello, potential future Oatly employee. It’s us, the original oatmilk company that started in Sweden back 25 or so years ago and has since expanded to the U.S., where we’ve continued growing at a rate such that we need more brilliant minds to work with us to keep the momentum going and the oatmilk flowing.

Sustainability, health, and transparency are the core values that guide everything we do. Basically, we exist to help people live healthier lives without recklessly taxing the planet’s resources in the process, and to change the food system for the better. We drive that change through the power of oats and through a significant reduction in cow’s milk consumption. If any of this resonates with you, then maybe you’d like to work for Oatly, too. Now onto the formal stuff.

We are looking for aSupply Planning Manager, North America to join our Supply Chain team. This role will lead the North American Supply Planning function and ensure the business has a robust, executable supply plan that delivers the right products at the right place and time while balancing customer service, inventory, capacity, cost, waste, and operational efficiency.

Due to business needs, the qualified candidate will reside in the Eastern timezone.

Here are the things we want to hire you to do:

  • Lead the North America Supply Planning team and build a high-performing, data-driven planning organization

  • Own the development and execution of the regional supply plan across manufacturing sites, product categories, co-manufacturers, and the distribution network

  • Translate the consensus demand plan into integrated capacity, production, inventory, deployment, and material requirements

  • Establish clear planning priorities and decision rules across service, inventory, cost, capacity, and waste

  • Connect short-, medium-, and long-term supply plans to provide a consistent view of regional supply capability

  • Drive exception-based planning so the team can focus on decisions and risks rather than manual data processing

  • Develop a forward-looking view of capacity requirements, constraints, gaps, bottlenecks, and opportunities across manufacturing sites and co-manufacturers

  • Partner with Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics, Customer Service, Deployment, Commercial, Finance, and the broader Supply Chain organization to develop mitigation plans and align around one set of numbers

  • Evaluate production, sourcing, capacity, and inventory scenarios to optimize the North American supply network and support fact-based business decisions

  • Ensure new products, renovations, transitions, and discontinuations are reflected in supply plans with clear ramp-up and phase-out strategies

  • Own regional inventory planning principles, safety stock, inventory targets, planning parameters, and replenishment policies

  • Balance customer availability with working capital, shelf life, storage capacity, obsolescence, and waste considerations

  • Proactively identify shortages, excess inventory, service failures, inventory deviations, and supply disruptions, then coordinate root-cause analysis and corrective action

  • Lead the Supply component of the North American Integrated Tactical Planning process and escalate structural or strategic constraints into the monthly Integrated Business Planning process

  • Champion the simplification, standardization, automation, and effective use of planning systems, ERP capabilities, master data, advanced analytics, and AI

  • Lead or contribute to regional and global planning transformation initiatives and deploy best practices across the planning organization

  • Coach, mentor, and develop Supply and Deployment Planners; establish clear expectations and development plans; and strengthen succession and future planning capabilities

Here are the things we think you need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline

  • 5+ years of experience in Supply Planning, IBP, S&OP, or related processes

  • 3+ years of people leadership experience

  • Proven experience leading supply planning processes; experience in FMCG, food and beverage, consumer goods, or another fast-moving industry is preferred

  • Demonstrated success driving cross-functional alignment and influencing senior stakeholders

  • Experience supporting executive-level decision-making through analytics and scenario planning

  • Experience with planning platforms such as Anaplan, SAP IBP, OMP, Kinaxis, or an equivalent platform, along with strong business intelligence and Excel capabilities

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills

  • Ability to travel approximately 4–6 times per year within the requirements of the role

And here’s another list of qualities we think make a good Oatly team member:

  • You feel connected to our mission of encouraging health, sustainability, and transparency

  • You are a self-starter who doesn’t need direct supervision to motivate you for success – we believe strongly in building a culture of individual accountability and ownership and need partners that can embrace that mentality

  • You are ready to make your mark in a smaller, growing brand, leveraging your experience to deliver amazing results and build an outstanding company

  • You have an entrepreneurial spirit in that you’re comfortable with ambiguity and are energized by the process of building something lasting from the ground up

  • You enjoy sharing your quirkiness and talents with your coworkers

Another bulleted list felt a bit too…bullet-y. So we wrote this long, awkward sentence to let you know all the ways we sweeten the deal when you work with us, like flexible vacation (take it when you need it), really great benefits (yes, pet insurance is in there), paid volunteer days off throughout the year (doing good is fun), free six packs of...(drumroll)…oatmilk, and you’ll also get genuinely great coworkers who are rooting for each other and the company to thrive. Oh, one more short but very important sentence: We are nimble and agile (not chaotic) in how we work, and we’re grounded in a long company history dating way back to the last century.

Job Title:

Vulnerability Management Engineer (AI Automation)

About Trellix 
Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era. Combining AI-native security, operational threat intelligence, and automated detection and response, Trellix provides defense-grade protection at machine speed across on-premises, air-gapped, operational technology, hybrid, and cloud environments. Trellix helps customers anticipate threats, scale effective security operations, maintain business continuity, and adapt their security posture for the modern threat landscape. Working with a broad partner ecosystem and global intelligence collaborators, Trellix helps strengthen the collective defense against cybercriminals and state-sponsored attacks. At Trellix, we empower professionals at all career stages to expand their technical expertise, lead strategic initiatives, and make a tangible global impact. Whether you are an industry pioneer or an emerging specialist, Trellix provides the tools and opportunities to enhance and expand your skill set. Join our mission to scale AI-driven cyber defense alongside an AI-accelerated threat landscape, and help build a safer, more resilient future. More at .

Role Overview:

We are looking for strategic, hands-on Security Engineer to drive end-to-end vulnerability management, governance, and risk-based prioritization across hybrid, cloud, and containerized environments in alignment with NIST SSDF, EU CRA, and IEC standards. The role focuses on engineering autonomous AI agents to automate asset discovery, finding validation, exploitability analysis, ticket orchestration, and zero-day response. Candidates will lead cross-functional remediation with IT and DevOps teams, streamline exception workflows, and deliver executive-level risk reporting and metrics.

About Role:

  • Direct continuous asset discovery, vulnerability assessment, remediation verification, and executive reporting across hybrid cloud, container, and application ecosystems.
  • Contextualize vulnerability severity (CVSS) using real-world threat intelligence (EPSS, CISA KEV) and business criticality. Spearhead rapid response protocols for critical zero-day vulnerabilities, implementing interim compensating controls and formal risk-acceptance workflows as required.
  • Architect and deploy autonomous AI agents to automate asset discovery, CMDB reconciliation, false-positive elimination, exploitability analysis, intelligent ticket routing, SLA breach escalations, and executive reporting.
  • Establish and enforce program governance, remediation SLAs, and exception management frameworks aligned with NIST SSDF, EU CRA, and IEC standards.
  • Define, track, and present key performance indicators (scan coverage, MTTR, SLA adherence, and vulnerability aging) to senior leadership. Partner with and mentor IT Operations, DevOps, and Software Engineering teams to accelerate remediation and embed security-by-design practices.

About You:

  • 5+ years in Information Security with a strong focus on Vulnerability Management, Application Security, or Cloud Security.
  • Extensive hands-on expertise with industry-leading VM, CNAPP, and AppSec solutions—including Tenable, Wiz, Qualys, CrowdStrike, or Snyk—with proven ability to programmatically orchestrate scans, ingest telemetry, and validate remediation.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and deploying autonomous AI agents and multi-step LLM workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs to automate discovery, reconciliation, and remediation pipelines.
  • Proficiency in leveraging LLMs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures to correlate vulnerability data with source code repositories, asset metadata, and exploit intelligence to filter false positives and determine real-world exploitability.
  • Strong proficiency in Python for developing production-grade security automation, custom integrations, and consuming or building REST and GraphQL APIs.
  • Proven experience integrating security scanners with SOAR platforms, enterprise ticketing systems (Jira, ServiceNow), CMDBs, and collaboration platforms (Slack, Microsoft Teams) for automated ticket creation, routing, reminders, and SLA escalations.
  • Deep command of CVSS, EPSS, and CISA KEV methodologies, with experience enriching vulnerability telemetry using threat feeds and business impact assessments.
  • Comprehensive understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), hybrid enterprise networks, container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Working knowledge of NIST SSDF, EU CRA, and IEC regulatory frameworks, paired with the ability to build automated executive dashboards tracking MTTR, scan coverage, and SLA compliance.

jobs.description:
A MTP – Métodos e Tecnologia é uma multinacional espanhola com 28 anos de atuação, presente em mais de 21 países, com sedes no Brasil, Espanha e México.

Somos especialistas em Digital Business Assurance, unindo estratégia, tecnologia e inovação para apoiar grandes empresas em sua jornada de transformação digital.

Com mais de 80 clientes ativos nos setores de Finanças, Seguros, Telecom, Indústria, Varejo, Tecnologia e Energia, entregamos soluções que garantem qualidade, segurança e performance em todo o ciclo digital.

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar com Code Review e Segurança de Aplicações (Application Security), apoiando as atividades de segurança de sistemas desenvolvidos em uma organização global.

A posição terá como foco a análise de vulnerabilidades identificadas por ferramentas de SAST (Static Application Security Testing) e SCA (Software Composition Analysis), avaliação de propostas de mitigação, identificação de falsos positivos e orientação técnica às equipes de desenvolvimento para a correção de vulnerabilidades.

Procuramos um perfil com sólida compreensão de desenvolvimento de software, arquitetura de aplicações e segurança, capaz de atuar com autonomia, avaliar riscos técnicos e propor soluções práticas em um ambiente global e colaborativo.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Monitorar e gerenciar filas de chamados, selecionando demandas de forma proativa, definindo prioridades e acompanhando os casos desde a abertura até a resolução.
  • Analisar vulnerabilidades e apontamentos identificados por ferramentas de SAST e SCA, avaliando sua relevância, criticidade e impacto na segurança das aplicações.
  • Avaliar propostas de mitigação de vulnerabilidades, verificando se os controles implementados são suficientes para reduzir os riscos de segurança.
  • Investigar possíveis falsos positivos, analisando código-fonte, comportamento das aplicações, arquitetura e fluxos de dados.
  • Orientar equipes de desenvolvimento sobre boas práticas de segurança e estratégias de correção de vulnerabilidades identificadas no código.
  • Interagir diretamente com equipes técnicas por meio de Microsoft Teams, reuniões e comunicações escritas, esclarecendo dúvidas e apoiando decisões relacionadas à segurança.
  • Colaborar com profissionais de Desenvolvimento, QA, Infraestrutura, Operações e Segurança para garantir a resolução adequada dos problemas identificados.
  • Contribuir com sugestões de melhorias nos processos, serviços e utilização de tecnologias emergentes, buscando maior eficiência e qualidade nas atividades de segurança.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Conhecimento sólido em Segurança de Aplicações (Application Security), incluindo arquitetura de software, funcionamento de aplicações e fluxos de dados.
  • Domínio dos conceitos do OWASP Top 10, com capacidade de identificar vulnerabilidades comuns e relacioná-las às respectivas estratégias de correção no código.
  • Experiênciaem Desenvolvimento de Software, Arquitetura de Software, Quality Assurance (QA) ou Engenharia de Segurança de Aplicações.
  • Conhecimento prático em pelo menos uma linguagem ou tecnologia de desenvolvimento, como C#, C++, Java, .NET, ou Python.
  • Capacidade de analisar resultados de ferramentas SAST e SCA, avaliar possíveis falsos positivos e validar propostas de mitigação de riscos.
  • Capacidade de interpretar código-fonte e compreender o comportamento das aplicações para investigar vulnerabilidades e orientar correções.
  • Autonomia para gerenciar demandas, estabelecer prioridades, acompanhar chamados e conduzir atividades até sua conclusão.
  • Inglês avançado, com boa comunicação verbal e escrita para explicar riscos técnicos, apresentar recomendações de correção e interagir com equipes internacionais e stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de adaptação a mudanças, atuação em cenários com informações incompletas e colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares.

Requisitos desejáveis (diferenciais)

  • Experiência prática anterior como Desenvolvedor(a) de Software, especialmente em atividades relacionadas à análise de código e correção de vulnerabilidades.
  • Familiaridade com padrões de arquitetura de aplicações, como MVC, microsserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, como Agile, XP, Scrum e Kanban.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de Test Driven Development (TDD) e integração e entrega contínuas (CI/CD).
  • Conhecimentos em arquitetura e serviços de Cloud Computing, especialmente AWS.
  • Familiaridade com processos de revisão de código e conceitos de testes de penetração (Pentest).
  • Conhecimento ou exposição a ferramentas e técnicas como Burp Suite, Metasploit, Fuzzing e Jenkins, sem necessidade de experiência prática em Pentest.
  • Experiência com utilização ou suporte a recursos baseados em Inteligência Artificial (IA) aplicados à Engenharia de Software ou serviços de Segurança.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar com sobreposição significativa ao horário comercial da costa leste dos Estados Unidos (Eastern Time), sem caráter obrigatório.
  • Perfil participativo, com facilidade para compartilhar opiniões, propor melhorias e contribuir para um ambiente de trabalho aberto e colaborativo.

jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer – Permanent - £60,000 - £70,000

Join us and be part of a mission-driven, independent publisher. You’ll work with a diverse group of people who share a passion for empowering researchers, educators, and institutions to shape the future.

About Sage:

Sage is a global academic publisher of books, journals, and library resources with a growing range of technologies to enable discovery, access, and engagement. Believing that research and education are critical in shaping society, Sara Miller McCune founded Sage in 1965. Today, we are controlled by a group of trustees charged with maintaining our independence and mission indefinitely.

Our guaranteed independence means we’re free to:

  • Do more – supporting an equitable academic future, furthering disciplines that drive social change, and helping social and behavioural science make an impact

  • Work together – building lasting relationships, championing diverse perspectives, and co-creating resources to transform teaching and learning

  • Think long-term – experimenting, taking risks, and investing in new ideas

About our Team:

You’ll join a collaborative, multi‑disciplinary engineering team that builds the publishing systems powering critical business operations across content delivery, access control, workflow, analytics, eCommerce, finance, and metadata management. Working closely with product managers, architects, designers, and stakeholders across multiple business units, the team focuses on creating reliable, scalable, and modern solutions that enable colleagues and customers to work, learn, and innovate with confidence. Together, we champion continuous improvement, shared learning, and inclusive engineering practices that help every team member thrive.

Could you be our new Senior Software Engineer? Are you?

  • Experienced in full‑stack engineering with a strong track record of delivering complex solutions on modern technology - Microsoft stack strongly preferred (.NET, C#, Azure, SQL Server).

  • Skilled in cloud development with hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating solutions preferably in Azure (Functions, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, or equivalents).

  • Curious about AI‑enabled development and understand concepts like LLMs, prompt engineering, and workflow orchestration, and you're keen to explore how they change the way software gets built.

  • Able to apply AI responsibly to accelerate analysis, coding, testing, documentation, and day to day productivity while ensuring accuracy, security, and maintainability.

  • Attentive to security and governance with awareness of data protection, access control, auditability, and risk as part of the design consideration.

  • Collaborative and self‑directed with experience contributing effectively to remote Agile teams.

  • Analytical and detail‑oriented with the ability to prioritise, work through ambiguity, and deliver high-quality work under time pressure.

  • A supportive technical leader recognised for mentoring others, sharing expertise, and continuously developing your own skills.

Your new role:

This role shapes the technical direction of our publishing platforms, designing and developing sophisticated solutions that support business‑critical outcomes. You’ll contribute to architecture decisions, build high‑quality software, and influence engineering standards across teams. Your work will directly improve system reliability, developer experience, and customer impact.

  • Deliver scalable solutions that meet business needs through robust full‑stack development and thoughtful architectural design.

  • Advance technical direction by contributing to multi‑team architecture, patterns, and engineering practices.

  • Enhance existing systems through continuous improvement, optimisation, and modernisation of features and capabilities.

  • Strengthen platform reliability by implementing high‑quality enhancements, resolving issues, and ensuring seamless integration across products.

  • Champion engineering excellence by researching and applying modern standards, tools, and approaches—including responsible use of AI‑assisted development.

  • Support team growth by mentoring colleagues, sharing knowledge, and contributing positively to team culture.

  • Drive Agile collaboration through active participation in ceremonies, cross‑team discussions, and remote‑first ways of working.

  • Solve complex problems independently while helping others navigate challenges with clarity and confidence.

Overview of benefits:

  • 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with 2 additional floating personal days.

  • Home working allowance

  • Life assurance, income protection, and travel insurance.

  • Private medical cover and access to the company doctor.

  • Tuition scheme and support for pursuing professional qualifications, including access to Sage books and journals.

  • Variety of snacks and beverages available in the office.

  • Healthy lifestyle reimbursement and anniversary trips.

  • Access to Company loans (season ticket loan, rental deposit loan, cycle loan).

We’re a Disability Confident Employer (Level 1).If you’d like to apply under this scheme, please let us know in your application.

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and inclusive. If you’d like to request reasonable adjustments, please email . Please note we only accept applications via email if an adjustment has been agreed.

Closing date for applications: Thursday 26th November 2026

To ensure we can give each application the attention it deserves, we may consider bringing the closing date forward. Therefore, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible to ensure it is considered.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Sage, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and to sustaining a culture that celebrates diversity, encourages authenticity, and builds a deep sense of belonging. We encourage applications from all members of society irrespective of age, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, colour, race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion, or belief as crafting value through diversity is what makes us strong.

jobs.description:
Overview

The Opportunity:

Amyx, a Tetra Tech company, is adding a Senior Project Analyst and Testing Engineer to our Defense Logistics Agency team based in Philadelphia, PA.

Why Amyx, a Tetra Tech company:

Amyx has been a leader in the Federal Defense, National Security, and Intelligence industry for over 25+ years. In 2023 we joined Tetra Tech, enabling us to combine our expertise with the reach and resources of a prestigious global organization.

At Amyx and Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry-leading experts are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting-edge solutions in IT/OT, Cyber, Mission Support Service, Water, Environment, Energy, and International Development. Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

Your Impact:

Join Amyx, a Tetra Tech company, to make a real difference. Our work leverages cutting-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy.

Responsibilities

Your Role:

Join a mission-focused team at the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) dedicated to maintaining and modernizing critical medical logistics applications that directly support military customers. As a Senior Project Analyst and Quality Engineer, you will manage complex, state-of-the-art test programs while serving as a key bridge between stakeholders, users, and software developers. The role requires translation of complex program requirements into testable objectives, developing comprehensive test plans and procedures, and guiding the software development lifecycle (SDLC) from requirement decomposition to release verification. You will work closely with cross-functional technical teams, apply use cases and user stories to create test cases, and independently assess system performance against stated requirements to ensure high-quality software delivery. Additional sustainment tasks, such as monitoring production environments and performing analysis on databases, may be required.

  • Designs and executes test cases and test procedures to support software release targets and meeting requirement needs.
  • Translates complex program requirements into clear, testable objectives and assists with decomposition of user stories/requirements to a level of sufficiency that software developers can implement, including insertion of best practices for ensuring user stories/requirements are testable.
  • Develops and implements the overall test strategy, including defining clear test objectives, methodologies, analysis, schedules.
  • Leads and mentors QA Testers in designing detailed, executable test plans and compensating for test limitations and restrictions.
  • Incorporates automation to test cases where appropriate to expedite test execution.
  • Fosters excellent relationships with business analysts and/or stakeholders/users to understand user story and requirement needs.
  • Collaborates with cross-team technical or business resources to coordinate the resolution of data, requirements, or testing process issues that impact application quality.
  • Provides feedback on business direction, interpretation of requirements, and updates to test cases; executes test cases and signs off for release completion when necessary.
  • Captures, tracks, and manages test plans, test cases, and test steps in the enterprise repository and program-provided tools (e.g., Azure DevOps/TFS), and manages test case signoff and overall test plan posture, providing updates to project lead on testing posture.
  • Participates in software releases and deployments with Infrastructure and Application developers, supporting project leads where appropriate to review application functionality when going live and assist with documentation needs.
  • Develops a deep functional understanding of application business capabilities and continuously learns new business and technical domains.
  • Utilizes data analysis and SQL skills to investigate issues, validate database state, and provide reports as needed by stakeholders, users, or other clients in a timely fashion.
  • Leads analysis efforts to dissect test output data, interfaces with the client, provides clear results, and recommends corrective actions. Uses these skills in development and production environments as demands require.
  • Acts as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the project, assisting project lead to support the overall stakeholder need and mission objectives.
  • Conduct activities in line with internal procedures, legislation, and industry standards.
  • Pursue continuous professional development and maintain a high degree of discipline knowledge and awareness.
  • Work in a safe manner at all times and report all health and safety incidents and concerns.
  • Additional duties as required.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • Must be able to achieve a NACLC security background check.
  • Minimum of 5 years related experience.
  • Experience in testing software applications, including system, regression, acceptance, end-to-end, performance, and automation testing.
  • Experience in an Agile environment, with demonstrated knowledge of System Operations, Engineering, and DevOps integration.
  • Experience developing and maintaining test cases and requirements using designated automated test tools and repositories like Azure DevOps/TFS.
  • Must have detailed familiarity with commercial test environments and operating procedures.
  • Experience translating complex program requirements into testable objectives, and decomposing requirements for development.
  • Experience analyzing and recommending test cycles, test plans, and detailed test objectives.
  • Demonstrated leadership, experience working effectively with diverse organizations and personalities, and is a “team player”.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Relevant certification from a nationally recognized technical authority (e.g., ISTQB, CSM, PMP, or equivalent).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline is a plus.
  • Military Medical Supply Chain experience is a big plus.
  • Possess significant experience performing complex analysis using SQL to validate application behavior or generate business reports.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating or leading the development/testing of Web-based applications (e.g., .Net MVC, Angular).

Life at Amyx, a Tetra Tech company:

The perks of working at Tetra Tech include:

  • Comprehensive and market-competitive benefits.
  • Merit-based financial rewards.
  • Flexibility and company-wide commitment to work/life balance.
  • Collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees.
  • Learning and development opportunities for ongoing professional growth.

About Amyx and Tetra Tech:

Amyx, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Tetra Tech, and our mission is to exceed our customer's expectations on every contract, to provide an environment that encourages, recognizes and rewards the extraordinary contributions of our employees, and to advance and support the communities in which we work and live.Amyx is a management and technical solutions provider and a "trusted partner"​ to our Federal Government clients on programs of national importance. We understand that successful programs require superior performance and a level of trust achieved through genuine rapport with the customer. Award-winning results have propelled Amyx to become one of the fastest growing businesses in the Washington Region. Amyx's service offerings include: - Program Management and Acquisition Support - Systems Engineering and Implementation - Enterprise Architecture - Business Process Transformation

Tetra Tech is the leader in water, environment, and sustainable infrastructure, providing high-end consulting and engineering services for projects worldwide. With 30,000 employees working together, Tetra Tech provides clear solutions to complex problems by Leading with Science® to address the entire water cycle, protect and restore the environment, design sustainable and resilient infrastructure, and support the clean energy transition.

We invite applications from all interested parties.

Please contact with any questions!

Amyx is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. Amyx is a VEVRAA federal contractor and we request priority referral of veterans.

Physical DemandsEmployee needs to be able to sit at a workstation for extended periods; use hand(s) to handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear. Most positions require ability to work on desktop or laptop computer for extended periods of time reading, reviewing/analyzing information, and providing recommendations, summaries and/or reports in written format. Must be able to effectively communicate with others verbally and in writing. Employee may be required to occasionally lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically less than 20 pounds. Regular and predictable attendance is essential.

Job Description:

Database Analyst /Administrator

GDIT has an opportunity for a dynamic and talented candidate to join our team supporting the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AOUSC) Mission Support Systems Division (MSSD) in one of its mission-critical applications that is used by all federal courts’ community. MSSD has a mature agile practice using the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and supports a broad range of complex business systems which are instrumental to the AOUSC mission.


The Database Analyst/ Administrator will execute the following responsibilities:

  • Works within an Agile solution development environment with daily scrums, biweekly sprint planning and quarterly Program Increment planning.
  • Develops operating standards and best practices, including performance, security, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Ensures the proper definition, control, and coordination of data elements and standards, and the facilitation of efficient data relationships, systems integration, and physical structure.
  • Collaborates with Product Owners and users to gather business requirements and define and maps them to technical requirements. Meets with agency leaders and stakeholders, collaborating with other consultants and program/agency personnel regarding the development of innovative data analysis techniques.
  • Demonstrates ability to document complex workflow designs to present to project team and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrates ability to work on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors and frequently contributes to the development of new business strategy, ideas, and methods adhering to best practices within the Agile framework.
  • Collects, analyzes, and interprets large amounts of data to help guide business decisions. Experience with using advanced statistical analysis, data mining, and predictive modeling techniques.
  • Synthesizes disparate information and recognizes patterns and relationships across data; synthesizes large sets of data from multiple sources, develops data visualizations for the purposes of tracking key performance indicators and other critical metrics tied to program outcomes.
  • Hosts and conducts peer reviews of the code of other developers on the team. Performs data validation and ensures data accuracy and integrity.
  • Develops stored procedures, jobs, views, tables, and other database objects in SQL Server Management Studio.
  • Designs and develops dimensional data models including start and snowflake schemas, fact and dimension tables, and enterprise data marts to support analytics, reporting and business intelligence solutions.
  • Develops and deploys ETL packages using CI/CD pipeline. Exposure to core configuration management systems for version control.
  • Works with Atlassian Suite of software development management tools.
  • Indexes system and application logs in to the Splunk system monitoring application, then creates dashboards, alerts, and reports from those logs.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least seven (7+) years of Server database maintenance and database analysis or similar role.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Programming, Computer Engineering or relevant computer-based major. Experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Database or cloud certification preferred such as Microsoft Certified Azure Database Administrator Associate, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent industry recognized database certification.
  • Proficient experience with Databases like Microsoft SQL Server, Informix, Oracle.
  • Experience with Snowflake and exposure to cloud platforms, Azure cloud platform.
  • Demonstrated understanding of standard Data warehouse concepts.
  • Adept with data modeling, data mapping, data flow diagrams and data marts.
  • Previous experience architecting and implementing cloud-based database solutions on various platforms.
  • Experience with Data migration from legacy on-premises database to multi-cloud/hybrid cloud platforms.
  • Proven ability to spearhead and work independently, prioritize, and get things done.
  • Strong analytical, technical, problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent organization and time management skills and ability to identify priorities to accomplish a variety of tasks on schedule.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills and ability to work with people at every level. Comfortable writing down ideas, implementation plans and status reports.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience creating and managing database reports, visualizations, and dashboards.
  • Knowledge of court operations and law enforcement business data.

About the Role

Join an early-stage team building multimodal AI agents for customer communication across voice, SMS, and email. You will own a core product or technical domain, work directly with customers, and help shape product decisions as the platform grows.

What You'll Do

  • Own a domain end to end, from system architecture through shipping and operating production features.

  • Join customer conversations, identify needs, and make product decisions in a fast-moving environment.

  • Build and improve multimodal agents, including low-latency voice experiences and persistent conversations across channels.

  • Set quality practices for non-deterministic systems, including evaluations, prompt versioning, guardrails, and drift detection.

  • Contribute across React and Next.js frontends, Node.js backends, and Python services.

What We're Looking For

  • Typically 3 to 8 years of full-stack engineering experience, with a record of delivering products from early development through growth at startups, established technology companies, or as a founder.

  • Production proficiency with TypeScript, Node.js, React, and Next.js, plus hands-on experience building with LLM APIs or agent SDKs.

  • Experience owning and shipping production AI or agent systems, with depth in at least one area such as agent memory and state, evaluations and guardrails, voice or SMS agents, or marketplace and B2B2C products.

  • Strong product judgment, including customer discovery and making decisions without relying on a dedicated product manager.

  • Full-stack capability, including Python services for real-time systems or evaluation tooling, and experience with low-latency systems and persistent cross-channel data.

  • Strong technical fundamentals, an ability to work independently in an early-stage environment, and a record of sustained ownership and measurable product impact.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $180,000 to $250,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

On-site, five days per week in New York, New York.

jobs.excerpt: Position DescriptionValiant Solutions is hiring an Associate Software Engineer to build the internal apps, automations, and AI tools that help our staff work faster.
jobs.description:
Position Description

Valiant Solutions is hiring an Associate Software Engineer to build the internal apps, automations, and AI tools that help our staff work faster.

The Associate Software Engineer will work directly with people across the company to find slow or error-prone work, then design, build, and measure the fix. Much of this work runs through VITALs (Valiant Innovation Team and Lab), our program that turns staff ideas into custom apps and automations. Inside IT and Engineering, you work alongside the Engineering lead and the IT Systems Administrator. The Engineering lead sets technical direction and priorities. The IT Systems Administrator runs daily IT operations, user support, and software licenses. You build the apps, automations, and AI tools that make the team, and the rest of Valiant, more efficient. All three roles share one backlog and review work together, so ideas move quickly from a support ticket or staff interview to a working tool.

Named one of the Best Places to Work in the Washington DC area for 12 consecutive years, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

Location: This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.

Eligibility: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field or equivalent experience. 0 to 2 years of experience. Internships and substantial projects count.
  • Working skill in TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python.
  • An app, tool, or automation you built that other people used.
  • Working knowledge of RESTAPIs, OAuth 2.0, Git, and the Linux command line. Clear communication with technical and non-technical people, in writing and in conversation.
  • Ability to learn how a team works, find where it slows down, and plan the fix. Self-direction in a fully remote team.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud or another major cloud, plus Docker.
  • Next.js or React.
  • Workflow automation tools, such as n8n, Make.com, or Google Apps Script. LLM APIs, agents, MCP servers, orAI coding tools such as Claude Code. Google Workspace administration or GAM.
  • IT support experience.
  • Experience training users or running user acceptance testing.

Responsibilities:

Your core work is building software, automation, and AI tools that give Valiant staff time back. When IT gets busy, you also help the team with escalations.

Build and ship

  • Develop projects from the VITALs backlog, from project charter and definition of done through sprints, launch, and measurement.
  • Build and maintain apps on our internal Micro-App Platform for finance, contracts, HR, and other internal teams.
  • Move workflows out of low-code apps and into custom apps when they outgrow them.
  • Work with the IT Systems Administrator to further automate IT tasks and management, from account provisioning and offboarding to Google Workspace administration and reporting.
  • Build and maintain integrations between our business systems.
  • Run user acceptance testing with each app's users, and confirm every app works on real tasks before launch.
  • Ship through GitHub with code review, CI, tests, and a runbook for each release.

AI development and enablement

  • Help set Valiant's AI development strategy: where AI fits, how we evaluate it, and how we deploy it securely.
  • Build AI features, agents, and automations with LLM APIs and MCP servers, then measure the results against the manual baseline.
  • Test new AI models and tools as they release, and recommend what Valiant adopts. Advise Valiant on modern AI tools and research, such as Claude Code and ChatGPT, and keep the company current as the field changes. Your recommendations inform adoption and risk decisions by the CTO and Engineering lead.
  • Train staff to use AI tools well through sessions, written guides, and one-on-one help.

Discover and plan

  • Meet with staff and department leads to learn how their work gets done. Find the slow, manual, or error-prone steps in their workflows, and turn them into scoped plans with a measured baseline.
  • Keep exploring new ways technology can improve how Valiant works, and bring forward the ideas worth testing.
  • Contribute to the project that defines Valiant's future app architecture, including how apps share data, sign users in, and connect to business systems.

Tools you may work with. These are examples, not requirements. Our tools change as Valiant grows, and you learn most of them on the job.

  • App development: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Node.js, Python
  • Cloud and hosting: Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Firestore), Docker, Linux
  • Automation: n8n, Make.com, Google Apps Script, Bash, GAM
  • Business systems: Google Workspace, Unanet, Salesforce, GoDaddy, iCIMS, Knack, Notion, Discord, Supernormal
  • Source control and CI: GitHub, GitHub Actions

Growth and milestones

This role is built to grow. The apps you build become yours to own: you set their roadmap, work directly with the people who use them, and decide how they improve. As your track record grows, so does your scope, from single features to whole platforms, and from building tools to shaping how Valiant builds them.

Day 30: Learn the platform, ship a fix to a live app, and join a VITALs discovery session.

Day 60: Own one automation from end to end, with tests and a runbook.

Day 90: Take one VITALs project from intake to production, including user acceptance testing.

Month 6: Own one or more apps end to end. Hold regular check-ins with their department leads, and take part in architecture discussions.

Month 12: Act as a trusted technical partner to the department leads you support. Help design Valiant's future app architecture, lead discovery for new VITALs projects, and help set the direction of AI development.

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions delivers cybersecurity and IT services to federal civilian, defense, and national security customers nationwide. We support the full cyber lifecycle, from secure system design and accreditation through AI-enabled operations, threat emulation, and continuous improvement, across classified and unclassified environments. Our work is independently certified for quality and security, including CMMI, CMMC, and ISO certifications.

Valiant is a multi-year Washington Business Journal Best Places to Work winner, and our growth and cyber leadership have been recognized by Washington Technology, Northern Virginia Technology Council, and the Triangle Business Journal. We offer strong benefits, rewards for earning industry certifications, and room to grow your career as we grow. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, our distributed workforce supports customers from coast to coast. We go where the stakes are highest, and the margin for error is zero. If you want meaningful work alongside talented professionals, apply today.

Benefits Snapshot

Valiant takes care of the people who support our customers, with real choices in coverage and real investment in your career. Eligible full-time employees receive:

  • A choice of medical plans, from an affordable HSA option to a full-featured PPO, with generous company contributions
  • Dental and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Company-paid life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance
  • Optional supplemental life, accident, and critical illness coverage to round out your protection
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid time off that grows with your years of service, plus paid federal holidays
  • Paid certifications, professional development, and the Valiant University training portal
  • Flexible spending accounts and a wellness and fitness program
  • Referral bonuses when you help us bring great people to Valiant

Benefit eligibility and plan details are subject to the terms of each plan and may change from time to time.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $75,000 to $90,000. This range reflects Valiant Solutions' good-faith estimate of the base salary reasonably expected for this position upon hire, at the time of posting. The range has been established based on the scope of the role, market rates, and internal equity. Where a candidate falls within the posted range will depend on job-related factors, including relevant skills, experience, qualifications, achievements, education, geographic location, applicable security clearance requirements, additional corporate responsibilities, and other legitimate, non-discriminatory business considerations. The posted range does not guarantee an offer at any particular salary. In addition to base salary, this position includes the benefits described above.

Remote Work Policy (Remote and Hybrid Positions Only)

Remote work necessitates a high level of trust in our employees. To ensure that employee performance does not suffer in a remote work environment, all employees who telecommute are expected to have a quiet and distraction-free workspace with adequate internet, dedicate their full attention and availability to their job duties during working hours, and maintain a schedule during core business hours that aligns with those of their coworkers and Valiant's clients. In alignment with Valiant's inclusive and engaging environment, cameras are encouraged and can be required to be on during virtual video conferences. Additionally, in alignment with the Office of the Inspector General’s effort to eliminate conflicting employment, all Valiant employees are required to disclose any current or future outside employment engagements. During onboarding and throughout employment, employees must disclose any current activities or intent to engage in outside employment or other professional activities and obtain written approval. Employees may not solicit or conduct any outside business during core business hours for Valiant Solutions and our clients.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Valiant Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Valiant Solutions provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need an accommodation during the application or hiring process, please contact .

Physical Demands

Sitting or standing at a desk for prolonged periods and consistently operating a computer. Frequent communication and exchanging of accurate information via electronic communication, phones, and in person. Occasionally lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically less than 20 pounds. A representative task may require analyzing an airfoil, preparing a computational domain and mesh, defining appropriate boundary conditions, running a CFD simulation, calculating lift and drag, and determining whether the resulting flow field is numerically and physically valid.

  1. Solve and validate aerodynamic and fluid-dynamics problems.
  2. Translate physical requirements into computational models and solver-ready cases.
  3. Create or modify geometries, computational domains, and meshes.
  4. Define appropriate initial conditions, boundary conditions, fluid properties, and solver settings.
  5. Run CFD and aerodynamic-analysis workflows using command-line-accessible tools.
  6. Use Python to automate preprocessing, simulation execution, parameter sweeps, postprocessing, and validation.

  1. An MS or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with an aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, or thermofluids specialization; or
  2. A BS in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering plus at least 1–2 years of aero-specific professional or research experience.
  3. Strong understanding of fluid mechanics and applied aerodynamics.
  4. Experience formulating and executing CFD or aerodynamic analyses.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one engineering tool or library that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.
  7. Ability to select and justify modeling assumptions, boundary conditions, mesh strategies, and solver settings.
  8. Ability to diagnose non-convergence, unstable solutions, incorrect results, and physically invalid outputs.

Relevant tools may include Python,OpenFOAM, SU2, Gmsh, FEniCSx, Elmer, CalculiX, SciPy, or similar programmatic engineering software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, solver APIs, mesh-processing libraries, or domain-specific scientific packages. No single library is mandatory.

Kearney & Company is hiring a Senior Data Engineer – Subject Matter Expert. The Senior Data Engineer SME will design, develop, optimize, and sustain enterprise data engineering solutions supporting the FASTR program within the War Data Platform. Working under the Technical Lead / Solution Architect, the SME will implement reliable ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and validation pipelines for Department of the Air Force financial data. This role collaborates with functional, architecture, and integration teams to deliver traceable, secure, and production-ready datasets that enable audit readiness, FIAR, and financial management reporting. Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Design, build, test, and maintain scalable batch and incremental data ingestion and transformation pipelines within the War Data Platform.
  • Implement approved source-to-target mappings, business rules, and data models in collaboration with Data Architecture / Transformation Analysts.
  • Develop and optimize SQL, Python, and ETL/ELT processes for large, complex financial datasets.
  • Build reusable data processing components, orchestration workflows, and automated data quality controls.
  • Implement completeness, accuracy, reconciliation, and lineage checks to support FIAR and Universe of Transactions requirements.
  • Investigate and resolve pipeline failures, performance bottlenecks, schema changes, and data integrity issues.
  • Coordinate with Interface & Integration Analysts to validate inbound feeds, interface contracts, and source-system dependencies.
  • Apply engineering standards for version control, peer review, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with BI / Reporting teams to publish reliable, well-documented datasets and support downstream analytical use cases.
  • Partner with authorized platform and security personnel to implement applicable access, handling, and operational controls.
  • Provide technical mentorship, code reviews, and implementation guidance to other data engineering personnel.
  • Communicate engineering progress, technical risks, defects, dependencies, and remediation recommendations to the Technical Lead / Solution Architect.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in data engineering, enterprise data integration, data platform development, or related technical disciplines.
  • Extensive hands-on experience designing and implementing production ETL/ELT pipelines and large-scale data transformations.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python or comparable data engineering programming languages.
  • Demonstrated experience with data modeling, orchestration, performance tuning, and data pipeline troubleshooting.
  • Demonstrated experience with engineering delivery platforms (such as Databricks, Palantir Foundry, etc.)
  • Experience implementing automated data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and end-to-end data traceability.
  • Knowledge of software engineering practices including source control, testing, code reviews, and deployment processes.
  • Ability to work with cross-functional teams, interpret technical specifications, and deliver maintainable production solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret level security clearance (requires US Citizenship)
  • Must be willing and able to travel as required, up to 25% of the time

  • Experience supporting Department of the Air Force or other Department of War financial management systems and modernization programs.
  • Experience developing or sustaining data engineering solutions within the War Data Platform or comparable secure enterprise analytics environments.
  • Familiarity with FIAR, Universe of Transactions, financial reconciliation, and audit-support data requirements.
  • Experience with distributed processing, cloud data services, orchestration tools, CI/CD, and pipeline monitoring.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Relevant data engineering, cloud, or platform certifications.
